title: AI-assisted pre-review of open-source software submissions: an experience report from BOSC 2026
summary: Most conferences rely on peer-review of submissions, but as generative AI makes it easier than ever to prepare submission materials, some conferences are seeing an overwhelming surge of submissions. We wanted to see if generative AI could help our conference's volunteer reviewers by pre-reviewing abstracts for certain criteria. The Bioinformatics Open Source Conference (BOSC) was well-positioned to experiment with this, as we already had a detailed rubric used by reviewers to evaluate submitted abstracts on multiple criteria, including openness (public availability of the code or other content associated with the project), valid open source license, and "runnability" (how easy it is to download, build, and run the project - an important measure of reusability). For BOSC 2026, we built bosc-pre-review, an agentic skill that assessed six review criteria, and Runabilly, which builds and tests each project in a disposable Docker container for safety. The AI only gathered evidence to present to the reviewers; humans made every decision regarding the acceptance of the abstracts. After the review period, we surveyed the reviewers to determine how useful they found the pre-review. Most of those who responded said they found it useful, but they preferred to check the AI's conclusions against their own, rather than accepting the AI results unquestioningly.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在BOSC 2026会议中使用生成式AI辅助审稿人预审摘要的实验。作者构建了bosc-pre-review技能（评估六个审稿标准）和Runabilly工具（在Docker容器中构建和测试项目），AI仅收集证据供人类审稿人参考，最终审稿人调查显示多数认为有用，但倾向于将AI结论与自身判断交叉验证，而非盲目接受。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI使提交材料的准备变得更加容易，会议面临大量投稿激增，志愿者审稿人负担过重。作者希望探索生成式AI能否通过预审摘要来帮助审稿人减轻负担。
AI.method: 在BOSC 2026上构建了bosc-pre-review（一个评估六个审稿标准的agentic技能）和Runabilly（在一次性Docker容器中构建和测试每个项目以确保安全）。AI仅收集证据提交给审稿人，人类保留所有决定权。审稿期后通过调查收集审稿人反馈。
AI.result: 大多数回复调查的审稿人表示AI预审有用，但他们偏好将AI的结论与自己的判断进行核对，而不是不加批判地接受AI结果。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI辅助预审在会议审稿流程中具有实用价值，但应定位为辅助工具而非替代人类判断，审稿人的批判性验证需求表明AI与人类协作的模式更受欢迎。

title: LayerRAG-Bench: A Cross-Layer Reliability Benchmark for Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation systems can produce answers that appear grounded while failing at the evidence, tool-contract, authorization, or session-state layer. We introduce LayerRAG-Bench, a controlled cross-layer reliability benchmark with 8 enterprise domains, 240 tasks, 9 fault scenarios, 2 contract modes, and 38,880 live task-level records across nine models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini. Schema normalization raises schema-drift success from 0.000 to 0.913, but stale evidence, missing tool output, denied permissions, and wrong-session context are not recovered by schema normalization. Groundedness-only evaluation also produces substantial false positives under stale and wrong-session evidence. These results support a layer-specific evaluation principle: a reliability intervention should be credited for repairing its target layer without being mistaken for a universal fix.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LayerRAG-Bench，一个跨层可靠性基准测试，包含8个企业领域、240个任务、9种故障场景、2种契约模式和38000多条记录，用于评估9个主流模型在RAG系统各层的可靠性表现。研究发现模式规范化只能修复schema漂移问题，而陈旧证据、缺失工具输出、权限拒绝和错误会话上下文等问题无法被修复，且仅基于groundedness的评估会产生大量误报。
AI.motivation: 现有的Agentic RAG系统虽然能生成看似正确的答案，但在证据层、工具契约层、授权层和会话状态层可能存在隐藏的可靠性缺陷。需要设计一个系统化的跨层可靠性基准来识别不同层的故障，并澄清不同可靠性干预手段的实际修复范围。
AI.method: 构建LayerRAG-Bench基准测试框架，覆盖8个企业领域、240个任务、9种故障场景、2种契约模式，评估OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini三家的9个模型，共产生38,880条任务级记录。通过模式规范化和groundedness-only评估等对比实验来检验不同干预手段的效果。
AI.result: 模式规范化可将schema漂移成功率从0.000提升到0.913，但对陈旧证据、缺失工具输出、权限拒绝和错误会话上下文等故障无能为力。仅基于groundedness的评估在陈旧证据和错误会话证据场景下会产生大量误报。
AI.conclusion: 提出分层评估原则：可靠性干预措施应仅被认定修复其目标层的问题，而不应被视为通用解决方案。这意味着评估和修复都需要针对故障所属的具体层次进行精细化处理。

title: Theatre Chapbooks At Scale: A Statistical Comparative Analysis of Typography
summary: We propose a statistical methodology that quantifies the similarity of typefaces between printed historical books. This provides a tool that accelerates philological analysis. Using character prototypes derived from clustering and aligning automatically extracted character images, the method defines a typeface distance between any two books. To produce actionable outputs, we develop an a contrario statistical framework to interpret the significance of the computed typeface distances. We apply the method to the philological study of 17 th -century Spanish printed theatre chapbooks in a quantity that exceeds the capabilities of systematic visual inspection by human experts. Our method enables the automatic comparison of Roman and Italic types extracted from different books. After validation by human experts, our method has led to new printer attributions being discovered, and former printer attributions being revised. This success strongly suggests that our method has the potential to enable digital bibliography on a larger scale than was previously possible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统计方法，通过自动提取字模图像并聚类比对，量化历史印刷书籍之间的字体相似度，并利用a contrario统计框架评估距离的显著性，成功应用于17世纪西班牙戏剧小册子的印刷商鉴定。
AI.motivation: 传统的印刷史和文献学分析依赖人类专家对字体进行视觉比对，在面对大规模历史书籍时效率极低且难以系统化。作者希望开发一种自动化工具，能够在大规模语料上量化字体相似度，加速并扩展文献学（尤其是印刷商归属）研究的范围。
AI.method: 方法包括三个核心步骤：(1) 从印刷书籍中自动提取字符图像，通过聚类和对齐生成字符原型（character prototypes）；(2) 基于这些原型定义任意两本书之间的字体距离（typeface distance）；(3) 采用a contrario统计框架对计算得到的字体距离进行显著性检验，以产生可操作的结论。方法支持罗马体和斜体字体的自动跨书籍比较。
AI.result: 将该方法应用于17世纪西班牙印刷戏剧小册子的大规模语料（远超人类专家目视检查能力）。经人类专家验证后，方法成功发现了新的印刷商归属，并修正了先前错误的印刷商归属，证明了方法的有效性和可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为数字目录学（digital bibliography）提供了可扩展的工具，使大规模历史书籍的印刷商鉴定成为可能，有潜力显著扩大数字文献学研究的规模和范围。

title: Multi-Head Attention Residuals
summary: Transformers propagate information across depth through a single additive residual stream: every sublayer reads only the most recent state. Attention residuals relax this by letting each sublayer attend, through a learned softmax. However, that read uses a single query shared across the entire width, so every feature subspace must read the depth history through one distribution. The cost of this forced compromise grows with how much the subspaces disagree about which layers to read, and disagreement grows with model width. We introduce Multi-Head Attention Residuals (MHAR): the routing query is reshaped into H per-subspace heads, each with its own softmax over the depth history. The read becomes block-diagonal, the reshape adds zero parameters and negligible compute, and H = 1 recovers attention residuals exactly. Trained from scratch on a deduplicated Nemotron-based anneal corpus that is quality-filtered and STEM- and code-heavy, MHAR improves validation loss over a standard Transformer at 100M, 350M, and 1B (-0.061, -0.149, and -0.140). It achieves the best result among four methods in every setting, with the gain increasing from 100M to the larger scales. The head count is a real design axis rather than a free knob: validation loss is U-shaped with respect to H, with a flat optimum at H = 4 or H = 8 across scales. We adopt H = 8 for large-scale models; over-splitting beyond this point (H = 16) consistently gives back part of the gain. A direct probe of the trained queries confirms that learned subspace disagreement is the underlying driver. Fused Triton routing kernels increase attention-residual training throughput from 0.2-0.5x to 0.55-0.88x of the baseline while maintaining near-baseline peak memory. An identity-preserving conversion using delta attention residuals supports 8B mid-training, yielding improvements of +3.2 on GSM8K and +3.1 on GPQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多头注意力残差（MHAR），将注意力残差中的单一路由查询重塑为H个子空间头部，每个头部拥有独立的softmax来读取深度历史，从而消除不同特征子空间在读取历史时的强制妥协。该方法零参数增加、计算开销可忽略，在100M、350M和1B规模上均优于标准Transformer及其他三种对比方法，并支持8B模型的中途训练改进。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer通过单一加性残差流传播信息，注意力残差虽允许每个子层通过softmax关注深度历史，但单一查询被所有特征子空间共享，导致不同子空间对读取哪一层历史的分歧被迫妥协。随着模型宽度增加，这种分歧加剧，成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 将注意力残差中的路由查询重塑为H个按子空间划分的头部，每个头部各自对深度历史做softmax，使读取操作变为块对角结构。H=1时退化为原始注意力残差。配合融合Triton路由内核提升训练吞吐，并使用delta注意力残差实现恒等保持的转换以支持中途训练。
AI.result: 在去重、质量过滤且偏STEM和代码的Nemotron退火语料上，MHAR在100M、350M和1B规模分别带来-0.061、-0.149和-0.140的验证损失改进，在所有设置中均取得四种方法中的最优结果，且增益随规模增大。训练吞吐从基线0.2-0.5x提升至0.55-0.88x。8B中途训练在GSM8K和GPQA上分别提升+3.2和+3.1。
AI.conclusion: MHAR验证了子空间对深度历史读取的分歧是注意力残差性能受限的根本原因，头部数量H是真实的设计轴而非自由参数，最佳值为H=4或8（大规模选8），过度分割（H=16）会损失部分收益。该方法在规模扩大时优势更明显，且实际部署开销可控。

title: BridgeAlign: Bridging Preference Alignment for Humanities and Social Sciences
summary: While data synthesis for large language models (LLMs) is prevalent, it primarily targets domains with verifiable answers, overlooking open-ended humanities and social sciences (HSS), where nuanced quality judgments matter more than objective correctness. This makes preference alignment a natural paradigm for broad HSS tasks. Yet existing methods are either costly or not tailored to broad HSS disciplines. We thus propose BridgeAlign, among the first preference-alignment pipelines for broad HSS disciplines, with three phases: i) Seed Curation: curating HSS seed documents from web corpora via heuristic/LLM-based filtering and text refinement; ii) Preference Data Synthesis: generating preference triplets via persona-based instruction inversion with Q&A consistency checks; iii) Preference Optimization: moving beyond naive human-vs-model heuristics by first grounding preferences in HSS quality rubric, then generating transitional responses via controlled quality degradation to form near-boundary preference pairs for finer-grained quality discrimination. Aligning over 210k synthetic preference samples, BridgeAlign enables Qwen3-8B to achieve the best average across 17 benchmarks against 11 strong baselines; importantly, leading on both human-preference and knowledge-based capabilities at once, with no trade-off between them, as supported by extensive experiments and contextualized by existing theories.

AI.tldr: BridgeAlign是首个面向广泛人文社会科学（HSS）领域的偏好对齐流水线，通过种子数据策展、基于人设的指令反转合成偏好数据，以及基于质量量规的过渡响应生成三个阶段，实现了LLM在HSS任务上的精细质量判别。在210k合成偏好样本上对齐后，Qwen3-8B在17个基准上超越11个强基线，同时兼顾人类偏好与知识能力。
AI.motivation: 现有数据合成方法主要面向具有可验证答案的领域，忽略了开放式的HSS领域，而HSS任务更依赖精细质量判断而非客观正确性。现有的偏好对齐方法要么成本高昂，要么不适合广泛的HSS学科，因此需要一种专门针对HSS的偏好对齐流水线。
AI.method: BridgeAlign包含三个阶段：1）种子策展：通过启发式/LLM过滤和文本精炼从网络语料中策展HSS种子文档；2）偏好数据合成：通过基于人设的指令反转生成偏好三元组，并带有Q&A一致性检查；3）偏好优化：基于HSS质量量规将偏好扎根于理论，通过受控质量降级生成过渡响应，形成近边界偏好对以实现更精细的质量区分。
AI.result: 在210k合成偏好样本上对齐后，BridgeAlign使Qwen3-8B在17个基准上的平均表现达到最佳，超越了11个强基线。重要的是，它在人类偏好和知识能力基准上同时领先，二者之间没有权衡。
AI.conclusion: BridgeAlign证明了对HSS领域进行专门偏好对齐是可行且高效的，通过质量量规引导的偏好优化可以在广泛HSS任务上实现细粒度质量判别，且不会在以人类偏好为中心的能力和基于知识的能力之间产生折衷。

title: OVEarth-Bench: Evaluating Category Breadth and Query Diversity for Open-Vocabulary Earth Observation
summary: Open-vocabulary Earth observation (EO) aims to localize geospatial concepts specified in natural language rather than a fixed label set. Existing benchmarks, however, usually cover narrow category vocabularies or limited query forms. To fill this gap, we introduce OVEarth-Bench, which extends existing evaluation in two directions: category breadth, through broad hierarchical category coverage with positive and negative expressions, and query diversity, through vocabulary, referring, and reasoning queries. The benchmark supports mask and box localization under a unified zero-shot protocol. We evaluate a broad set of general and EO-specific methods. The evaluation reveals that: (1) the performance of current methods remains limited, while broader category coverage yields more stable model rankings; (2) MLLM-based methods achieve the strongest overall performance; and (3) EO-specific methods generally underperform general models and rarely match the strongest methods. These findings provide guidance for future open-vocabulary EO method design and highlight the importance of developing more realistic, diverse, high-quality, and large-scale benchmarks for reliable evaluation. Our data and evaluation package are released at https://earth-insights.github.io/OVEarth-bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OVEarth-Bench基准，用于开放性词汇地球观测任务，在类别广度和查询多样性两个方向上扩展了现有评估，并系统评估了通用和EO专用方法，发现当前方法性能有限、MLLM方法表现最佳、EO专用方法普遍不如通用模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的地球观测（EO）开放性词汇基准通常只覆盖狭隘的类别词汇或有限的查询形式，无法全面评估模型在真实场景中的开放性词汇定位能力，因此需要更全面、更多样化的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建OVEarth-Bench基准，在类别广度上通过广泛的分层类别覆盖（包含正面和负面表达）进行扩展；在查询多样性上通过词汇查询、指代查询和推理查询三种形式进行扩展。基准支持在统一的零样本协议下进行掩码和框定位评估，并评估了通用方法和EO专用方法。
AI.result: 评估发现：（1）现有方法性能仍然有限，但更广泛的类别覆盖能带来更稳定的模型排名；（2）基于MLLM的方法整体性能最强；（3）EO专用方法通常不如通用模型，很少能匹敌最强方法。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为未来开放性词汇EO方法设计提供了指导，强调了开发更现实、更多样、更高质量和大规模基准对可靠评估的重要性。数据和评估包已公开发布。

title: KernelGenBench: A Multi-Source and Multi-Chip Benchmark for LLM-based Kernel Generation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/flagos-ai/KernelGenBench
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly increased the demand for efficient accelerator kernels, but kernel development remains a highly specialized and labor-intensive task. The recent rise of LLMs and agentic frameworks offers a promising pathway toward automatic kernel generation. However, despite rapid progress, there is still no comprehensive benchmark to rigorously evaluate LLM-generated kernels across diverse operator sources or heterogeneous hardware platforms. We present KernelGenBench, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM- and agent-generated Triton kernels across diverse operator sources and heterogeneous hardware platforms. It comprises two complementary sub-benchmarks: KernelGenBench-MS (Multi-Source), evaluating 210 operators from three sources beyond standard PyTorch-centric tasks, and KernelGenBench-MC (Multi-Chip), measuring performance portability across six heterogeneous hardware platforms using a 110-operator subset. Our large-scale evaluation, consuming over 15 billion tokens, shows: (1) agent-based methods consistently outperform pure LLM sampling methods, while cuBLAS operators are the most challenging across all methods; (2) generation performance varies significantly across hardware platforms, with even recent kernel-specialized agents experiencing severe cross-platform degradation (e.g., AutoKernel drops from 87% on NVIDIA to 25% on Platform E); (3) autonomous kernel generation remains highly cost-intensive, with specialized agent methods averaging 5.11 million tokens per successful operator (AKO4all reaches 5.19 million), orders of magnitude higher than simple LLM sampling approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了KernelGenBench，一个统一基准测试框架，用于系统评估LLM和智能体生成的Triton内核，涵盖210个多源算子和110个跨六种异构硬件平台的算子子集，大规模评估消费超过150亿tokens。
AI.motivation: LLM对高效加速器内核的需求激增，但内核开发高度专业化且劳动密集。尽管LLM和智能体框架为自动内核生成带来了希望，但缺乏一个统一、全面的基准来严格评估跨不同算子来源和异构硬件平台上LLM生成内核的性能。
AI.method: 构建KernelGenBench统一基准，包含两个互补子基准：KernelGenBench-MS（多来源，评估来自三个来源的210个算子）和KernelGenBench-MC（多芯片，使用110个算子子集测量跨六种异构硬件平台的性能可移植性），并进行超过150亿tokens的大规模评估。
AI.result: （1）基于智能体的方法始终优于纯LLM采样方法，cuBLAS算子对所有方法最具挑战性；（2）生成性能在不同硬件平台间差异显著，即使是近期内核专用智能体也遭受严重的跨平台性能退化（如AutoKernel从NVIDIA上的87%降至平台E上的25%）；（3）自主内核生成成本极高，专用智能体方法平均每个成功算子消耗511万tokens，比简单LLM采样方法高出数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: KernelGenBench揭示了当前LLM和智能体内核生成方法的现状：智能体方法表现更优但存在严重跨平台退化问题，且自主内核生成的成本效益仍然非常低下，为未来研究指明了改进方向。

title: HSS-Synth: Humanities and Social Sciences Data Synthesis for LLMs
summary: High-quality, diverse data are vital for large language models (LLMs) but remain scarce and costly. Data synthesis is a viable alternative and succeeds on closed tasks, yet the humanities and social sciences (HSS) are overlooked, and their open-ended nature makes synthesis challenging. Moving beyond prior capability-centric, fragmented attempts, we adopt a subject-centric paradigm, define the first HSS domain system covering 14 mainstream fields, and introduce HSS-Synth, the first data synthesis pipeline for HSS. HSS-Synth comprises: (1) constructing seed documents from web corpora via multi-step filtering and text refinement evaluated by a judge; (2) specifying "requirements + persona" to backtranslate seed documents into diverse yet faithful instructions with a strict Q&A alignment check; and (3) breaking LLM response limits via teacher-forced Answering that feeds seed documents during response generation to anchor semantics, reduce hallucinations, and preserve tone and integrity. HSS-Synth yields 237k high-quality, diverse instruction-tuning samples that outperform 14 leading baselines on 16 benchmarks. The fine-tuned Qwen3-8B-Base sets a new SOTA and approaches the official Qwen3-8B, improving both human preference and knowledge capabilities without performance seesaws. Extensive experiments demonstrate HSS-Synth's robustness and transferability. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/pengr/HSS-Synth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSS-Synth，首个面向人文社科（HSS）领域的数据合成流水线，通过种子文档构建、需求+角色反翻译生成指令以及教师强制回答三个环节，合成237k高质量多样化指令微调样本，在16个基准上超越14个基线，微调后的Qwen3-8B-Base达到新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 高质量、多样化的数据对LLM至关重要但稀缺且昂贵。数据合成在封闭任务上已取得成功，但人文社科领域被忽视，且其开放性问题性质使合成具有挑战性。现有方法多为能力导向的碎片化尝试，缺乏系统性解决方案。
AI.method: HSS-Synth包含三个核心环节：(1)通过网络爬虫语料经多步过滤和文本精炼（由评审模型评估）构建种子文档；(2)通过"需求+角色"设定将种子文档反翻译为多样化且忠实的指令，并进行严格的问答对齐检查；(3)采用教师强制回答策略，在回答生成过程中喂入种子文档以锚定语义、减少幻觉并保持语气和完整性。
AI.result: 生成237k高质量多样化指令微调样本，在16个基准上超越14个领先基线。微调后的Qwen3-8B-Base达到新SOTA，接近官方Qwen3-8B，同时在人类偏好和知识能力上均有提升，未出现性能下滑。大量实验证明方法的鲁棒性和可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: HSS-Synth采用主体中心（subject-centric）范式，定义了覆盖14个主流领域的首个HSS领域系统，验证了数据合成在开放性问题上的可行性，为HSS领域的高质量数据构建提供了可复现的解决方案。

title: VETO: Towards Protecting Images From Frontier AI Editing
summary: The rise of powerful, accessible image-editing models such as FLUX.2 has brought high-fidelity editing within broad reach. Their capabilities now extend beyond localized modifications to extracting and recontextualizing objects and identities in entirely new scenes. By allowing prompt and generation tokens to attend directly to reference-image tokens, modern models blur the boundary between conventional editing and text-to-image synthesis. This expanded generative freedom also broadens the space of potential misuse, as harmful transformations are no longer confined to a predictable set of localized edits. Existing anti-edit defenses are designed to disrupt the semantic bottleneck of the reference-image encoding in legacy diffusion pipelines. However, newer editors distill reference information through joint-attention blocks, thereby often circumventing these protections. We therefore introduce VETO, a subtle anti-edit cloak that disrupts this inner mechanism through which modern models read the source image. Additionally, as existing editing benchmarks leave comprehensive recontextualizations largely untested, we introduce VetoBench, which evaluates defenses not only on conventional localized edits but also on broader contextual shifts. Across two contemporary editing models and three benchmarks, VETO consistently outperforms existing defenses while providing a stronger protection-fidelity trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VETO，一种针对现代图像编辑模型（如FLUX.2）的反编辑保护机制，通过干扰联合注意力机制而非传统语义瓶颈来防护图像篡改，并引入VetoBench基准以评估包括重上下文化在内的更广泛编辑场景。
AI.motivation: 现代图像编辑模型能力大幅提升，支持物体和身份在新场景中的提取与重上下文化，远超传统局部编辑。现有反编辑防御专注于干扰传统扩散管道中参考图像编码的语义瓶颈，但新模型通过联合注意力模块蒸馏参考信息，常常绕过这些防护，因此需要新的防御方法。
AI.method: 提出VETO隐形反编辑掩码（cloak），通过干扰现代模型读取源图像的内部机制——即联合注意力模块，来实现防护。同时构建VetoBench基准，不仅评估传统局部编辑，还覆盖更广泛的情境转换场景。
AI.result: 在两种当代编辑模型和三个基准上，VETO一致优于现有防御方法，并提供更强的保护-保真度权衡。
AI.conclusion: VETO有效针对现代图像编辑模型的联合注意力机制提供反编辑保护，VetoBench为更全面的编辑防护评估提供了新标准。

title: RadHarmony: Radiological Data Handling in the Era of Agentic AI
summary: Training deep learning models on radiological images requires integrating heterogeneous datasets across different sources, file formats, directory layouts, label schemas, and annotation types. We present RadHarmony, an open-source Python library that provides a unified API for loading, harmonizing, and augmenting radiological datasets, with a primary focus on chest radiographs and early support for computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). RadHarmony standardizes metadata from 24 public datasets into a single tabular format, wraps MONAI's map-style datasets for deep-learning-ready sample delivery with optional on-disk caching, and supports classification labels, segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and radiology report text through a single interface, with an interactive visualization tool for dataset exploration and verification. To lower the barrier for integrating new datasets, RadHarmony introduces an AI-agent skill that guides the full integration workflow from raw data inspection through code generation and testing. We demonstrate the library's utility by pretraining RadHarmony-ViT, a reference vision transformer baseline that combines three heterogeneous chest radiograph datasets with no dataset-specific code. The code and pretrained model weights are available at https://github.com/f10409/RadHarmony.

AI.tldr: RadHarmony是一个开源的Python库，提供统一的API来加载、整合和增强放射学数据集，主要支持胸部X光片，并初步支持CT和MRI。它标准化了24个公共数据集的元数据，封装了MONAI数据集，支持多种标注类型，并引入AI-agent技能降低新数据集集成的门槛。通过预训练RadHarmony-ViT验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 在放射图像上训练深度学习模型需要整合来自不同来源、文件格式、目录布局、标签体系和标注类型的异构数据集，这一过程繁琐且耗时，缺乏统一的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 将24个公共数据集的元数据标准化为单一表格格式；2) 封装MONAI的map-style数据集，提供深度学习就绪的样本输出和可选的磁盘缓存；3) 通过单一接口支持分类标签、分割掩码、边界框和放射报告文本；4) 提供交互式可视化工具用于数据集探索与验证；5) 引入AI-agent技能引导完整的数据集集成工作流，从原始数据检查到代码生成和测试。
AI.result: 通过结合三个异质胸部X光数据集预训练RadHarmony-ViT（参考视觉Transformer基线），无需数据集特定的代码即可完成训练，验证了库的实用性。代码和预训练模型权重已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: RadHarmony有效降低了放射学数据集的集成和使用门槛，提供了一站式解决方案，使研究者无需编写数据集特定代码即可跨多个异质数据集训练深度学习模型。

title: Bunraku: Turning a Single Illustration into an Editable Live2D Character
summary: Live2D is the dominant 2D character-animation format for anime characters and virtual avatars, representing each character as a stack of RGBA layers driven by per-layer mesh deformation. Despite its wide use in virtual streaming, mobile games, and interactive characters, authoring a Live2D model still demands weeks of manual layer separation, occlusion completion, mesh placement, and keyframing, and no prior generative method produces such a structured asset end-to-end. We present the first system that, from a single illustration, generates all the structured information a Live2D runtime consumes: ordered RGBA layers, a deformation mesh per layer, and the parameter-driven keypose vertex offsets that make the character move. Stage 1 casts layered decomposition as a layered diffusion process under a Live2D-aware organ-level taxonomy, producing an ordered RGBA stack with hidden-region completion. Stage 2 builds a content-conforming triangle mesh for each layer from its alpha channel alone, then predicts the keypose displacement field of all layers jointly: every vertex of every layer is one token, self-attention spans layer boundaries, and each displacement is factorised into a bounded direction and a log-magnitude. Joint rather than independent prediction is what makes the result a coherent character instead of separately plausible parts, and is our largest gain; scaling the network 112x yields none. On 50 held-out characters, under true generation with no teacher forcing, Stage 2 attains a per-vertex direction cosine of 0.768 (median 0.828). Because a layer's mesh derives from its alpha channel, a clothing layer can be re-textured from a natural-language instruction while the mesh and predicted animation are reused byte-for-byte. We further contribute Live2D-Bench, the first standardized benchmark for the task, and an 8,884-model Live2D corpus with layer and animation supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个从单张插画端到端生成完整Live2D结构化资产的系统，包括有序RGBA图层、逐图层变形网格和参数驱动的关键帧顶点偏移。通过分层扩散过程实现图层分解，并通过联合预测所有层顶点位移来生成连贯的角色动画。
AI.motivation: Live2D是动漫角色和虚拟形象的主流2D角色动画格式，但其制作流程需要数周的人工操作（图层分离、遮挡补全、网格放置和关键帧制作），且此前没有任何生成方法能端到端产出这种结构化资产。
AI.method: 系统分为两个阶段：Stage 1采用基于Live2D意识器官分类学的分层扩散过程，生成带有隐藏区域补全的有序RGBA图层堆栈；Stage 2仅从每层的alpha通道构建内容一致的三角网格，然后联合预测所有层的关键帧位移场——每个顶点作为一个token，自注意力跨越图层边界，每个位移被分解为有界方向和log幅度。
AI.result: 在50个保留角色上，在无教师强制的真实生成条件下，Stage 2达到每顶点方向余弦0.768（中位数0.828）。联合预测比独立预测带来最大增益，而将网络扩展112倍无任何提升。此外，由于图层网格源自alpha通道，衣物层可通过自然语言指令重新纹理化，同时复用原网格和动画。还贡献了首个标准化基准Live2D-Bench和含8,884个模型的Live2D语料库。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个从单张插画生成完整Live2D结构化资产的系统，证明了联合跨层预测对生成连贯角色的关键作用，并提供了标准基准和语料库以推动该领域后续研究。

title: Asymmetric Collapse in Model Merging: When Refusal Over- writes Recognition
comment: Accepted into COLM AIW, waiting decision for AdvML-Frontiers x CoTMA and HAIPS
summary: Model merging is often used to combine capabilities from separately fine-tuned models without additional training, but it is unclear whether standard merging methods preserve multiple safety-relevant behaviors simultaneously. We study this question through a controlled case study using two Gemma-3-1B-IT finetunes on two complementary safety objectives: CARES harm-level classification and WildJailbreak adversarial refusal. We merge the two fine-tunes using Linear, SLERP, TIES, and DARE-TIES, and evaluate the merged models on classification accuracy, attack resistance, and benign compliance. Across all four methods, attack resistance transfers significantly more than classification accuracy: merged models retain 81-85% jailbreak refusal rates while CARES accuracy falls to at most 12.9%. Weight-space measurements suggest that this asymmetry is not caused by strongly opposing task-vector directions: the two task vectors are nearly orthogonal (cosine similarity 0.011). Instead, the refusal fine-tune induces consistently larger per-layer task-vector magnitudes, causing magnitude-sensitive methods to favor refusal updates. These results show that standard model merging can collapse safety recognition into broad refusal when safety-relevant task vectors differ substantially in scale.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控案例研究发现，当用标准模型合并方法（Linear、SLERP、TIES、DARE-TIES）合并两个针对不同安全目标的微调模型时，攻击拒绝能力（81-85%的越狱拒绝率）远好于分类准确性（CARES准确率仅12.9%）。这种不对称不是由于任务向量方向对立（余弦相似度仅0.011），而是因为拒绝微调产生更大的逐层任务向量幅度，导致幅度敏感的方法偏向拒绝更新。
AI.motivation: 模型合并常用于不经过额外训练就组合多个微调模型的能力，但标准合并方法能否同时保留多个安全相关行为尚不明确，需要系统性研究这种多安全能力保持问题。
AI.method: 使用两个Gemma-3-1B-IT微调模型，分别针对CARES危害级别分类和WildJailbreak对抗拒绝两类互补安全目标。采用Linear、SLERP、TIES和DARE-TIES四种合并方法，评估合并后模型的分类准确率、攻击抵抗力和良性合规性，并通过权重空间测量分析任务向量的余弦相似度和逐层幅度。
AI.result: 四种合并方法下，攻击拒绝率保持在81-85%，而CARES分类准确率降至12.9%或以下。两个任务向量几乎正交（余弦相似度0.011），但拒绝微调的逐层任务向量幅度更大，导致幅度敏感的合并方法偏向保留拒绝行为。
AI.conclusion: 当安全相关的任务向量在规模上差异显著时，标准模型合并会导致安全识别能力塌缩为广泛拒绝行为，揭示了模型合并在多安全目标场景下的固有缺陷。

title: AHA-Memes: A Fine-Grained Multimodal Benchmark for Understanding Hate in Arabic Memes
summary: Hateful memes are a growing form of multimodal online harm, where hostile intent is often conveyed through the joint interpretation of images, text, cultural references, and implicit targets. While hateful meme detection has advanced in high-resource languages, Arabic remains underexplored, with existing meme resources focusing mainly on propaganda or coarse harmful-content labels. We introduce AHA-Memes (Arabic HAteful Memes), which is, to our knowledge, the first large-scale Arabic hateful meme benchmark with fine-grained, multi-label annotations. The dataset includes 5K manually annotated memes using a taxonomy that captures hate types, i.e., attack strategies. We further provide ~66K silver-labeled memes to support future studies. We benchmark text-only, image-only, and late-fusion multimodal models, as well as few-shot in-context learning (ICL) and open- and closed-weight Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under zero-shot and fine-tuning settings. Our results establish strong baselines and highlight key challenges in culturally grounded Arabic hateful meme detection. We release the dataset, annotation guidelines, and evaluation scripts to support future research. WARNING: This paper contains examples that may be disturbing to readers.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AHA-Memes，这是首个大规模阿拉伯语仇恨模因基准数据集，包含5K条人工标注的多标签仇恨类型模因和约66K条银标签模因，并对多种单模态和多模态模型进行了基准测试。
AI.motivation: 仇恨模因在阿拉伯语中的研究仍然不足，现有阿拉伯语模因资源主要关注宣传或粗粒度有害内容标签，缺乏细粒度、多标签的仇恨模因数据集。
AI.method: 构建包含5K条人工标注的阿拉伯语仇恨模因数据集，采用捕捉攻击策略的仇恨类型分类体系进行多标签标注，并提供约66K条银标签数据；对文本模型、图像模型、晚期融合多模态模型及多种视觉语言模型进行了零样本和微调设置下的评估，同时包括少样本上下文学习。
AI.result: 建立了强大的基线结果，突出了在具有文化背景的阿拉伯语仇恨模因检测中面临的关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集、标注指南和评估脚本将公开释放，以支持未来的阿拉伯语仇恨模因检测研究。

title: Divergence Decoding: Training-Free Capability Fusion
summary: While large language models excel in reasoning, these generalists often lack knowledge for specialized scientific domains. Conversely, domain models~(specialists), while knowledgeable, suffer from specialization side-effects including diminished logic and reduced robustness.To address this dilemma, we introduce Divergence Decoding, a training-free framework for capability fusion. It reconstructs the "draft-and-verify" skeleton of speculative decoding into an adaptive routing mechanism. The core is using Jensen-Shannon divergence to monitor the distributional disagreement between the two models at each token. When the specialist exhibits significant divergence, our method identifies it as a potential reasoning risk and instantaneously routes control to the generalist. This allows the dynamic injection of general reasoning while preserving domain expertise, achieving inference-time policy composition of the generalist and the specialist.We evaluate Divergence Decoding across diverse model families (Qwen and Llama series) on challenging scientific benchmarks (GPQA, ChemBench, and ChemCoTBench). Experimental results demonstrate that Divergence Decoding outperforms both the domain-specialized and general-purpose models, effectively surpassing the performance of most single-model baseline. This suggests that Divergence Decoding provides a general, training-free paradigm for fusing diverse LLM capabilities through adaptive inference-time collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Divergence Decoding，一种无需训练的推理时能力融合框架，通过Jensen-Shannon散度监测专家模型与通用模型在每个token上的分布差异，当专家模型出现显著分歧时动态将控制权切换给通用模型，从而实现领域专业知识与通用推理能力的自适应融合。在GPQA、ChemBench等科学基准上，该方法超越了单一领域专家模型和通用模型。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型存在"通用模型缺乏领域知识，而领域专家模型虽知识丰富但逻辑能力下降且鲁棒性减弱"的两难困境，需要一种无需训练的方法来同时兼顾两者的优势。
AI.method: 将推测解码的"草稿-验证"框架重构为自适应路由机制，利用Jensen-Shannon散度在每个token上监测专家模型与通用模型之间的分布分歧，当分歧显著时将该token视为潜在推理风险并即时将控制权切换给通用模型，实现推理时的策略组合。
AI.result: 在Qwen和Llama系列模型上，基于GPQA、ChemBench和ChemCoTBench等科学基准的评估表明，Divergence Decoding同时优于领域专家模型和通用模型，超越了大多数单模型基线。
AI.conclusion: Divergence Decoding提供了一种通用的、无需训练的范式，通过自适应的推理时协作来融合不同LLM的能力，有效解决了通用性与专业性之间的权衡问题。

title: Benchmarking LLM Competence on Logical Inference over Probability Operators
summary: Both expressions of uncertainty and inferences are ubiquitous in natural language, and valid inferences over natural-language expressions of uncertainty are necessary for not only everyday conversations but also for high-stakes domains such as medicine and law. While large language models are increasingly evaluated on logical reasoning tasks, disentangling principled, symbolic reasoning from clever surface-level pattern matching is fraught with difficulty. We introduce a benchmark for reasoning over probability operators--inference over sentences with gradable epistemic modals (e.g., probably, might, must) containing 14,320 procedurally-generated English prompts across fifteen inference templates, systematically varying question form, negation strategy, and surface content. Evaluating 29 models, we find that most show answer biases independent of the logical form, a systematic preference for Yes or No. We summarize this with a competence floor: the worse of a model's accuracy on Yes-correct and No-correct items. Only 9 of 29 models exceed random chance. We also test variations in question form, verb phrases/activity, and both the gender and origin of names used in the prompts, finding biases across every axis.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个关于概率算子推理的基准测试，包含14,320个程序化生成的英语提示和15种推理模板，评估29个大语言模型在含可分级认知情态词（如probably、might、must）的句子上的推理能力。结果显示大多数模型存在系统性答案偏差（偏向Yes或No），仅9/29个模型超过随机水平。
AI.motivation: 自然语言中不确定性的表达和推理无处不在，在医学和法律等高风险领域尤为重要。虽然大型语言模型越来越多地被评估逻辑推理任务，但区分原则性的符号推理与表面模式匹配十分困难，需要专门的基准来检验模型在概率算子上的真实推理能力。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含14,320个程序化生成的英语提示的基准测试，涵盖15种推理模板，系统性地变化问题形式、否定策略和表面内容。评估了29个模型，并引入了"能力下限"（competence floor）指标——即模型在Yes正确答案和No正确答案上的准确率中较差的那个。同时还测试了问题形式、动词短语/活动以及提示中名字的性别和来源变化。
AI.result: 大多数模型显示出与逻辑形式无关的答案偏差，即系统性偏好Yes或No。只有9/29个模型超过随机基线。在问题形式、动词短语/活动和名字的性别与来源等各个维度上都发现了偏差。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在概率算子推理上普遍表现不佳，存在系统性答案偏差而非真正的逻辑推理能力，这表明当前模型在涉及不确定性表达的逻辑推理任务上仍需显著改进。

title: PIE-APT: A Unified Framework for Temporal Planning and Contradiction Hunting via Incremental Direct-Derivation Abduction
summary: Reasoning and planning over Dynamic Knowledge Graphs (DKGs) present significant challenges, especially in open-world environments with incomplete information. Existing action formalisms often face decidability issues and the Ramification Problem, while managing incomplete knowledge via structural abduction requires expansive combinatorial search. This paper introduces a unified framework with two integrated modules---\textbf{PIE-Abducer} (incremental direct-derivation abduction) and \textbf{PIE-APT} (Abductive Planning for Temporal KGs)---operating natively on the highly expressive Description Logic. We model state transitions along a linear timeline as non-monotonic updates to deductively closed DL theories. Treating the incremental reasoner as a black-box and representing actions natively in OWL without external modal operators preserves logical decidability. To address incomplete knowledge, \textbf{PIE-Abducer} circumvents traditional Minimal Hitting Set (MHS) enumeration. Instead of combinatorial syntactic search, it injects the logical negation of a target goal into a consistent branch and extracts missing premises via direct refutation consequences. \textbf{PIE-APT} then employs a recursive \textit{Generate-and-Test} architecture, interleaving backward-chaining A* search with \textbf{PIE-Abducer} up to a bounded causal depth, followed by strict validation via forward-chaining Temporal Projection. We evaluate four OWL benchmarks stressing semantic abilities absent in classical planning: parameterized goals with witness search, mid-search DL entailment, open-world assumption injection, and adversarial contradiction hunting. Results demonstrate qualitative superiority over classical planners and prove our direct-derivation approach quantitatively outperforms an MHS-faithful baseline during abductive enrichment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的框架，包含PIE-Abducer（增量直接推导溯因）和PIE-APT（时序知识图谱上的溯因规划）两个模块，在表达力丰富的描述逻辑（DL）上原生运行，通过非单调更新建模状态转换，并采用直接反驳推演而非最小击中集枚举来处理不完整知识，实现可判定的溯因规划。
AI.motivation: 在开放世界且信息不完整的动态知识图谱（DKGs）上进行推理和规划极具挑战性。现有动作形式化方法常面临可判定性问题与"分叉问题"（Ramification Problem），而通过结构溯因管理不完整知识需要巨大的组合搜索空间。
AI.method: 框架包含两个集成模块：（1）PIE-Abducer采用增量直接推导溯因方法，将目标目标的逻辑否定注入一致分支，通过直接反驳后果提取缺失前提，规避传统的MHS枚举；（2）PIE-APT采用递归的生成-测试架构，将后向链A*搜索与PIE-Abducer交错执行至有界因果深度，再通过前向链时序投影进行严格验证。
AI.result: 在四个OWL基准上评估，覆盖参数化目标与见证搜索、搜索中DL蕴含、开放世界假设注入和对抗性矛盾检测。结果表明在语义能力上定性优于经典规划器，且直接推导方法在溯因丰富过程中定量优于MHS忠实基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过在DL中原生表示动作且不引入外部模态算子，结合黑盒增量推理器，框架在保持逻辑可判定性的同时，有效解决了动态知识图谱中的溯因规划难题。

title: VideoCoCo: Code-as-CoT for Physically-Consistent Video Generation via an Agentic Dual-Engine System
summary: Text-to-video models have achieved remarkable visual quality, yet they still struggle to generate physically consistent dynamics because the temporal evolution of a scene must be inferred implicitly from a highly compressed text prompt. Existing chain-of-thought approaches introduce intermediate plans or visual states, but these representations are typically non-executable or temporally sparse, limiting their ability to instantiate and control the complete spatiotemporal process. To address this limitation, we introduce VideoCoCo, an agentic dual-engine framework in which executable Blender code serves as a process-level chain of thought. Given a text prompt, a coding agent synthesizes a Blender program that explicitly specifies the scene and its temporal evolution. The executable simulation engine runs the program to produce a deterministic spatiotemporal draft, which is subsequently transformed into a photorealistic video by a generative video engine through draft-conditioned editing. This decomposition separates process-level reasoning from high-fidelity visual realization. To adapt the video editor to simulated drafts, we construct VideoCoCo-3K, a curated dataset of draft-instruction-target triplets. VideoCoCo improves the OmniWeaving baseline from 0.475 to 0.558 on PhyGenBench and from 52.18 to 77.88 on VBench-2.0, achieving the best average score on both benchmarks. These results demonstrate that executable code provides an effective, controllable, and inspectable intermediate representation for physically consistent video generation.

AI.tldr: VideoCoCo是一个双引擎智能体框架，通过可执行的Blender代码作为过程级思维链，将文本提示转换为显式的时空草稿，再由生成式视频引擎渲染为逼真视频，显著提升了视频生成的物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有文生视频模型虽然视觉质量出色，但难以生成物理一致的动态效果，因为场景的时间演化必须从高度压缩的文本提示中隐式推断。已有的思维链方法虽然引入中间计划或视觉状态，但这些表示通常不可执行或时间上稀疏，限制了完整时空过程的实例化和控制能力。
AI.method: VideoCoCo采用双引擎架构：编码智能体根据文本提示合成可执行的Blender程序，显式指定场景及其时间演化；模拟引擎运行程序生成确定性的时空草稿；生成式视频引擎通过草稿条件编辑将其转换为逼真视频。同时构建了VideoCoCo-3K数据集（草稿-指令-目标三元组）以适应视频编辑器。
AI.result: 在PhyGenBench上将OmniWeaving基线从0.475提升至0.558，在VBench-2.0上从52.18提升至77.88，两个基准上均取得最佳平均分数。
AI.conclusion: 可执行代码为物理一致的视频生成提供了有效、可控且可检查的中间表示，将过程级推理与高保真视觉实现相分离是提升物理一致性视频生成的关键。

title: PAUSE: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personal AI Assistants in Unified Service Environments
summary: Personal AI assistants are increasingly deployed as task-oriented, tool-augmented agents that operate within unified service environments to support everyday user activities. In realistic settings, such assistants must reason over persistent user state, respect user-specific configurations and permissions, and sustain long-horizon, constraint-aware interactions across multiple services. Existing benchmarks, however, often fragment service contexts or abstract away user state, limiting their ability to evaluate user-centric personal assistant behavior in realistic service settings. We introduce PAUSE, a user-centric benchmark for evaluating personal AI assistants in stateful, service-integrated environments. PAUSE captures core challenges of real-world assistant deployment by requiring agents to coordinate actions across heterogeneous user-owned resources while maintaining consistency with environment state, authorization constraints over multi-turn interactions. The benchmark incorporates explicit user-agent interaction via realistic user simulation, enabling evaluation beyond static tool execution. To support principled and reproducible evaluation, PAUSE adopts a multi-regime evaluation framework aligned with task characteristics. Open-ended service management tasks are assessed using semantic and trajectory-level behavioral metrics, while constraint-intensive tasks admit deterministic, state-based verification. Benchmark results show that even state-of-the-art proprietary models fail to reach 70% task completion on scenarios requiring stateful reasoning and configuration awareness, revealing consistent and interpretable failure patterns. Finally, we present a user-centric synthesis pipeline that enables scalable generation of coherent service environments, user configurations, and reliably annotated tasks, supporting benchmark extensibility and future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAUSE，一个以用户为中心的基准测试，用于评估个人AI助手在状态化、多服务集成环境中的表现，涵盖持久用户状态、授权约束和长时程交互等核心挑战。实验表明即使最先进的大模型在需要状态推理和配置感知的任务上完成率也低于70%，并揭示了可解释的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试往往将服务上下文碎片化或抽象掉用户状态，无法真实评估个人AI助手在现实服务场景中的用户中心化行为表现，缺乏对持久状态、用户配置和权限约束的综合评测。
AI.method: PAUSE采用多模态评估框架：开放式的服务管理任务使用语义和轨迹级行为指标评估，约束密集型任务则使用确定性的基于状态的验证；通过真实用户模拟实现显式的用户-智能体交互；并提出用户中心的合成数据生成管线以扩展基准的可扩展性。
AI.result: 即使最先进的专有模型在需要状态推理和配置感知的场景下任务完成率也无法达到70%，且表现出一致且可解释的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: PAUSE为个人AI助手在状态化、服务集成环境中的评估提供了系统化框架，其合成数据生成管线支持基准的持续扩展和未来研究，填补了现有评估体系在用户中心助手研究方面的空白。

title: SkillSmith: Learning to Compose Parametric Skills and Textual Knowledge
summary: Agentic systems driven by large language models (LLMs) regularly feature two key mechanisms to autonomously solve complex problems: synthesizing text-based knowledge and procedures from past experiences and building parametric (weight-space) skill libraries for recurring sub-goals. To date, research has largely treated these as orthogonal pursuits: either organizing textual knowledge through composition and reflection, or consolidating parametric skills via weight-space merging. Consequently, the seamless integration of text and model weights for targeted performance improvements remains largely unexplored. This work bridges this modality gap by treating model weights as an additional modality that an LLM can natively reason over. We instantiate parametric learning via prefix-tuning and augment an LLM to ingest both prefix weights and rich textual data which capture relationships to a target capability. Our augmented LLM, which we call SkillSmith, synthesizes these inputs to perform instruction-steered parametric synthesis, directly outputting new prefix weights that manifest the target skill. We demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms both text-only and weight-space-only baselines, unlocking performance gains that are out of reach for uni-modal (text-only or weight-only) adaptations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillSmith框架，将模型权重视为LLM可以原生推理的额外模态，通过前缀微调实现文本知识与参数技能的跨模态整合，从而生成新的参数权重以展现目标技能，性能优于纯文本或纯权重方法。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统通常将文本知识合成与参数技能库构建视为正交的两条研究路线，缺乏将文本和模型权重无缝整合以针对性提升性能的探索。
AI.method: 将模型权重视为额外模态，通过前缀微调实例化参数学习，增强LLM使其能同时摄入前缀权重和丰富的文本数据（捕获与目标能力的关系），从而进行指令引导的参数合成，直接输出体现目标技能的新前缀权重。
AI.result: SkillSmith显著优于纯文本和纯权重空间的基线方法，能够解锁单模态（纯文本或纯权重）适应无法企及的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 文本知识和模型权重可以作为互补模态被统一整合，跨模态的参数合成是实现目标技能提升的有效途径。

title: SkillMentor: LLM Agent Self-Evolution via Learning Blind-Spot Diagnosis
summary: Agent self-evolution has primarily focused on learning how to act, while overlooking an equally important capability: learning to discover what an agent does not know. Existing approaches typically assume that failure discovery is given, focusing on how to repair failures once they are identified. We ask whether blind-spot diagnosis itself can be learned. We thus study diagnosis as an agent capability separate from execution, and exclude two alternative sources of progress: executor adaptation and human supervision. Under these constraints, performance cannot improve through executor updates or annotated examples, forcing all improvements to originate from the learned diagnostic capability. We propose SkillMentor, which trains a Mentor policy via reinforcement learning to generate diagnostic tasks, identify recurrent failure modes, and curate them into reusable corrective skills. Across AppWorld and BFCLv3, SkillMentor improves executor performance by an average of 44.2%. These results suggest that blind-spot diagnosis is a learnable capability, enabling self-evolution without updating executor weights or relying on human-curated data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillMentor框架，将"盲点诊断"作为智能体独立于执行的可学习能力，通过强化学习训练Mentor策略来生成诊断任务、识别失败模式并策展为可复用的纠错技能，在不更新执行器权重或依赖人工标注的情况下，使执行器在AppWorld和BFCLv3上平均提升44.2%的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体自我进化研究主要关注"如何行动"，忽视了"发现自身不知道什么"这一同等重要的能力。传统方法假设失败发现是给定的，只关注识别失败后的修复，而本文提出盲点诊断本身可以被学习。
AI.method: 提出SkillMentor框架，将诊断与执行分离为独立能力。通过强化学习训练Mentor策略，使其能够生成诊断任务、识别反复出现的失败模式，并将这些模式策展为可复用的纠错技能。实验设计中排除了执行器适应和人类监督两条替代进步来源，确保所有改进都来源于学到的诊断能力。
AI.result: 在AppWorld和BFCLv3两个基准上，SkillMentor使执行器性能平均提升44.2%。结果表明盲点诊断是可学习的能力。
AI.conclusion: 盲点诊断是智能体可学习的能力，通过纯诊断能力的提升即可实现自我进化，无需更新执行器权重或依赖人工策展数据，为智能体自我进化开辟了新路径。

title: Models for minimalist RAG: B1ade 335M Embedding and 1B Parameter Small Language Models
summary: Language and embedding models used in RAG systems are conventionally assumed to require large-scale pretraining and explicit grounding supervision. We present B1ade, an efficient RAG architecture comprising two purpose-built components: a compact embedding model and a purpose-built SLM. B1ade-embed, a 335M parameter retrieval model constructed via parameter-free fusion of five pretrained encoders achieves top MTEB scores among sub-500M models with zero additional training, and B1ade-1B, an SLM trained on low-cost GPUs using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on 723M tokens (2.2M examples) of curated context-question pairs with rewards that optimize only answer similarity. Our central finding is emergent attribution: despite receiving no explicit supervision for source citation, B1ade-1B cites retrieved passages in 42.4% of responses, exceeding the attribution rate of its training distribution by 5.5 percentage points. This demonstrates that grounding behavior can emerge as an accuracy-maximizing strategy under RL training, without explicit reward engineering. On standard QA benchmarks, B1ade-1B achieves 81.82% on PopQA, 65.8% on PubMedQA, and 51.09% on FEVER. In end-to-end RAG evaluation, B1ade-1B achieves an average score of 0.654 across correctness, completeness, coherence, and faithfulness, a 10.8% improvement over the SFT, while closing the gap with models 1.5x its size. These results show that strategic model composition and reward design suffice for resource-efficient RAG, without large-scale pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出B1ade，一种高效的RAG架构，由335M参数的嵌入模型（融合五个预训练编码器，零额外训练即达顶尖MTEB分数）和1B参数的SLM（通过GRPO在723M token上训练）组成。核心发现是"涌现式归因"：尽管没有显式引用监督，模型在42.4%的回复中自动引用检索段落。在多个QA基准上表现优异，端到端RAG评估比SFT提升10.8%。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG系统假设需要大规模预训练和显式接地监督，本研究旨在挑战这一假设，探索通过策略性的模型组合和奖励设计实现资源高效RAG的可能性。
AI.method: B1ade由两个组件构成：B1ade-embed（335M参数，通过五个预训练编码器的参数无关融合构建，零额外训练）和B1ade-1B（在低成本GPU上使用GRPO训练，2.2M个上下文-问题对），奖励仅优化答案相似度，不包含任何引用监督。
AI.result: B1ade-1B在PopQA达81.82%、PubMedQA达65.8%、FEVER达51.09%。端到端RAG评估平均0.654分，比SFT提升10.8%，接近1.5倍规模模型的性能。归因率42.4%，超出训练分布5.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明策略性模型组合和奖励设计足以实现资源高效的RAG，无需大规模预训练。接地行为可以在RL训练下作为精度最大化策略自然涌现，无需显式奖励工程。

title: ProgFormer: Hierarchical Voxel Diffusion Transformer for Longitudinal Brain MRI Prediction
summary: Predicting future structural MRI of a brain is challenging because longitudinal changes are often subtle and confined to specific anatomical regions, while most subject-specific brain structure remains stable over time. An effective model should therefore preserve global brain structural consistency while remaining sensitive to fine-grained disease progression. Existing latent-space-based methods improve computational efficiency, but suffer from information loss during their compression-reconstruction procedure. In contrast, direct voxel-space methods avoid latent reconstruction but commonly use a unified prediction pathway to model brain structure and progression-related changes. Subtle local changes may therefore be overshadowed by the dominant stable brain structure. To address these challenges, we propose ProgFormer, a hierarchical voxel-space Diffusion Transformer for longitudinal brain MRI prediction. ProgFormer uses a coarse pathway to perform the primary volumetric prediction from 3D patch tokens. This pathway models overall brain structure and longitudinal context. The fine pathway then uses the coarse representations as spatio-temporal grounding for voxel-level refinement within individual patches. The two pathways jointly estimate a velocity field directly in voxel space through conditional flow matching, enabling end-to-end prediction without a separately learned image autoencoder. The predicted future scan is then generated from Gaussian noise by integrating the estimated velocity field over a sequence of Euler steps. Extensive experimental results on three widely used benchmarks, ADNI, AIBL, and OASIS, under both pairwise and trajectory settings demonstrate favourable performance compared against several state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProgFormer，一种层级式体素空间扩散Transformer，用于纵向脑MRI预测。该方法通过粗路径进行整体体积预测，细路径进行体素级细化，并通过条件流匹配在体素空间直接估计速度场，避免潜在空间重建带来的信息损失，在三个基准数据集上表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在空间方法在压缩-重建过程中存在信息损失，而直接体素空间方法使用统一预测路径，导致细微的局部疾病进展变化被主导性的稳定脑结构所掩盖。需要一个既能保持全局脑结构一致性又能敏感捕捉细微进展变化的模型。
AI.method: ProgFormer包含两条路径：粗路径从3D patch tokens中进行主要体积预测，建模整体脑结构和纵向上下文；细路径利用粗表示作为时空引导，在单个patch内进行体素级细化。两条路径在体素空间通过条件流匹配联合估计速度场，无需单独的图像自编码器，通过Euler步骤从高斯噪声生成预测的未来扫描。
AI.result: 在ADNI、AIBL和OASIS三个广泛使用的基准数据集上，在pairwise和trajectory两种设置下的实验结果表明，ProgFormer在性能上优于多种最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: ProgFormer通过层级式粗-细双路径设计，在体素空间中直接进行预测，有效解决了现有方法中信息损失和细微变化被掩盖的问题，在纵向脑MRI预测任务上取得了优越性能。

title: Beyond the Bidirectional Promise: Re-evaluating the Robustness of Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive (AR) generation by enabling bidirectional context and iterative refinement. However, their reliability under natural input noise and adversarial attacks remains under-explored. To address this, we systematically evaluate DLM robustness and calibration against AR baselines, using two parameter-matched pairs (LLaDA-8B vs. LLaMA-3-8B and Dream-7B vs. Qwen2.5-7B) across 32 natural perturbation conditions, adversarial gradient probes, and mechanistic hidden-state analyses. This paired design effectively isolates architecture-intrinsic properties from weight-dependent behaviors. We find a nuanced robustness profile: while highly stochastic DLM loss landscapes naturally resist gradient-based adversarial suffixes, they provide no guaranteed defense against natural noise, proving that everyday robustness is weight-dependent rather than inherently architectural. Furthermore, DLMs exhibit systematic overconfidence, presenting a practical deployment hazard. Most crucially, mechanistic probing reveals that all models perfectly encode input corruption, isolating behavioral fragility entirely to a decoder routing failure. Consistent with this diagnosis, we show that surface-level prompt patching fails to improve over noisy baselines. Ultimately, DLM robustness cannot be patched on; it must be fundamentally integrated into the iterative decoding loop.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了扩散语言模型（DLMs）相对于自回归（AR）模型的鲁棒性和校准性能，使用两组参数匹配的模型对（LLaDA-8B vs LLaMA-3-8B 和 Dream-7B vs Qwen2.5-7B），在32种自然扰动条件、对抗梯度探针和机制性隐藏状态分析下进行测试。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型提供了双向上下文和迭代精炼的优势，但其在自然输入噪声和对抗攻击下的可靠性尚未被充分探索。作者旨在填补这一空白，系统地评估DLM在鲁棒性和校准方面与AR基线的差异。
AI.method: 采用参数匹配的配对设计（LLaDA-8B vs LLaMA-3-8B 和 Dream-7B vs Qwen2.5-7B），通过32种自然扰动条件、对抗梯度探针和机制性隐藏状态分析，有效隔离了架构固有属性与权重相关行为的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现：DLM高度随机的损失景观天然抵抗基于梯度的对抗后缀，但对自然噪声没有保证性防御，表明日常鲁棒性是权重相关的而非架构固有的。DLM表现出系统性的过度自信，构成实际部署风险。机制性探针揭示所有模型都能完美编码输入损坏，行为脆弱性完全源于解码器路由失败。表面提示修补无法改善有噪声的基线。
AI.conclusion: DLM的鲁棒性无法通过表面修补获得，必须从根本上集成到迭代解码循环中。

title: Drawing-Recode: Annotation Grounding for Parametric CAD Code Generation from Raster 2D CAD Drawings
summary: Recovering Parametric CAD sequences from raster-format 2D Computer-Aided Design (CAD) drawings accumulated prior to digital transformation is important for part reproduction and manufacturing process automation. However, existing studies either process only vector drawings or are limited to specific domains, and fail to explicitly connect dimensional annotations to geometric information, limiting their use of dimensional information for 3D Parametric CAD sequences recovery. We propose Drawing-Recode, a framework that generates Parametric CAD sequences as CAD code from raster 2D CAD drawings. Drawing-Recode extracts geometric features via an image encoder and recognizes annotations through a separate text recognition module, then explicitly grounds annotations to geometric information using cross-attention and our proposed Annotation Grounding Loss (AGL). The resulting features are fed into a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate CAD code in the Structured Parametric CAD Code (SPCC) format. Experiments show that Drawing-Recode outperforms existing baselines and remains robust on scanned drawings resembling industrial conditions. We expect Drawing-Recode contributes to digitizing raster 2D CAD drawings in industrial settings and to part reproduction and manufacturing automation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Drawing-Recode框架，从光栅格式的2D CAD图纸中恢复参数化CAD序列（生成CAD代码），通过图像编码器提取几何特征、文本识别模块识别标注，并利用交叉注意力与标注接地损失（AGL）将标注显式关联到几何信息，最后通过大语言模型生成结构化参数化CAD代码（SPCC）。实验表明该方法优于现有基线，且在工业扫描图纸上表现稳健。
AI.motivation: 数字化转型前积累的大量光栅格式2D CAD图纸需要恢复为参数化CAD序列以支持零件复制和制造自动化。现有研究要么仅处理矢量图纸，要么局限于特定领域，且未能将尺寸标注与几何信息显式关联，限制了尺寸信息在3D参数化CAD序列恢复中的应用。
AI.method: Drawing-Recode框架包含三个核心部分：(1) 通过图像编码器提取几何特征；(2) 通过独立的文本识别模块识别尺寸标注；(3) 利用交叉注意力机制和提出的标注接地损失（AGL）将标注显式接地到几何信息上。融合后的特征输入大语言模型（LLM），生成SPCC格式的参数化CAD代码。
AI.result: 实验表明Drawing-Recode在恢复参数化CAD序列方面优于现有基线，并且在模拟工业条件的扫描图纸上仍保持稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: Drawing-Recode有望促进工业场景中光栅2D CAD图纸的数字化，为零件复制和制造自动化做出贡献。

title: Bridging Inference-Time Scaling and Episodic Memory with Action-Centric Graphs
summary: Recent advancements in inference-time scaling have significantly unlocked the complex reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models~(LLMs). However, for agents, these approaches suffer from a critical inefficiency, operating in a stateless manner and engaging in redundant search processes. Existing memory mechanisms largely rely on the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, leading to prohibitive computational costs. In this paper, we propose a novel framework, \textit{GAMER}~(Graph-based Action-centric Memory with Episodic Reasoning), that bridges the gap between inference scaling and episodic memory. Our approach models historical reasoning as a dynamic \textit{Action-Centric Graph}. By decoupling the memory mechanism from LLMs, our method can save token/money usage by providing less memory context than memory mechanism baselines. To extract knowledge from the graph effectively, we use a dual-stream Temporal Difference learning mechanism to estimate the positive~(suggestion) and negative~(avoidance) value of action nodes based on past successes and failures. During the inference phase, this learned value function optimizes decision-making bi-directionally, so that positive values provide action suggestions, while negative values indicate high-risk actions. By performing efficient searches on the graph, our method significantly improves the efficiency of inference scaling. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that \textit{GAMER} achieves superior performance by \textbf{20.81\%/6.17\%} for success/progress rate compared to vanilla baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAMER框架，通过构建动态的"以动作为中心的图"将历史推理建模为情节记忆，并利用双流时序差分学习估计动作节点的正负价值，在推理阶段进行双向优化决策，从而在不依赖LLM推理能力的情况下实现高效的推理时扩展，相比基线在成功率上提升20.81%，进度率提升6.17%。
AI.motivation: 现有的推理时扩展方法以无状态方式运行，在智能体任务中存在冗余搜索的关键低效问题；现有的记忆机制高度依赖LLM的推理能力，导致计算成本过高，亟需一种能够将推理扩展与情节记忆有效桥接的高效方案。
AI.method: 提出GAMER框架，将历史推理建模为动态的Action-Centric Graph（以动作为中心的图），将记忆机制与LLM解耦以节省token/金钱开销；采用双流时序差分（TD）学习机制，基于过去成功和失败来估计动作节点的正向（建议）与负向（规避）价值；推理阶段通过学到的价值函数进行双向优化，在图上进行高效搜索以提升推理扩展效率。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，相比vanilla基线，GAMER的成功率提升20.81%，进度率提升6.17%，同时在memory context消耗上优于记忆机制基线。
AI.conclusion: GAMER通过将推理过程图结构化并解耦记忆与LLM，有效解决了推理时扩展在智能体场景中的效率瓶颈，为推理扩展与情节记忆的结合提供了新的方向。

title: Training Skills Like Parameters via Self-Supervised Semantic Diffusion
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable general instruction-following capabilities, they often fall short of human experts in highly specialized, open-ended domains such as creative screenwriting. Prior approaches typically adopt post-training, yet both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning require weight access that closed-source frontier models do not offer, and demand heavy compute. Moreover, what is learned is tied to a single checkpoint and cannot be inspected by humans. Recent advancements in agentic continual learning instead attempt to bridge this gap by accumulating external textual skills. However, these methods heavily rely on costly human expert annotations or unreliable LLM-as-a-judge feedback for reflection. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose a novel, unsupervised self-evolving agent framework inspired by the corruption-and-reconstruction paradigm of diffusion models. Instead of relying on explicit external scoring, we leverage existing high-quality human artifacts to construct self-supervised signals. Training then follows the familiar loop of neural network training, forward, loss, and backward, with the loss coming from contrasting the agent's reconstruction against the human original. What is updated is not model weights but an external library of textual skills. We evaluate our framework on the challenging task of short drama screenwriting. Experimental results demonstrate that our method enables the agent to autonomously extract and internalize highly generalizable skills, significantly enhancing its domain-specific generation capabilities. Furthermore, this self-contrastive reflection paradigm offers a scalable pathway for agents to teach themselves the production of complex, high-quality human artifacts, without requiring external supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出一个无监督的自进化智能体框架，借鉴扩散模型的"损坏-重建"范式，利用高质量人类作品构建自监督信号，通过对比智能体重建与人类原作的差异来更新外部文本技能库（而非模型权重），从而提升LLM在创意编剧等专业领域的能力。
AI.motivation: LLM在通用指令遵循方面表现出色，但在创意编剧等高度专业化、开放式领域难以达到人类专家水平。现有方法依赖后训练（需要权重访问和大量计算）、人类专家标注或不可靠的LLM裁判反馈，存在成本高、可解释性差等问题。
AI.method: 提出无监督的自进化智能体框架，受扩散模型"损坏-重建"范式启发：利用现有高质量人类作品构造自监督信号，训练循环（前向、损失、反向）中的损失来自对比智能体重建与人类原作；更新的不是模型权重，而是外部文本技能库。
AI.result: 在短剧编剧这一挑战性任务上的实验表明，该方法使智能体能够自主提取并内化高度可泛化的技能，显著提升了领域特定的生成能力。
AI.conclusion: 这种自对比反思范式为智能体在无需外部监督的情况下自我教授复杂、高质量人类作品的生产提供了一条可扩展的途径。

title: Dimensionality and Measurement Precision in HLE's Multiple-Choice Subset
summary: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) is widely used to evaluate frontier language models. HLE organizes its questions into eight subject-domain categories, whose subscores are often interpreted as evidence of distinct capabilities. However, no study has assessed whether these labels correspond to empirically separable latent constructs, nor whether the benchmark effectively differentiates between models of similar ability. We evaluate 29 LLMs on the text-only multiple-choice subset of HLE ($J = 428$ items) and apply psychometric methods to assess both the dimensionality of the benchmark and the distribution of its measurement precision. Fitting a two-parameter logistic IRT model, we find convergent evidence that HLE measures a single general reasoning factor: McDonald's $ω_h = 0.998$, domain labels explain only 3.5\% of item response variance, within- and between-domain residual correlations are nearly identical (Cohen's $d = 0.016$), and domain-specific ability estimates are near-redundant with the total score ($r \geq 0.81$). A separate analysis of the test information function reveals that measurement precision concentrates at moderate ability levels and drops sharply above $θ= 0$, where frontier models sit. These findings suggest that HLE's domain subscores do not warrant distinct capability interpretations and that the benchmark's ability to discriminate among the strongest models is limited.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用心理测量学方法（IRT模型）对HLE基准测试的428道选择题进行分析，发现HLE实际测量的是一般推理能力（ωh=0.998），其领域子标签不构成独立的潜在构念（仅解释3.5%的方差），且测量精度集中在中等能力水平，对顶尖模型的区分能力有限。
AI.motivation: HLE基准测试的八个学科领域分类常被解读为模型不同能力的证据，但目前缺乏实证研究验证这些标签是否对应可分离的潜在构念，也缺乏对基准区分相似能力模型效果的检验。
AI.method: 对29个LLM在HLE文本多选子集（428题）上的表现，拟合两参数逻辑斯蒂克（2PL）IRT模型，综合运用McDonald's ωh、域标签方差解释率、域内/域间残差相关对比（Cohen's d）及域特定能力估计与总分相关性等指标评估维度性，并分析测试信息函数考察测量精度分布。
AI.result: HLE测的是单一一般推理因子（ωh=0.998）；领域标签仅解释3.5%的条目响应方差；域内与域间残差相关几乎相同（d=0.016）；域特定能力估计与总分高度冗余（r≥0.81）；测量精度集中于中等能力水平，在θ>0处急剧下降（前沿模型所在区域）。
AI.conclusion: HLE的领域子分数不支持独立能力解释，其测量精度随能力提升快速衰减，导致对最强模型之间的区分能力存在局限。研究者应对领域子分数谨慎解读，并需开发更适当前沿模型的评测工具。

title: Beyond Similarity: Grounded Agentic Extraction and Expert-Adjudicated Evaluation of Intertextuality in Classical Chinese Histories
summary: Computational approaches to intertextuality have advanced from string matching to neural retrieval, yet their outputs, similarity scores and parallel-passage lists, identify where texts reuse one another without characterizing how or why. We recast fine-grained intertextuality extraction as an agentic task in which a large language model (LLM) reads two text units in full and, through a constrained tool interface, must ground each proposed reuse in exact character spans on both sides and label it under a five-dimension typology of reuse (form, aspect, source-marking, function, stance). We validate the approach on an exhaustive comparison of the Analects with the Book of Han, where three domain experts adjudicate a pooled multi-model candidate set into a benchmark of 2,533 intertextual pairs. Against this standard we study twelve LLMs, reporting precision (56%-93%), a 51$\times$ cost spread at comparable quality, and how well their confidence is calibrated. Expert agreement traces a reliability gradient: dimensions legible on the textual surface are annotated consistently, while those requiring inference of intent are contested, delimiting the claims such annotation supports. Scaling the validated extractor to the full Twenty-Four Histories (65,380 comparisons, 5,766 pairs) recovers corpus-level structure a similarity score cannot express. The interpretive composition of citation shows no systematic change across eighteen centuries, yet the same passage is quoted less and less literally. Stability in the aggregate with drift in the individual case is what a cultural-attraction account expects. We release the extraction protocol and the expert-adjudicated benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将细粒度互文性提取重构为智能体任务：LLM通过受限工具接口，将文本复用精确锚定到字符跨度，并用五维类型标注。在《论语》与《汉书》的专家裁决基准（2,533对）上验证了12个LLM，随后扩展到二十四史（65,380次比较，5,766对），发现引用构成跨世纪稳定但字面引用逐渐减小。
AI.motivation: 现有计算互文性方法（字符串匹配、神经检索）只能识别文本复用的位置（相似度分数和并行段落列表），无法刻画复用的方式和原因。作者希望超越"哪里复用"，回答"如何复用、为何复用"的问题。
AI.method: 将互文性提取重构为agentic任务：LLM完整阅读两个文本单元，通过受限工具接口将每次复用精确锚定在双方的确切字符跨度上，并按五维类型学标注（形式、方面、来源标记、功能、立场）。三位领域专家裁决多模型候选集构建基准，随后将验证过的提取器扩展到二十四史全量数据。
AI.result: 在12个LLM上报告精确率56%-93%，同等质量下成本相差51倍。专家一致性呈可靠性梯度：文本表面可读维度标注一致，需推断意图的维度有争议。扩展到二十四史后恢复相似度分数无法表达的语料库级结构：引用构成在十八个世纪中无系统性变化，但同一段落的引用越来越不字面化。
AI.conclusion: 聚合层面稳定、个体案例漂移的现象符合文化吸引（cultural attraction）理论预期。作者发布提取协议和专家裁决基准以供后续研究使用。

title: Leveraging Trajectory Graphs for Pre-Execution Error Diagnosis in Agentic LLM Systems
summary: Large Language Model~(LLM)-based agents have demonstrated exceptional performance across a wide range of complex interactive tasks. However, they often struggle with long-horizon interactive tasks common in domains, such as embodied AI. The complexity and vast action spaces in these settings lead to compounding errors, where a single suboptimal action can derail an entire trajectory, causing the agent to exhaust its limited step budget on inefficient or unrecoverable paths. To overcome this without costly fine-tuning, we draw inspiration from software debugging, where execution logs are analyzed to preemptively catch errors. We propose \textit{Trajectory Graph Copilot}, a novel framework that acts as a ``copilot'' for LLM agents by diagnosing potential action errors before they are executed. At its core,\textit{Graph Debugger} models historical trajectories as a probabilistic graph and uses a Graph Neural Network to identify sequential action patterns that frequently lead to failure. Functioning as a proactive diagnostic sandbox, our method provides early warnings on potentially flawed actions, prompting the agent to self-correct. This pre-action error diagnosis prevents costly mistakes, significantly enhancing the agent's ability to complete long-horizon tasks successfully. The extensive experiments on four benchmarks with three LLM agents demonstrate a $14.69\%$ pass ratio improvement on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Trajectory Graph Copilot框架，通过图神经网络对历史轨迹建模为概率图，在动作执行前诊断潜在错误，作为LLM智能体的"副驾驶"帮助其在长时程交互任务中提前自我纠正，平均提升14.69%的通过率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长时程交互任务（如具身AI）中常因单一次优动作导致级联错误，耗尽有限的步数预算而无法完成任务。现有方法依赖昂贵的微调，因此需要一种无需微调的轻量级错误预防机制。
AI.method: 提出Trajectory Graph Copilot框架，核心组件为Graph Debugger：将历史轨迹建模为概率图，利用图神经网络识别频繁导致失败的序列动作模式；在执行前作为主动诊断沙箱提供早期错误预警，促使智能体自我纠正。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试上使用三种LLM智能体进行广泛实验，平均通过率提升14.69%。
AI.conclusion: 通过执行前的错误诊断而非事后修复，可以有效防止代价高昂的错误，显著增强LLM智能体完成长时程任务的能力，且无需昂贵的微调开销。

title: AWARE-FX: An Auditable Knowledge-Guided AI System for Measuring Corporate Foreign-Exchange Hedging Disclosure
comment: 40 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Preprint; not peer reviewed
summary: Corporate annual reports contain weakly structured evidence about foreign-exchange risk management, derivative use, natural hedging, and explicit non-use. This study develops AWARE-FX, an auditable AI/NLP decision-support system that converts report text into traceable firm-year hedging-disclosure measures. The system combines a professional-source lexicon, negation and accounting-status logic, channel-specific financial encoders, exact evidence gates, conservative aggregation, and an audit ledger. Across 24,909 Hong Kong firm-years from 2008-2025, it retrieves and scores 543,527 snippets. Reliability is evaluated through ablations, a stratified 300-snippet human audit, three-seed FinBERT-ModernBERT comparisons, strict 2023-2025 temporal tests, probability calibration, selective prediction, and fixed-prompt generative-model benchmarks. FinBERT has the higher mean F1 in seven of eight encoder task-split comparisons; its temporal F1 ranges from 0.702 to 0.872. Abstaining on the 20% least-confident temporal observations raises retained-sample F1 by 0.050-0.077. Deterministic Qwen3-8B performs strongly on commodity and negation evidence but poorly on foreign-debt and accounting-context labels, showing that a general-purpose LLM does not uniformly replace domain constraints. The strict FX score is negatively associated with linked baseline and stress-period FX exposure, whereas the generic broad score is not. These associations provide external construct validation, not causal estimates of hedging effectiveness. AWARE-FX contributes a tested decision-support architecture in which retrieval, status logic, classification, uncertainty handling, aggregation, and external validation remain separately auditable.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了AWARE-FX，一个可审计的AI/NLP决策支持系统，用于从企业年报中提取外汇风险管理和对冲披露度量，并在24,909个香港企业年度样本上进行了严格验证。
AI.motivation: 企业年报中的外汇风险管理和对冲披露信息是非结构化且弱结构的，缺乏可追溯的量化度量工具，亟需一个可审计的系统将这些文本转化为可靠的企业-年度对冲披露指标。
AI.method: AWARE-FX结合了专业来源词典、否定与会计状态逻辑、渠道特定金融编码器、精确证据门控、保守聚合和审计账本；使用FinBERT和ModernBERT进行编码器比较，Qwen3-8B作为生成式基线，并通过消融实验、人工审计、时间测试等多种方式进行可靠性评估。
AI.result: 在24,909个香港企业年度中检索评分了543,527个文本片段。FinBERT在八个编码器任务对比中七次取得更高平均F1，时间F1范围为0.702-0.872；对20%最低置信度样本弃权使F1提升0.050-0.077。严格FX分数与基线和压力期FX敞口负相关，而通用宽泛分数则无此关联。
AI.conclusion: AWARE-FX提供了检索、状态逻辑、分类、不确定性处理、聚合和外部验证均可分别审计的决策支持架构，且严格的对冲披露度量具有外部建构效度，但结果仅代表关联而非因果估计。

title: ZMIS-SAM: Segment Anything Model Enhanced with Wavelet Transform for Zooplankton Microscopy Image Instance Segmentation
summary: As primary consumers in the marine food chain, zooplankton play a crucial role in maintaining marine ecological balance. However, the Segment Anything Model (SAM) exhibits limited performance in microscopic image instance segmentation due to its lack of zooplankton-specific domain knowledge. To address these challenges, we propose a novel instance segmentation model based on SAM and wavelet transform (ZMIS-SAM), effectively tackling issues such as inaccurate classification, discontinuous segmentation of slender appendages, and incomplete boundary segmentation. Our framework incorporates three core innovations: ZM-ViT enhances SAM's capability to model zooplankton morphology and image intensity distributions through two lightweight adapters, the Neighboring Feature Aggregation Module (NFAM) improves continuous segmentation of semi-transparent slender appendages by integrating general-purpose and domain-specific features, and the Wavelet-based Multi-scale Multi-directional Feature Enhancement (WM2FE) module effectively recovers high-frequency details to refine boundary segmentation completeness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ZMIS-SAM achieves state-of-the-art instance segmentation performance on the zooplankton dataset and exhibits strong generalization capability across multiple public cross-domain datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ZMIS-SAM，一种基于SAM和小波变换的浮游动物实例分割模型，通过三个核心创新模块（ZM-ViT、NFAM、WM2FE）解决了SAM在浮游动物显微图像分割中的分类不准确、细长附肢分割不连续和边界不完整等问题，在浮游动物数据集上达到最优性能并展现出强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 浮游动物作为海洋食物链中的初级消费者对维持海洋生态平衡至关重要，但SAM模型因缺乏浮游动物领域的专门知识，在显微图像的实例分割任务中表现有限，存在分类不准确、细长附肢分割不连续及边界分割不完整等问题。
AI.method: 提出基于SAM和小波变换的浮游动物实例分割模型ZMIS-SAM，包含三个核心创新模块：ZM-ViT通过两个轻量适配器增强SAM对浮游动物形态和图像强度分布的建模能力；NFAM通过整合通用特征和领域特定特征改进半透明细长附肢的连续分割；WM2FE模块利用小波变换恢复高频细节以完善边界分割。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ZMIS-SAM在浮游动物数据集上达到了最先进的实例分割性能，并在多个公开跨域数据集上展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该模型通过引入领域特定知识和多尺度多方向特征增强，有效提升了SAM在浮游动物显微图像实例分割任务中的表现，为解决相似领域自适应分割问题提供了可行方案。

title: DualAnchor: Preserving Language Priors and Improving Lexical Fidelity in Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led sign language translation (SLT), the task of converting sign-language videos into spoken-language text, to increasingly adopt LLMs as textual backbones. However, despite their strong language modeling capabilities, existing LLM-based SLT methods often undermine rather than exploit this language prior, producing disfluent translations, a failure we term language-prior degradation. Meanwhile, existing methods typically align videos and text at the sentence level, which does not ensure accurate lexical details and creates a lexical fidelity gap. To address both issues, we propose DualAnchor, a gloss-free LLM-based SLT training framework that couples two complementary anchors for linguistically fluent and visually faithful generation. Token-level Prior Anchoring (TPA) preserves the LLM's language prior by regularizing the multimodal decoder at each decoding step toward the next-token distribution of a frozen LLM conditioned on the same autoregressive prefix. Optimal Transport Alignment (OTA) improves lexical fidelity by formulating visual-textual matching as entropy-regularized partial optimal transport, with Sinkhorn optimization inducing a soft alignment between visual tokens and textual content tokens under a cosine cost. DualAnchor achieves strong overall performance on both PHOENIX-2014T and CSL-Daily. Targeted analyses attribute these gains to the complementary effects of the two anchors: TPA improves fluency, whereas OTA reduces fine-grained lexical errors.

AI.tldr: DualAnchor是一个无gloss的基于LLM的手语翻译训练框架，通过Token级先验锚定（TPA）和最优传输对齐（OTA）两个互补锚点，分别解决LLM语言先验退化导致的不流畅翻译问题和句子级对齐导致的词汇保真度不足问题，在PHOENIX-2014T和CSL-Daily数据集上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的手语翻译方法存在两个核心问题：一是语言先验退化——尽管LLM具备强大的语言建模能力，但现有方法未能充分利用甚至损害了这一先验，导致翻译不流畅；二是词汇保真度缺口——现有方法在句子级别对齐视频和文本，无法确保词汇级别的精确匹配。
AI.method: 提出DualAnchor框架，包含两个互补锚点：(1) Token级先验锚定（TPA）——在每一步解码时通过将多模态解码器的输出分布向冻结LLM在相同自回归前缀条件下的下一token分布进行正则化，以保留LLM的语言先验；(2) 最优传输对齐（OTA）——将视觉-文本匹配建模为带熵正则化的部分最优传输问题，通过Sinkhorn优化在余弦代价下实现视觉token与文本内容token之间的软对齐，提升词汇保真度。
AI.result: DualAnchor在PHOENIX-2014T和CSL-Daily两个基准数据集上均取得了强整体性能。针对性分析表明，TPA提升了翻译流畅性，而OTA减少了细粒度的词汇错误，两个锚点发挥互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语言先验锚定和最优传输对齐两个互补机制相结合，DualAnchor能够同时实现语言流畅和视觉忠实的手语翻译，验证了在LLM-based SLT框架中同时关注语言流畅性和词汇保真度的有效性。

title: MeshFM: 2D Features Are All You Need for 3D Shape Understanding
summary: We present MeshFM, an efficient feedforward framework for extracting rich features from 3D inputs. Our method distills 2D features from visual foundation models into 3D. We train a feedforward network to directly predict 3D features without requiring optimization during inference. The approach utilizes a two-stage training strategy. First, we optimize a feature field in 3D using only 2D feature supervision. Second, we train a network to regress this feature field. The entire procedure requires no 3D annotation, instead relying on the powerful information in 2D foundation models. We demonstrate that our learned features can be immediately applied to downstream tasks, including part segmentation, dense correspondence, and mesh deformation. Extensive experiments show that MeshFM, trained solely with 2D supervision, performs on par with methods trained explicitly with 3D supervision, even without task-specific fine-tuning. Moreover, our model is trained to be robust to extreme rotations of the input objects. Project page: https://threedle.github.io/MeshFM/

AI.tldr: 本文提出MeshFM，一个高效的3D输入特征提取前馈框架，通过从2D视觉基础模型蒸馏特征到3D空间，无需推理优化和3D标注即可获得丰富的3D特征，可直接应用于零件分割、稠密对应和网格变形等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D特征提取方法通常依赖3D标注数据或推理时的优化过程，成本高且效率低；而2D视觉基础模型已蕴含丰富的语义和几何信息，如何将这些强大能力高效迁移到3D领域是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段仅利用2D特征监督在3D空间优化一个特征场；第二阶段训练一个前馈网络回归该特征场。整个过程无需3D标注，仅依赖2D基础模型的信息，并训练模型对输入的极端旋转具有鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验表明，MeshFM仅用2D监督训练即可与使用3D监督的方法表现相当，且无需任务特定的微调；在零件分割、稠密对应和网格变形等下游任务上展现出即插即用的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明2D基础模型的特征可以高效蒸馏到3D领域，通过两阶段蒸馏策略可以免去3D标注依赖和推理优化，为3D特征学习提供了一条高效、可扩展的新路径。

title: Skill Use or Skill Theater? Evaluating the Reasoning Backroom in Skill-Augmented Language Agents
summary: Reusable skills are becoming a standard interface for extending language agents with task procedures. Yet evaluators usually infer skill use from visible reasoning or the agent's own attribution. These signals show what the agent appears to use, not whether the skill changed its decision. We ask whether skill-augmented agents exhibit a \textbf{Reasoning Backroom}, a systematic gap between stated skill use and intervention-measured influence. We introduce BACKTRACE, an evaluation framework that pairs each skill-conditioned answer with a matched no-skill counterfactual, intervenes on skill meaning, wording, identity, content, and assignment, and elicits attribution only after the answer is committed. We instantiate the framework as BACKROOMBench, a verified testbed spanning controlled logic and competition mathematics, multiple skill conditions, single-agent and multi-agent settings, and diverse model families. Our evaluation reveals a pervasive provenance failure. Across models and domains, stated skill use often remains stable while causal reliance and signed utility vary, producing both silent uptake and performative use. Behavioral effects follow procedural content more reliably than displayed skill identity, whereas stated attributions respond strongly to artifact availability. Observational detectors based on direct skill-use claims, text mentions, trace similarity, and an LLM judge do not identify which decisions actually depend on the skill. In multi-agent systems, skill influence can survive communication even after its source is lost, while no-skill teams still name skills and sources that were never supplied. These findings establish the Reasoning Backroom as a general AI provenance problem whose audit requires intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BACKTRACE评估框架，通过配对有无技能的反事实干预测量技能对智能体决策的真实因果影响，发现技能增强型智能体存在"推理后室"系统性问题——声称的技能使用与实际行为影响之间存在差距。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法仅通过可见推理或智能体自我归因推断技能使用情况，但这些信号只能反映表面使用，无法判断技能是否真正改变了决策。研究者希望揭示技能声称使用与实际因果影响之间的系统性差距。
AI.method: 构建BACKTRACE框架，将每个技能条件答案与匹配的无技能反事实配对，对技能含义、措辞、身份、内容和分配进行干预，并在答案提交后才收集归因。实例化为BACKROOMBench基准，涵盖受控逻辑和竞赛数学、多种技能条件、单智能体与多智能体场景及多种模型家族。
AI.result: 发现普遍的存在性失败：技能声称使用保持稳定而因果依赖和有符号效用变化，产生静默吸收和表演性使用；行为效应更依赖于程序内容而非技能身份；观察性检测器无法识别实际依赖技能的决策；多智能体系统中技能影响可在来源丢失后存续，而无技能团队仍会提及从未提供的技能和来源。
AI.conclusion: 推理后室是一个普遍的人工智能溯源问题，其审计需要干预性方法而非观察性信号。

title: Harness-G: A Graph-Structured Harness for Search Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) search agents commonly model retrieval as free-form natural-language query generation and optimize multi-turn interactions using final-answer rewards. Current studies mainly improve training with denser or more structured credit signals, but rarely examine whether retrieval is properly formulated at the policy-environment interface. We observe pronounced retrieval aliasing during Search-R1 training: rollouts for the same question continue to generate distinct query strings, yet their accumulated evidence sets increasingly overlap. We call this phenomenon retrieval-equivalence collapse; in this regime, trajectories approach utility equivalence with respect to retrieval decisions, leaving within-group returns with little effective retrieval contrast. To address this problem, we propose Harness-G, a graph-structured retrieval framework that redesigns this interface. It reformulates free-form query generation as finite action selection: the policy selects an evidence sentence or entity, or chooses to answer, while the environment constructs the menu, tracks retrieval state, and validates and executes each choice. This interface reduces linguistic aliasing and makes same-state alternatives directly comparable. Building on this interface, we introduce Structured Non-myopic Credit (SNC), which uses a frozen answer scorer to compare the selected action with its alternatives and assigns downstream gains to the earlier actions that enabled them. Across six QA benchmarks, Harness-G achieves the highest average F1 at both evaluated model scales, outperforming the strongest baseline, Graph-R1, by 10.74 points at 1.5B and 3.98 points at 3B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Harness-G，一个图结构的检索框架，将RL搜索代理中的自由形式查询生成重新设计为有限动作选择，解决检索等价坍塌问题，并通过结构化非短视信用（SNC）分配下游收益，在六个QA基准上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RL搜索代理将检索建模为自由形式的自然语言查询生成，虽然通过更密集或结构化的信用信号改善训练，但很少审视检索在策略-环境接口层面的公式化是否正确。作者观察到检索别名化现象（retrieval aliasing）：同一问题生成不同的查询字符串，但累积的证据集越来越重叠，导致检索等价坍塌，使轨迹在检索决策上趋于效用等价，缺乏有效的检索对比信号。
AI.method: Harness-G是一个图结构化检索框架：(1) 将自由形式查询生成重新设计为有限动作选择，策略选择证据句子或实体，或选择回答；(2) 环境负责构建菜单、跟踪检索状态、验证并执行每个选择；减少语言别名化使同状态替代方案直接可比。(3) 提出结构化非短视信用（SNC），使用冻结的答案评分器比较所选动作与替代方案，将下游收益分配给早期使能动作。
AI.result: 在六个QA基准上，Harness-G在两个评估模型规模上均取得最高平均F1分数，在1.5B规模上比最强基线Graph-R1高出10.74分，在3B规模上高出3.98分。
AI.conclusion: 重新设计策略-环境接口能够有效解决检索等价坍塌问题，图结构化的有限动作选择框架配合结构化的信用分配机制，可以显著提升RL搜索代理在QA任务上的表现。

title: MPIE-Bench: Benchmarking Anatomically Plausible Multi-Person Interaction Editing
summary: Text-to-image and personalized editing models now synthesize high-fidelity single-subject images with ease. Yet placing multiple named people into shared contact actions such as embrace, carry, or grapple still exposes major failures: fused limbs, invented extremities, and interpenetrating bodies. Existing evaluations largely overlook these anatomical and geometric issues, and VLM-as-a-judge checklists often saturate on Interaction while the errors remain obvious to humans. We introduce MPIE-Bench, a 2,500-sample benchmark of video-mined editing triplets spanning 405 scenes, 14 interaction categories, and four contact densities (C0-C3). We also propose MPIE-Eval, whose two new axes score contact-time geometry from a frozen public multi-person mesh reconstruction. Anatomy asks whether every human-like mass is explained by a complete set of reconstructed bodies, and Interaction asks whether the penetration and surface distance between those bodies match the contact the instruction asked for. Across ten editors, mesh Anatomy tops out at 0.65 and mesh Interaction at 0.72 on two different models, so no single editor is strong on both, while VLM checklists rate the same images above 0.95. A five-rater study confirms that both axes track human judgement more closely than a zero-shot VLM judge, and the rankings hold under ablation of every weight and threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MPIE-Bench基准（2,500个样本、405个场景、14种交互类别、4种接触密度）和MPIE-Eval评估框架，利用多人体网格重建从解剖学和交互两个新维度评测多人物接触图像的生成质量。实验发现现有编辑模型在多人接触任务上表现欠佳，VLM作为评判者存在饱和现象，而所提方法更贴近人类判断。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像及个性化编辑模型在生成多个具名人物的接触动作（如拥抱、扛举、扭打）时存在严重缺陷，包括肢体融合、多余肢体和身体互相穿透等问题。然而现有评估方法大多忽略了这些解剖和几何问题，VLM作为评判者的检查表在交互维度上容易饱和，掩盖了人类显而易见的错误。
AI.method: 构建MPIE-Bench基准，从视频中挖掘2,500个编辑三元组，覆盖405个场景、14个交互类别和四种接触密度（C0-C3）。提出MPIE-Eval评估框架，利用冻结的公开多人体网格重建模型引入两个新评估轴：Anatomy（检查每个人体质量是否被完整重建的身体集所解释）和Interaction（检查重建身体之间的穿透和表面距离是否与指令要求的接触程度匹配）。
AI.result: 在十个编辑模型上，网格Anatomy最高得分仅0.65，网格Interaction最高仅0.72（分别来自两个不同模型），说明没有单一编辑器在两个维度上都表现优异；而VLM检查表对相同图像的评分超过0.95。五人评分研究证实两个轴比零样本VLM评判者更贴近人类判断，且在所有权重和阈值的消融下排序保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 现有编辑模型在多人物接触生成任务上仍存在显著不足，现有VLM评估存在明显的饱和问题；所提出的基于网格重建的评估框架能够更准确地反映人类对解剖合理性和接触交互质量的感知，为多人物接触生成任务提供了更可靠的评估工具。

title: From Single- to Cross-Document: Benchmarking Multi-Granularity Event Analysis of Large Language Models
comment: 9 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR 2026)
summary: Event analysis is an essential and fundamental direction of information extraction, involving various event-centric tasks at different granularity of documents. While large language models (LLMs) have preliminarily achieved promising performance in part of these tasks individually, their capability in event analysis still lacks comprehensive understanding due to restricted document granularity, task designs, and data source of existing benchmarks. To address these limitations, we introduce MiGUE-Bench, a systematic benchmark for assessing the performance of LLMs in multi-granularity event analysis.
