To support large-scale evaluation, we first develop an LLM-driven self-correcting annotation framework called MiGUE-Pipeline, enabling scalable acquisition of high-quality source data of events with automatic labels. Then, we design four core tasks in our benchmark, i.e., event detection, relation reasoning, structure induction, and future prediction, to probe model competence at different levels, from atomic event details to complex cross-document narratives. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods delineate the current capability boundary and identify critical deficiencies, providing insights into the future improvement of LLMs in challenging event analysis tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MiGUE-Bench，一个用于系统评估大语言模型（LLMs）在多粒度事件分析中能力的基准测试框架，包含自动标注管道和四个核心任务（事件检测、关系推理、结构归纳和未来预测），并在多种先进LLM和RAG方法上进行了广泛实验。
AI.motivation: 现有的事件分析基准受限于文档粒度、任务设计和数据来源，导致对LLMs在事件分析方面的综合能力缺乏全面理解。需要构建一个系统化的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: （1）开发了MiGUE-Pipeline，一个由LLM驱动的自纠正标注框架，支持大规模获取高质量带自动标签的事件源数据；（2）设计了MiGUE-Bench基准，包含四个核心任务：事件检测、关系推理、结构归纳和未来预测，从原子事件细节到跨文档复杂叙事的多层次探测模型能力。
AI.result: 在多种先进的LLMs和检索增强生成（RAG）方法上进行了广泛实验，刻画了当前模型的能力边界，识别了关键缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为LLMs在挑战性事件分析任务中的能力评估提供了系统化基准，并为其后续改进提供了有价值的见解。

title: ICLE++: Modeling Fine-Grained Traits for Holistic Essay Scoring
comment: Accepted as a long paper to NAACL 2024
summary: The majority of the recently-developed models for automated essay scoring (AES) are evaluated solely on the ASAP corpus. However, ASAP is not without its limitations. For instance, it is not clear whether models trained on ASAP can generalize well when evaluated on other corpora. In light of these limitations, we introduce ICLE++, a corpus of persuasive student essays annotated with both holistic scores and trait-specific scores. Not only can ICLE++ be used to test the generalizability of AES models trained on ASAP, but it can also facilitate the evaluation of models developed for newer AES problems such as multi-trait scoring and cross-prompt scoring. We believe that ICLE++, which represents a culmination of our long-term effort in annotating the essays in the ICLE corpus, contributes to the set of much-needed annotated corpora for AES research.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ICLE++语料库，这是一个带整体评分和特质评分的说服性学生作文语料库，可用于测试AES模型的泛化能力，并支持多特质评分和跨提示评分等新型AES任务的研究。
AI.motivation: 现有AES模型大多仅在ASAP语料库上评估，但ASAP存在局限性，无法确定模型能否泛化到其他语料库，因此需要新的标注语料库来弥补这一缺口。
AI.method: 构建ICLE++语料库，对ICLE语料库中的说服性学生作文进行长期标注，包含整体评分（holistic scores）和特质评分（trait-specific scores）两种标注维度。
AI.result: ICLE++不仅可用于测试在ASAP上训练的AES模型的泛化能力，还可支持多特质评分和跨提示评分等新型AES问题的模型评估。
AI.conclusion: ICLE++作为长期标注努力的成果，为AES研究提供了急需的标注语料库资源，有助于推动AES领域的进一步研究。

title: BlindPSNR: A No-Reference Fidelity Predictor for Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods involve tunable parameters that are typically fixed, often leading to performance degradation when applied across scenes. Manually selecting the best configuration, however, can be time-consuming and not always practical. Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) is the natural fidelity criterion for automating parameter selection, yet it requires a ground-truth reference that is typically unavailable. To our knowledge, no learning-based method addresses no-reference PSNR prediction for low-light image enhancement; the natural surrogate, no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA), targets perceptual quality rather than signal fidelity, and all seven baselines we test achieve 0% top-1 selection accuracy on our benchmark. With paired training data, the ground-truth PSNR is analytically computable, providing exact supervision without a separate teacher network. Building on this, we propose BlindPSNR, a lightweight no-reference network that fuses the enhanced image with the degraded low-light input via windowed cross-attention and estimates PSNR through heteroscedastic regression. While a scalar-regression baseline achieves top-1 accuracy of 54.4%, BlindPSNR raises this to 89.5% with regret dropping from 1.62 dB to 0.026 dB, and generalizes to unseen datasets (SRCC = 0.61-0.67).

AI.tldr: 本文提出BlindPSNR，一种轻量级无参考网络，用于低光图像增强中的PSNR预测，通过窗口交叉注意力融合增强图像与退化输入，并采用异方差回归估计PSNR，在参数自动选择基准上达到89.5%的top-1准确率，远超标量回归基线的54.4%。
AI.motivation: 低光图像增强方法包含可调参数但通常固定不变，导致跨场景性能下降。手动选择最佳配置耗时且不切实际。PSNR是自然的参数自动选择准则，但需要真实参考图像，而实际应用中通常不可得。现有的无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）针对感知质量而非信号保真度，七个基线在基准上top-1选择准确率均为0%，无法有效解决该问题。
AI.method: BlindPSNR采用轻量级无参考网络架构，通过窗口交叉注意力机制融合增强图像与退化低光输入，利用配对训练数据中可解析计算的真实PSNR作为精确监督（无需教师网络），并通过异方差回归来估计PSNR值。
AI.result: 标量回归基线top-1准确率为54.4%，而BlindPSNR达到89.5%，后悔值从1.62 dB降至0.026 dB，并且在未见数据集上具有良好的泛化能力（SRCC = 0.61-0.67）。
AI.conclusion: BlindPSNR有效解决了低光图像增强中无参考PSNR预测问题，能够高效准确地自动选择最优参数配置，显著优于现有基线方法，并展示了良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

title: A dataset of rated conceptual arguments
summary: Large language models have improved rapidly on tasks with verifiable answers, such as mathematics and programming. Much less is known about their ability to reason about what we call conceptual questions: questions for which no ground truth is realistically accessible and no widely accepted resolution methodology exists, but on which progress can still be made by debating arguments. Most philosophical questions are of this kind, as are central components of questions in AI safety, decision theory, and social choice. Our approach is based on the view that while bottom-line conclusions on such questions are hard to evaluate, individual contextualized arguments can be evaluated far more reliably. We therefore introduce a dataset of 951 argumentative critiques of 442 position texts, spanning topics from AI safety and decision theory to ethics and politics, with 1,458 ratings by six expert raters along dimensions including centrality, strength, correctness, and clarity. We propose two scoring functions and benchmark a range of models. Performance tracks general capability rankings.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨大语言模型在"概念性问题"上的推理能力——即没有标准答案、但可通过辩论论证取得进展的问题（如哲学问题）。作者构建了一个包含951条论证性批评、442篇立场文本、1,458条专家评分的数据集，并提出两种评分函数对多种模型进行基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注大语言模型在数学和编程等可验证答案任务上的表现，但对缺乏唯一正确答案的概念性问题（如哲学、AI安全、决策论等）的推理能力了解甚少。作者认为，虽然这类问题的最终结论难以评估，但单个情境化论证可以被可靠地评估，因此需要建立相应的数据集和评估方法。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含951条论证性批评、442篇立场文本的数据集，涵盖AI安全、决策论、伦理和政治等主题，由六位专家从中心性、力度、正确性和清晰度四个维度给出1,458条评分。提出两种评分函数，并对一系列模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: 模型在概念性问题论证表现上的性能与通用能力排名一致，表明语言模型在该类任务上的表现与其整体能力水平相关。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在概念性推理任务上的表现与通用能力排名一致，这为将来更好地评估和改进模型在缺乏标准答案领域的推理能力提供了数据基础和评估框架。

title: Recall Before You Rank: Similarity-Guided Top-$K$ Reuse for Efficient Long-Context Attention
summary: Top-$K$ sparse attention reduces the cost of Softmax and value aggregation by attending to only a small subset of key--value (KV) entries. However, identifying this subset still requires scoring the current query against the full KV cache and performing global Top-$K$ selection, leaving selector cost linear in context length and limiting the practical efficiency of sparse attention for long-context decoding. In this paper, we introduce ReTopK, a training-free method that accelerates dynamic Top-$K$ attention by reusing historical retrieval decisions. ReTopK builds on the observation that similar queries often attend to overlapping supports and that partially overlapping supports can still preserve most of the Exact Top-$K$ attention mass. For each attention head, it maintains a bounded cache of historical query--support pairs, retrieves the most similar cached queries for each new query, unions their stored supports with a recent window, and reranks only the resulting compact candidate set using exact current-query scores. A similarity-based fallback invokes full-history Exact Top-$K$ when reuse is unreliable, while periodic exact refreshes limit cache drift. ReTopK retains the complete KV cache and reuses only selected indices, rather than historical scores, attention weights, or outputs. Across 16K--128K contexts, ReTopK achieves the lowest PG19 perplexity and the highest NIAH and LongBench scores among the evaluated approximate methods. At 128K with $K=512$, ReTopK incurs only a 0.50\% perplexity increase over Exact Top-$K$ while accelerating attention computation by $3.07\times$.

AI.tldr: ReTopK是一种无需训练的加速动态Top-K稀疏注意力方法，通过复用历史检索决策（相似的查询倾向于关注重叠的支持集）来避免对完整KV缓存进行全局Top-K选择，在16K-128K上下文中以极小的困惑度损失换取约3倍的注意力计算加速。
AI.motivation: Top-K稀疏注意力虽然通过只关注少量KV条目来降低Softmax和值聚合成本，但识别这些子集仍需对完整KV缓存进行评分和全局Top-K选择，导致选择器成本随上下文长度线性增长，限制了长上下文解码中稀疏注意力的实际效率。
AI.method: ReTopK为每个注意力头维护一个有界的历史查询-支持集缓存；对于每个新查询，检索最相似的缓存查询并将其存储的支持集与近期窗口取并集，然后仅对紧凑候选集使用精确当前查询分数进行重排序。采用相似度回退机制在重用不可靠时调用全历史精确Top-K，并通过周期性精确刷新限制缓存漂移。该方法只复用索引而非历史分数、注意力权重或输出，保留完整KV缓存。
AI.result: 在16K-128K上下文中，ReTopK在PG19困惑度、NIAH和LongBench指标上均取得评估的近似方法中最优表现。在128K上下文且K=512时，ReTopK相比精确Top-K仅增加0.50%的困惑度，同时将注意力计算加速3.07倍。
AI.conclusion: ReTopK通过巧妙复用历史检索决策，有效绕过了Top-K稀疏注意力中选择器成本随上下文线性增长的核心瓶颈，在保持接近精确Top-K质量的同时显著加速了长上下文解码中的注意力计算。

title: Automated Transcript Analysis for Detecting Flaws in Agentic Benchmarks
summary: Capabilities of frontier models are often assessed using agentic benchmarks. To trust these results, benchmarks must accurately measure what they claim to and be free from invalidating flaws. Previous manual audits of benchmarks such as SWE-Bench-Verified have uncovered several validity issues in transcripts. However, manual review is difficult to scale, and it is unclear whether automated methods can reliably surface flaws that compromise benchmark validity. In this paper, we developed AI scanners to detect four types of validity issues: ground truth access, tool failure, guessing vulnerability, and answer format ambiguity. We produced grading rubrics for each to instruct human labeling, and evaluated the scanners against human labels on a held-out test set of Inspect Evals benchmarks. Our scanners identified several verified quality issues in five widely used benchmarks, including cases unlikely to be caught by random manual inspection. Not all cases were identified, and scanner performance varied substantially across benchmarks, criteria and models. We highlight several open challenges to be addressed to improve scanners for stronger quality assurance claims, including broader standardization gaps in the evaluation field that degrade scanner performance. Together, these results serve as a proof of concept for using automated transcript analysis to audit benchmark quality more broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了AI扫描器来自动检测基准测试（benchmark）中的四种有效性缺陷：真实标签访问、工具故障、猜测脆弱性和答案格式歧义。在Inspect Evals基准的保留测试集上评估，扫描器在五个广泛使用的基准中发现了多个经人工验证的质量问题，但仍存在遗漏，且性能因基准、标准和模型而异。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型的能力常通过代理基准（agentic benchmarks）评估，但此前人工审计发现如SWE-Bench-Verified等基准存在有效性缺陷。人工审查难以规模化，且不清楚自动化方法能否可靠地发现损害基准有效性的缺陷，因此需要开发可扩展的自动化审计方法。
AI.method: 开发了AI扫描器用于检测四类有效性缺陷（真实标签访问、工具故障、猜测脆弱性、答案格式歧义），为每类缺陷制定评分标准以指导人工标注，并在Inspect Evals基准的留出测试集上将扫描器结果与人工标注进行比较评估。
AI.result: 扫描器在五个广泛使用的基准中识别出多个经人工验证的质量问题，包含随机人工检查难以发现的案例。但并非所有问题都被识别，扫描器性能在不同基准、标准和模型间差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 该研究作为概念验证，表明可以使用自动化转录分析来更广泛地审计基准质量。同时指出评估领域存在的标准化不足等问题会降低扫描器性能，需改进以支持更强的质量保证声明。

title: A Sparse Glimpse of the Whole: Train-Free Self-Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding alleviates the memory-bandwidth bottleneck in large language model inference, but its acceleration is jointly constrained by drafting overhead, token acceptance, and speculation length. We present a unified efficiency analysis showing that extending the speculation horizon can reduce rather than improve speedup when the marginal acceptance probability falls below the relative drafting cost. Guided by this analysis, we introduce SparseSpec-L, a training-free self-speculative decoding framework for long-context inference. SparseSpec-L generates lightweight drafts directly from the target model using a dynamically sparsified and recallable KV cache. It recycles per-head attention statistics produced during full-context verification as a no-extra-forward importance signal, allowing critical historical tokens to be recalled without permanently discarding the dense KV cache. An online entropy-based controller further selects the speculation length according to expected step-wise efficiency. Experiments across multiple long-context tasks and model scales show consistent end-to-end acceleration, with up to speedup over autoregressive decoding while preserving the target model's output distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SparseSpec-L，一个无需训练的自我推测解码框架，通过动态稀疏化和可召回KV缓存实现长上下文推理加速，并在统一效率分析指导下动态选择推测长度，最高可实现数倍于自回归解码的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 推测解码能够缓解大语言模型推理中的内存带宽瓶颈，但其加速效果受制于草稿开销、token接受率和推测长度三个因素的共同约束。作者通过统一效率分析发现，当边际接受概率低于相对草稿成本时，延长推测窗口反而会降低加速比，因此需要更精细的框架来平衡这些因素。
AI.method: SparseSpec-L包含三个核心组件：(1)利用动态稀疏化和可召回的KV缓存直接从目标模型生成轻量级草稿；(2)复用全上下文验证过程中产生的每头注意力统计作为无需额外前向传播的重要性信号，在不永久丢弃稠密KV缓存的前提下召回关键历史token；(3)在线基于熵的控制器根据期望的逐步效率动态选择推测长度。
AI.result: 在多个长上下文任务和不同模型规模上的实验表明，SparseSpec-L在保持目标模型输出分布的同时，实现了自回归解码的一致端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: SparseSpec-L通过理论指导的推测长度选择、无训练的自我推测机制以及可召回KV缓存设计，有效解决了长上下文推理中推测解码的效率瓶颈问题，为长上下文LLM推理加速提供了新的解决方案。

title: MMOOC: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Out-of-Context Evaluation in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on a wide range of vision-language tasks, but often fail under imperfect or shifted contexts. A reliable MLLM should refuse truly out-of-context (OOC) questions with subject-level context shifts while still answering shifted in-context (Shifted IC) questions with non-subject context shifts. Existing benchmarks mainly target OOC or visually unanswerable questions, but overlook answerable Shifted IC cases and cover limited OOC shifts. To fill this gap, we present MMOOC, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating refusal and robust answering abilities of MLLMs. MMOOC contains over 41K image-question pairs, including answerable Shifted IC cases and unanswerable OOC cases, spanning three question formats, eight shift types and six visual scenarios, with data quality ensured through MLLM-based filtering and human verification. We evaluate model responses using Accuracy and Refusal Rate, and further introduce an LLM-as-a-Judge metric to assess the correctness of model reasoning. Experiments on diverse MLLMs show that current models still struggle to balance answer-ability and refusal under shifted contexts. We further analyze key failure patterns and show that post-training can improve robustness. MMOOC will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MMOOC，一个大规模基准数据集（超过41K图像-问题对），用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在上下文偏移场景下的拒答能力和稳健回答能力，涵盖可回答的Shifted IC问题和不可回答的OOC问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型在变形或偏移的上下文条件下经常失败。现有基准主要针对OOC或视觉上不可回答的问题，但忽略了可回答的Shifted IC案例，且覆盖的OOC偏移类型有限。需要一个更全面的基准来衡量模型在偏移上下文下的拒答和稳健回答能力。
AI.method: 构建了MMOOC基准，包含超过41K图像-问题对，涵盖三种问题格式、八种偏移类型和六种视觉场景；通过基于MLLM的过滤和人工验证确保数据质量；使用Accuracy和Refusal Rate评估模型响应，并引入LLM-as-a-Judge指标来评估模型推理的正确性。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前MLLMs在偏移上下文下难以平衡可回答性和拒答能力；进一步分析了关键失败模式，并证明后训练（post-training）可以提升模型的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: MMOOC填补了现有基准在评估MLLMs偏移上下文处理能力方面的空白，揭示了当前模型的局限性，并展示了后训练策略对提升稳健性的潜力。基准将公开发布。

title: AI Literacy: An Exercise in Power-Knowledge
summary: As generative artificial intelligence becomes one of the most significant systems of knowledge production in our society today, questions relating to who can access and shape that production grow increasingly important in our discourse. This paper argues that the existing frameworks for AI literacy, which are dominated by technical competency and responsible-use principles, are insufficient because they enforce a "consumer" orientation toward AI rather than fostering genuine epistemic agency. Based upon Foucault's concept of power-knowledge, Freire's pedagogy of critical consciousness, and scholarship of digital literacy, this paper proposes a reconceptualization of AI literacy as a critical practice that equips individuals not just to use AI systems, but to critically evaluate them, resist their structuring assumptions, and participate in their governance. The paper further argues that unequal access to AI tools in society recapitulates longstanding epistemic injustices, and that a literacy framework oriented toward empowerment must account for these structural inequities. A three-part framework of AI literacy based on the notions of contextual use, critical interrogation, and participatory governance frames this literacy as a cultivation of epistemic "agents" rather than the training of competent consumers of AI-generated information.

AI.tldr: 本文批判现有AI素养框架过于强调技术能力和"负责任使用"，忽视了认知能动性，基于福柯、弗莱雷和数字素养理论，提出了包含情境使用、批判性审视和参与式治理三部分的AI素养重构框架，旨在将个体从AI信息的"消费者"转变为认知"能动者"。
AI.motivation: 现有AI素养框架以技术能力和负责任使用原则为主导，使个体沦为AI系统的"消费者"而非具有认知能动性的主体，无法应对生成式AI成为重要知识生产系统所带来的权力与公平问题。
AI.method: 基于福柯的权力-知识理论、弗莱雷的批判意识教育学以及数字素养相关学术研究，从理论上重新概念化AI素养，并提出一个包含"情境使用、批判性审视、参与式治理"三部分的分析框架。
AI.result: 提出了一个三部分框架，将AI素养重新定义为一种批判性实践，使个体能够批判性评估AI系统、抵制其结构性假设并参与其治理，同时回应AI工具获取不平等所复制的认知不公正问题。
AI.conclusion: AI素养不应仅是培养胜任的AI信息消费者，而应致力于培育具有认知能动性的主体，使其能够批判性参与AI系统的使用、审视与治理。

title: Can LVLMs Uncover the Truth Behind Visual Illusions? An Analysis of Perceptual and Reasoning Capabilities
summary: Large Vision Language Models have integrated reasoning capabilities, elevating cognitive performance to new levels. However, existing evaluations either focus solely on perception or rely on specific domains such as maths or coding. Evaluation for reasoning capabilities that align with an open-world environment is still required, especially one that considers perception and reasoning jointly. To bridge this gap, we propose to evaluate LVLMs by exploiting visual illusions as a diagnostic tool. Visual illusions are phenomena in which the human visual system misinterprets objective signals, resulting in an understanding that deviates from reality. We constructed IllusionReasoning, a benchmark of illusion images collected from the real world, incorporating diverse annotated question-answer pairs. Based on IllusionReasoning, we show that the reasoning capabilities of a wide range of LVLMs are not as advanced as claimed. Our work provides new insights into LVLMs and offers future direction for optimisation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了IllusionReasoning基准，利用真实世界中的视觉错觉图像来联合评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的感知与推理能力，并发现当前LVLMs的推理能力并未达到其宣称的水平。
AI.motivation: 现有的LVLMs评估要么只关注感知能力，要么依赖数学或编程等特定领域，缺乏与开放世界环境相符、同时考虑感知和推理的评估方法。作者希望通过视觉错觉这一诊断工具来弥合这一评估缺口。
AI.method: 构建了IllusionReasoning基准，收集真实世界中的视觉错觉图像，并配以多样化的标注问答对，用于联合评估LVLMs的感知与推理能力。
AI.result: 基于IllusionReasoning基准，实验表明广泛范围内的LVLMs的推理能力并未达到其宣称的先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解LVLMs的推理能力提供了新见解，并为未来的模型优化指明了方向。

title: Learning Color Grading, No Photo Sharing: Federated Aesthetic Preference Learning for Personalized Image Enhancement
summary: Personalized image enhancement should reflect individual aesthetic taste, yet learning such preferences commonly depends on private photos and ratings that are unsuitable for centralized collection. The task must infer preference from sparse, heterogeneous feedback and translate it into natural-looking color transformations on resource-constrained user devices. We introduce FedPAIE, a federated personalized aesthetic image enhancement framework for user-adaptive color grading without centralizing raw photos or ratings. FedPAIE trains a lightweight dual-cue aesthetic scorer, calibrates it into a personalized scorer on a small local support set, and freezes it to guide regularized adaptation of a lightweight CLUT enhancer from unpaired local photographs. Fidelity constraints and an excess-gap penalty regularize scorer-guided adaptation to limit proxy-score over-optimization while preserving content and natural appearance. Training remains lightweight throughout the pipeline: scorer learning updates at most 0.787M parameters, enhancer adaptation updates 0.265M, and inference retains only a 0.293M-parameter personalized enhancer. Experiments on MIT-Adobe FiveK and Flickr-AES demonstrate effective open-world personalization and a favorable balance between user preference and image fidelity. FedPAIE thus connects decentralized preference learning with efficient personalized image transformation without requiring paired user retouches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedPAIE，一个联邦个性化美学图像增强框架，在不集中收集原始照片和评分的情况下，通过轻量级双线索美学评分器校准和CLUT增强器适配，实现用户自适应的色彩分级。
AI.motivation: 个性化图像增强应反映个人审美偏好，但学习此类偏好通常依赖不适合集中收集的私人照片和评分数据，且任务需从稀疏异构反馈中推断偏好，并在资源受限的设备上实现自然色彩变换。
AI.method: FedPAIE训练轻量级双线索美学评分器，在小型本地支持集上校准为个性化评分器，然后冻结该评分器用于引导轻量级CLUT增强器的正则化适配（基于未配对本地照片）。通过保真度约束和超额间隙惩罚来正则化评分器引导的适配，防止代理分数过度优化，同时保持内容和自然外观。
AI.result: 评分器学习最多更新0.787M参数，增强器适配更新0.265M参数，推理仅保留0.293M参数的个性化增强器。在MIT-Adobe FiveK和Flickr-AES数据集上的实验证明了有效的开放世界个性化和用户偏好与图像保真度之间的良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: FedPAIE将分散的偏好学习与高效的个性化图像变换联系起来，无需成对的用户修饰数据即可实现个性化图像增强。

title: Using Large Language Models for Idea Generation in Innovation
summary: This research evaluates the efficacy of large language models (LLMs) in generating new product ideas. To do so, we compare three pools of ideas for new products targeted toward college students and priced at 50 dollars or less. The first pool of ideas was created by university students in a product design course before the availability of LLMs. The second and third pools of ideas were generated by GPT-4 from OpenAI using zero-shot and few-shot prompting, respectively. We evaluated idea quality using standard market research techniques to predict average purchase intent probability. We used text mining to assess idea similarity and human raters to evaluate idea novelty. We find that AI-generated ideas outperform human-generated ideas in terms of average purchase intent, with few-shot prompting yielding slightly higher intent than zero-shot prompting. However, AI-generated ideas are perceived as less novel and exhibit higher pairwise similarity, particularly with few-shot prompting, indicating a less diverse solution landscape. When focusing on the quality of the best ideas rather than the average ideas, we find that AI-generated ideas are seven times more likely to rank among the top 10 percent of ideas, demonstrating a significant advantage over human-generated ideas. We propose that this seven-to-one advantage is a conservative estimate because it does not account for the greater productivity of AI. Our findings suggest that despite some drawbacks, AI creativity presents a substantial benefit in generating high-quality ideas for new product development.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成新产品创意方面的有效性，通过对比大学生设计课程参与者、GPT-4零样本提示和少样本提示生成的三个创意池，发现AI生成的创意在平均购买意愿上优于人类创意，且高质量创意的概率是人类创意的七倍，但AI创意的新颖性较低且多样性不足。
AI.motivation: 探索大型语言模型（LLMs）能否有效生成新产品创意，并系统性地比较AI生成创意与人类生成创意的质量差异。
AI.method: 采用三种方式生成新产品创意池：1）大学生（LLM出现前）；2）GPT-4零样本提示；3）GPT-4少样本提示。使用标准市场调研技术（平均购买意图概率）评估创意质量，利用文本挖掘评估创意相似性，并邀请人类评分员评估创意新颖性。同时比较最佳创意的质量而非仅平均值。
AI.result: AI生成的创意在平均购买意图上优于人类创意，少样本提示略优于零样本提示；但AI创意被认为新颖性较低且相似性更高（尤其是少样本提示）。在最佳创意质量方面，AI生成的创意进入前10%的概率是人类创意的七倍。
AI.conclusion: 尽管AI生成的创意存在新颖性不足和多样性较差的缺点，但AI在生成高质量新产品创意方面具有显著优势，且七比一的优势是保守估计（未计入AI更高的生产力）。

title: Gradient-free Task-Conditioned Retrieval for On-Device In-Context Learning
summary: On-device in-context learning (ICL) relies on pre-inference retrieval to select demonstrations for useful context before downstream model inference. This retrieval must exploit task-specific information while operating over local memories under limited computation, memory, and data-exposure budgets. We propose Conditional Retrieval Alignment (CoRA), a gradient-free framework that converts a frozen encoder into a task-conditioned retriever using paired candidate inputs and outputs. CoRA selects complementary encoder layers, constructs an output-derived conditioning space from candidate memory, and aligns candidate input representations to this space through closed-form ridge regression. Low-rank factorization then produces a compact retrieval basis where candidate outputs are used only during offline index construction, whereas query-time retrieval requires only the query input and precomputed index. We show that CoRA's rank-constrained basis is the optimal low-rank compression of the output-conditioned fitted representation, and derive an exact two-pass streaming construction that avoids materializing the full fitted matrix. We further extend the framework to multimodal exemplar retrieval by incorporating visual representations into the conditioning and retrieval spaces. Experiments across ten textual datasets and four multimodal benchmarks with Llama-3.2-1B, MobileLLM-Pro, OpenFlamingo-3B, and Qwen3.5-2B, as well as end-to-end Raspberry Pi~5 deployment demonstrate that CoRA supports effective task-conditioned retrieval without retriever fine-tuning, backpropagation, or target-model calls.

AI.tldr: CoRA是一个无梯度的框架，通过将冻结的编码器转换为任务条件检索器来实现在设备端的上下文学习（ICL），利用闭式岭回归和对低秩因子分解构建紧凑的检索基，仅需离线构建索引，查询时无需微调或目标模型调用。在十个文本数据集和四个多模态基准上验证了有效性，并部署在树莓派5上。
AI.motivation: 设备端上下文学习（ICL）依赖推理前的检索来选择演示样本，但现有检索方法必须在有限的计算、内存和数据暴露预算下利用任务特定信息，同时不能依赖检索器微调或回传。需要一种既高效又能编码任务条件信息的检索方案。
AI.method: CoRA框架包含四个核心组件：(1) 选择互补的编码器层；(2) 从候选记忆构建输出派生的条件空间；(3) 通过闭式岭回归将候选输入表示对齐到该空间；(4) 利用低秩因子分解生成紧凑的检索基。候选输出仅在离线索引构建阶段使用，查询时只需查询输入和预计算索引。还提出精确的两遍流式构造方法避免物化完整拟合矩阵，并扩展支持多模态示例检索。
AI.result: 在十个文本数据集和四个多模态基准上，使用Llama-3.2-1B、MobileLLM-Pro、OpenFlamingo-3B和Qwen3.5-2B等模型进行实验，并在树莓派5上端到端部署，证明CoRA能够实现有效的任务条件检索，无需检索器微调、反向传播或目标模型调用。
AI.conclusion: CoRA证明了在设备端约束下，通过闭式回归和低秩压缩即可实现有效的任务条件检索，为轻量级设备上的上下文学习提供了一种无需训练的高效方案。

title: Witness Evidence Portfolios: Single-Prefill Risk Detection for Closed Multimodal Answers
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures; includes supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/SouthWinter/WEP
summary: Reliable deployment of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) requires deciding whether a confident visual answer should be trusted, reviewed, or routed to a stronger system. Confidence scores capture candidate margins, but not where the estimated signed visual readouts associated with those margins come from or how they are distributed. We study inference-time risk detection for closed visual answers using the same white-box prefill path that produces the answer. Witness Evidence Portfolios (WEP) first estimates, layer by layer, which visual contributions support or contradict the predicted candidate. It summarizes these contributions through two interpretable route families: question-related evidence provenance and signed evidence concentration. Nested grouped validation chooses the more reliable family and a sparse top-k route portfolio, which is fused with candidate confidence. WEP needs no image perturbation, decoding change, backward pass, or external verifier. Across three MLLMs and four binary-answer benchmarks, WEP improves mean error AP by 0.134. All 12 model--dataset gains are positive, and image-cluster bootstrap intervals are strictly positive on 10 pairs. WEP targets white-box closed-answer systems and uses a labeled calibration slice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Witness Evidence Portfolios (WEP)方法，通过白盒推理路径逐层估计视觉证据对预测候选答案的支持或矛盾程度，实现多模态大模型闭式视觉答案的推理时风险检测。WEP无需图像扰动、解码修改、反向传播或外部验证器，融合候选置信度与稀疏top-k路由组合，在三个MLLM和四个二值问答基准上平均错误AP提升0.134。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLM）的可靠部署需要判断一个置信的视觉答案是否应被信任、复核或路由到更强系统。现有置信度分数只能捕捉候选答案的边际信息，却无法反映这些边际所关联的估计符号化视觉读数（signed visual readouts）的来源和分布，导致风险检测不充分。
AI.method: WEP方法包含三个核心步骤：(1) 利用与生成答案相同的白盒预填充路径，逐层估计哪些视觉贡献支持或违背预测候选答案；(2) 通过两个可解释的路由家族（question-related evidence provenance 和 signed evidence concentration）汇总这些贡献；(3) 采用嵌套分组验证选择更可靠的路由家族和稀疏top-k路由组合，并与候选置信度融合。该方法无需图像扰动、解码修改、反向传播或外部验证器。
AI.result: 在三个MLLM和四个二值问答基准上，WEP将平均误差AP提升了0.134。所有12个模型-数据集组合均获得正向收益，其中10对组合的图像聚类bootstrap区间严格为正。
AI.conclusion: WEP为白盒闭式答案系统提供了一种有效的推理时风险检测方法，通过证据溯源和符号证据集中度两个可解释维度增强置信度信号的可靠性，适用范围为白盒闭式系统且需要标注校准切片。

title: Evaluating Agentic Bioinformatics through Function, Evidence, and Validation
summary: Large language model agents increasingly plan, execute, and interpret biological analyses, yet fluent responses, successful tool calls, and benchmark performance alone do not establish scientific credibility. Existing reviews primarily organize biological agents by application, architecture, and agentic capability, but do not jointly operationalize the accountability of agent-generated workflows. We address this gap by treating the inspectable workflow trajectory, rather than architecture or final output alone, as the primary unit of analysis. We introduce the Function--Evidence--Validation (FEV) framework, which separates demonstrated workflow operations, traceable support for actions and claims, and use-case-specific validation. Using FEV, we map 109 agentic or agent-adjacent systems and 28 benchmark or evaluation resources, representing 128 unique publications across genomics, single-cell and spatial omics, protein science, drug discovery, computational pathology, and general bioinformatics automation. Across domains, planning and tool-mediated execution have advanced more rapidly than replayability, provenance, robust scientific assessment, external validation, and prospective empirical testing. We therefore argue that agentic bioinformatics should be assessed through workflow correctness rather than final-answer correctness alone. FEV provides a practical basis for comparing systems and designing transparent, auditable, and scientifically accountable bioinformatics workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FEV框架（Function--Evidence--Validation），将可检查的工作流轨迹而非架构或最终输出作为主要分析单元，系统映射了109个智能体系统与28个基准评估资源（共128篇论文），覆盖基因组学、单细胞与空间组学、蛋白质科学、药物发现、计算病理学等生物信息学领域，论证了智能体工作流应通过工作流正确性而非仅最终答案正确性来评估。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型智能体在生物分析中越来越普遍，但流畅的响应、成功的工具调用和基准测试表现并不能建立科学可信度。现有综述主要按应用、架构和智能体能力组织，但未将智能体生成工作流的可问责性（accountability）进行统一操作化，存在评估盲区。
AI.method: 引入FEV框架，从三个维度对智能体进行评估：(1) Function——已展示的工作流操作；(2) Evidence——行动和主张的可追溯支持；(3) Validation——用例特定的验证。基于此框架对109个智能体系统、28个基准或评估资源（涵盖128篇出版物）进行跨领域系统映射分析。
AI.result: 跨领域分析发现，规划（planning）和工具介导的执行（tool-mediated execution）的进展快于可重放性（replayability）、溯源（provenance）、稳健的科学评估、外部验证和前瞻性实证测试。各领域的智能体发展在验证与问责层面存在显著不平衡。
AI.conclusion: 智能体生物信息学应通过工作流正确性（workflow correctness）而非仅最终答案正确性来评估。FEV框架为比较系统、设计透明、可审计且科学可靠的生物信息学工作流提供了实用基础。

title: ChronoMem: Version Control and Semantic Rollback for Large Language Model Agent Memory
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to support multi-session interaction and personalization. However, existing agent memory systems are designed around forward-only evolution, continuously accumulating, consolidating, and overwriting knowledge, with no principled mechanism to inspect, version, or revert prior states. This makes agents brittle under corrections, concept drift, and memory corruption, particularly after they have already been exposed to subsequent information. We present ChronoMem, a semantic version-control layer for agentic memory integrated into the production-ready, open-source Agent Development Kit by Google. ChronoMem commits whole-memory snapshots at each memory write, maintains structured version histories, and supports natural-language rollback requests by mapping undo intents to concrete historical versions through hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval, rank fusion, and reranking. We further introduce a post-exposure evaluation protocol that tests whether an agent can behave counterfactually after rollback by answering queries and summarizing history as if future updates had never occurred. On long-horizon conversational benchmarks augmented with evolving memory states and rollback tasks, ChronoMem substantially improves rollback-consistent question answering and history summarization relative to prompt-only and retrieval-only baselines, while achieving strong performance in semantic version selection. To our knowledge, ChronoMem is the first open-source system and benchmark for systematic semantic global memory rollback in LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChronoMem，一个面向LLM代理的语义版本控制系统，集成于Google的Agent Development Kit中。系统在每次内存写入时提交全量快照，维护结构化版本历史，支持通过自然语言回滚请求将撤销意图映射到具体历史版本。同时引入事后暴露评估协议，验证代理在回滚后能否以反事实方式行为。实验表明ChronoMem在回滚一致的问答和历史摘要任务上显著优于基线，是首个面向LLM代理的系统性语义全局内存回滚的开源系统与基准。
AI.motivation: 现有代理内存系统仅支持前向演化，持续累积、整合和覆盖知识，缺乏检查、版本化或回退先前状态的机制。这使得代理在修正、概念漂移和内存损坏场景下表现脆弱，尤其是在已经接触后续信息之后。
AI.method: ChronoMem采用语义版本控制层方案：1) 每次内存写入时提交整内存快照；2) 维护结构化版本历史；3) 通过混合词汇与语义检索、排名融合和重排序，将自然语言回滚请求映射到具体历史版本。此外引入事后暴露评估协议，测试代理回滚后能否以反事实方式回答查询和总结历史。
AI.result: 在带有演化内存状态和回滚任务的长时对话基准上，ChronoMem在回滚一致的问答和历史摘要方面显著优于仅提示和仅检索基线，并在语义版本选择上表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: ChronoMem是首个面向LLM代理的系统性语义全局内存回滚的开源系统和基准，填补了代理内存版本管理领域的空白，为构建更健壮、可修正的长期记忆系统提供了基础。

title: JigShape: Evaluating Visual-Geometric Reasoning in VLMs through Jigsaw Puzzles
summary: Jigsaw puzzle solving requires jointly reasoning about visual content and geometric constraints, yet existing benchmarks use rectangular cuts that create ambiguous ground truth in texture-repeated regions. We introduce \textit{\ours{}}, a benchmark with tab-and-blank interlocking pieces where geometric constraints provide strong local compatibility requirements that, combined with visual content, yield unambiguous ground truth. Across 95K instances at four grid densities (4$\times$4 to 16$\times$16), we find that \textbf{zero-shot VLMs largely lack geometric reasoning}: only one of five frontier models (GPT-5.5) exceeds random baseline on 4$\times$4 puzzles, while all others perform at chance level. While supervised fine-tuning achieves $>$97\% on 4$\times$4, \textbf{all models collapse on larger grids}: GPT-5.5 drops from 70\% to near-random on 8$\times$8, and even fine-tuned models fall below 5\% on 12$\times$12. This ``scaling cliff'' suggests current architectures cannot maintain consistent constraint satisfaction as the number of pieces increases. \ours{} establishes scalable geometric reasoning as an open challenge for vision-language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为\ours{}的拼图基准数据集，采用榫卯互锁的拼图块设计，在4×4到16×16四种网格密度下包含95K个实例。研究发现零样本VLM大多缺乏几何推理能力（仅GPT-5.5在4×4上超过随机基线），所有模型在大规模拼图上性能急剧崩溃，揭示了"缩放悬崖"问题。
AI.motivation: 现有拼图基准使用矩形切割，在纹理重复区域会产生模糊的真实标注，无法有效评估模型的几何推理能力。需要一个具有强几何约束、无歧义真实标注的基准来系统评估视觉语言模型的几何推理能力。
AI.method: 设计了榫卯互锁（tab-and-blank）拼图块，通过几何约束提供强局部兼容性要求，结合视觉内容产生无歧义的真实标注。在四种网格密度（4×4到16×16）下构建95K个实例，评估了五个前沿VLM模型的 零样本能力和监督微调后的性能。
AI.result: 零样本条件下仅GPT-5.5在4×4拼图上超过随机基线，其余模型均处于随机水平；监督微调在4×4上达到>97%准确率，但所有模型在更大规模上崩溃：GPT-5.5从70%降至8×8上的接近随机水平，微调模型在12×12上准确率低于5%。
AI.conclusion: 当前架构无法在拼图块数量增加时保持一致的约束满足能力，存在"缩放悬崖"现象。可扩展的几何推理是视觉语言模型面临的一个开放性挑战。

title: Reasoning Consensus: Structural Ensembling of LLM Reasoning via Weighted DAG Aggregation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) explore problems through chain-of-thought, but this exploration is buried in unstructured prose. On high-stakes tasks, users cannot tell which steps are well-supported, which alternatives were seriously considered, or how the final conclusion compares to those the model discarded. We propose a framework that ensembles the reasoning structure, not just the answers, of multiple LLMs by weighted merging of Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) extracted from reasoning chains. We weight each step by how many traces independently attest to it, to return "Consensus Reasoning". Across six benchmarks spanning statutory interpretation, graduate-level science, narrative multi-hop reasoning, and first-order logic, our ensemble outperforms a matched-budget majority-vote baseline, with a maximum accuracy gain of 3.1% on MuSR-MM (narrative multi-hop reasoning). On a single model, the framework matches or exceeds self-consistency at the same trace budget while additionally exposing an inspectable consensus reasoning graph. Ensemble weights correlate with LLM-judge rankings of reasoning quality at Spearman $ρ= 0.30$-$0.51$, and consensus subgraphs are preferred over alternatives leading to the majority-vote answer in 54.4-65.4% of head-to-head comparisons across five of six datasets. We observe that our framework can also be used to analyze diverse reasoning perspectives for a problem.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过加权合并多个LLM推理链提取的有向无环图（DAG）来集成推理结构而非仅集成答案的框架，在六个基准上优于多数投票基线，同时生成可检查的共识推理图。
AI.motivation: LLM的链式推理探索被埋藏在非结构化文本中，用户无法判断哪些步骤有充分依据、哪些替代方案被认真考虑过，以及最终结论与模型丢弃的方案相比如何。特别是在高风险任务上，这种不可解释性是个严重问题。
AI.method: 从多个LLM的推理链中提取DAG，通过加权合并来集成推理结构。每个步骤的权重由多少条推理迹独立支持该步骤来决定，最终返回"共识推理"（Consensus Reasoning）图。
AI.result: 在六个基准（覆盖法理解释、研究生级科学、叙事多跳推理和一阶逻辑）上优于匹配预算的多数投票基线，在MuSR-MM上最大准确率提升3.1%。在单模型上，以相同迹预算匹配或超越自一致性，同时额外暴露可检查的共识推理图。集成权重与LLM评判的推理质量排名在Spearman ρ=0.30-0.51范围内相关，共识子图在五个数据集的54.4-65.4%对比中被优先选择。
AI.conclusion: 该框架不仅提升了推理准确率，还提供了可检查的共识推理图，增强推理过程的透明度；同时可用于分析同一问题的多样化推理视角。

title: RefineSVG: Visual Feedback-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Image-to-SVG Generation
comment: 17 pages, 5 main-paper figures. Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026). Includes the complete supplementary material
summary: We propose RefineSVG, a single-step closed-loop visual feedback framework that enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform high-fidelity image-to-SVG generation through self-correction. Existing MLLM-based approaches rely on single-pass open-loop inference, where the model receives visual input only once and must generate thousands of SVG code tokens without intermediate verification. This paradigm inevitably leads to geometric drift, error accumulation, and visual hallucination on complex images. RefineSVG overcomes this limitation by invoking an external rendering engine after an initial SVG generation pass to compare the rendered output against the target image. The comparison yields a multi-dimensional visual residual map (Diff-Map) that is fed back to the model as a ReAct-style correction signal, driving a targeted correction step. To support this render-observe-correct interaction, we further introduce an SVG-oriented semantic vocabulary that compresses token sequences by over 52%. A progressive training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning, rejection-sampling cold-start data construction, and end-to-end agentic reinforcement learning aligns the model with closed-loop visual correction. Extensive experiments show that RefineSVG consistently outperforms existing baselines in reconstruction fidelity, structural accuracy, and code efficiency.Code is available at https://github.com/liuxiaobo66/RefineSVG.

AI.tldr: RefineSVG是一个单步闭环视觉反馈框架，通过外部渲染引擎比较输出与目标图像，生成多维视觉残差图（Diff-Map）作为纠正信号，使多模态大语言模型能够通过自纠错实现高保真度的图像到SVG生成。该方法引入SVG语义词汇表将token压缩52%以上，并通过渐进式训练流程（包括监督微调、拒绝采样冷启动和端到端agentic强化学习）实现闭环视觉纠正，在重建保真度、结构准确性和代码效率上均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM的图像转SVG方法采用单次开放循环推理，模型仅接收一次视觉输入就需生成数千个SVG代码token，缺乏中间验证，导致复杂图像上出现几何漂移、错误累积和视觉幻觉等问题。作者旨在通过闭环自纠错机制解决这一根本性局限。
AI.method: 提出RefineSVG框架：1) 初始SVG生成后调用外部渲染引擎，将渲染输出与目标图像比较，生成多维视觉残差图（Diff-Map）；2) 将Diff-Map作为ReAct风格的纠正信号反馈给模型进行针对性修正；3) 引入SVG语义词汇表压缩token序列超过52%；4) 采用渐进式训练管线，涵盖监督微调、拒绝采样冷启动数据构建和端到端agentic强化学习。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RefineSVG在重建保真度、结构准确性和代码效率等指标上一致优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 闭环视觉反馈框架可以有效解决MLLM在图像转SVG任务中因单次开放性推理导致的错误累积问题，通过渲染-观察-纠正的交互模式显著提升生成质量，同时通过词汇表压缩提高了代码生成效率。

title: What makes prompts a graph: necessary and sufficient conditions for prompt graph engineering
summary: Prompts stopped being isolated strings some time ago. In real systems, one model call feeds another, retrieval interleaves with generation, routers branch, and aggregators merge parallel results. Practice converged on a single structure to hold this together: the graph. Frameworks such as LangGraph, DSPy, and Prompt Flow expose it openly, and research systems already optimize it automatically. The vocabulary, however, lags behind. Graph names, variously, a reasoning topology inside one sampling strategy, a multi-agent conversation, or an orchestration artifact, while prompt engineering still evokes writing one good string. What is missing is a reference definition treating prompts as nodes of an explicit, executable, improvable graph. We build that definition through conceptual analysis over sources with persistent identifiers, complemented by primary grey literature. We reconstruct the genealogy of the idea, from dataflow graphs and build systems, through prompt chaining and the thought topologies (chain, tree, graph), to graphs compiled and optimized as artifacts. We then propose a constitutive definition of prompt graph engineering, state its four conditions (explicit structure, separation between structure and prompt content, executable semantics, and the graph as a first-class engineering artifact), and operationalize them as an inclusion and exclusion test. We draw the boundary against six neighboring concepts and apply the test to six real systems (LangGraph, DSPy, Prompt Flow, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Claude Code subagents); it includes and excludes consistently. We close with a research agenda organized along four design tension axes. The contribution is an operational definition and a shared vocabulary for a practice that industry already exercises daily without naming precisely.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"提示图工程"（Prompt Graph Engineering）的操作性定义，将提示视为显式、可执行、可优化图中的节点，并为这一行业已在实践中广泛使用但缺乏精确术语的技术提供共享词汇。
AI.motivation: 实际系统中提示词早已不再是孤立的字符串，而是以图结构组织（如LangGraph、DSPy等框架），但术语体系严重滞后——"提示工程"仍被理解为写一个漂亮的字符串，缺乏对"提示即图节点"这一现实的参考定义。
AI.method: 通过概念分析（基于带持久标识符的文献及灰色文献）重构该思想的谱系，从数据流图、构建系统，到提示链接和思维拓扑（链、树、图），再到可编译优化的图工件；提出四个构成条件（显式结构、结构与提示内容分离、可执行语义、图作为一等工程工件），并将其操作化为包含/排除测试。
AI.result: 提出的定义成功区分了六个邻近概念，并一致地应用于六个真实系统（LangGraph、DSPy、Prompt Flow、AutoGen、CrewAI、Claude Code subagents），包含与排除结果保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于为一项工业界每天实践但从未精确命名的技术提供了操作性定义和共享词汇，并以四个设计张力轴线的研究议程作结。

title: Semantic-Aligned Structural Abstraction for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) aims to interpret complex human emotions by integrating natural language with non-verbal modalities. Non-verbal modalities share a structural isomorphism with natural language, as both can be viewed as feature sequences evolving over time. This isomorphism enables the transformation of non-verbal modalities into text-like tokens for unified semantic reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs), designed to understand and generate sequential data, can thus be utilized to interpret complex affective sequences. However, existing LLM-based methods primarily capture low-level superficial features, failing to model affective semantics arising from structural variations and contextual interactions. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{SentiLLM}, a unified framework that leverages \textit{Semantic-Aligned Structural Abstraction} to distill continuous raw signals into compact, semantically meaningful tokens. Specifically, we introduce a \textit{Dual-Stream Salience-Context Calibration Mechanism}, which disentangles non-verbal feature sequences into a focus stream and an ambient stream. The focus stream captures salient sentiment shifts (e.g., facial expressions) guided by textual priors, while the ambient stream characterizes stable background states. Through calibrating these dynamic sentiment shifts against background states, SentiLLM effectively projects non-verbal modalities into a unified semantic space, making them naturally understandable for LLMs. Serving as a plug-and-play module, SentiLLM significantly improves discriminative performance with only a small number of trainable parameters. Our method achieves superior performance on four datasets, MOSI, MOSEI, CH-SIMS, and CH-SIMS v2, demonstrating the effectiveness of the structural abstraction paradigm in MSA. Our code is available at: \href{https://github.com/especiallyW/SentiLLM}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SentiLLM框架，通过语义对齐的结构抽象将非语言模态转换为文本风格令牌，利用双流显著性-上下文校准机制分离情感焦点流与背景流，使LLM能够有效理解多模态情感序列，在四个数据集上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多模态情感分析方法主要捕获低层表面特征，无法建模由结构变化和上下文交互产生的情感语义，需要新的方法将非语言模态有效转化为LLM可理解的语义表示。
AI.method: 提出SentiLLM框架，包含语义对齐的结构抽象和双流显著性-上下文校准机制。双流机制将非语言特征序列解耦为焦点流（捕获由文本先验引导的显著情感变化，如面部表情）和环境流（表征稳定的背景状态），通过将动态情感变化与背景状态校准，将非语言模态投影到统一语义空间中供LLM理解。
AI.result: 在MOSI、MOSEI、CH-SIMS和CH-SIMS v2四个数据集上取得优越性能，仅需少量可训练参数即可显著提升判别性能。
AI.conclusion: SentiLLM验证了结构抽象范式在多模态情感分析中的有效性，作为即插即用模块能够有效增强LLM对情感序列的理解能力。

title: Calibrate Before Reason: Robust Visual Token Reduction against Semantic Drift in VLMs
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) suffer from prohibitive inference overhead due to long sequences of visual tokens. However, existing visual token reduction methods mainly improve efficiency by pruning or compressing redundant tokens without examining whether the resulting representation remains semantically consistent with the original representation. Mapping the original N-token visual sequence to K tokens may discard, dilute, or misassign critical visual cues, triggering severe semantic drift that deviates the VLM's understanding. In this paper, we first introduce the principle of 'Calibrate Before Reason' to visual token reduction and propose CaRe, a training-free robust framework that calibrates compact visual representations before reasoning to preserve semantic fidelity in VLMs. CaRe consists of two mutually complementary modules: 1) Perturbation-Robust Calibration Anchoring, which identifies calibration anchors with stable model-side influence under multi-directional perturbations; 2) Confidence-Gated Token Calibration, which extracts reliable calibration signals from unselected tokens and injects them into anchors. Extensive evaluations across diverse VLM architectures and benchmarks verify that CaRe outperforms state-of-the-art token reduction baselines. While pruning 94.4% of visual tokens, our method retains 96.4% of the original full-token performance, delivering up to 2.30 times faster end-to-end inference speed relative to unpruned vanilla models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaRe框架，一种无需训练的视觉标记缩减方法，通过"先校准再推理"的原则，在缩减视觉标记前对压缩表示进行语义校准，确保语义保真度，仅保留5.6%的视觉标记即可达到原模型96.4%的性能，推理速度提升最高2.3倍。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉标记缩减方法主要关注效率提升，通过剪枝或压缩冗余标记，但未检查缩减后的表示是否与原表示保持语义一致。将N个视觉标记映射到K个可能导致关键视觉线索被丢弃、稀释或错误分配，引发语义漂移，损害VLM的理解能力。
AI.method: CaRe包含两个互补模块：1) 扰动鲁棒校准锚定（Perturbation-Robust Calibration Anchoring），识别在多方向扰动下模型侧影响稳定的校准锚点；2) 置信门控标记校准（Confidence-Gated Token Calibration），从未被选中的标记中提取可靠的校准信号并注入锚点，以补偿语义信息损失。
AI.result: 在多种VLM架构和基准上的广泛评估表明，CaRe优于现有最先进的标记缩减基线。剪枝94.4%的视觉标记时，保留原全标记性能的96.4%，相对未剪枝的原始模型实现最高2.30倍的端到端推理加速。
AI.conclusion: CaRe验证了"Calibrate Before Reason"原则在视觉标记缩减中的有效性，通过训练免费的校准框架在缩减前后保持语义保真，在效率与性能之间实现了更好的平衡。

title: Beyond Borrowed Histories: Person-Aligned User Simulation for Interactive Role-Playing Evaluation
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, including supplementary material. Resources: https://github.com/Zhuyh1139/PALATE
summary: Role-playing agents (RPAs) have become one of the most important consumer applications of large language models. Users engage in multi-turn conversations with RPAs for experiences such as emotional comfort, making reliable evaluation essential for measuring capability, comparing systems, and guiding further improvement. Existing benchmarks, however, typically require an RPA to continue a fixed dialogue history and then evaluate the continuation using a fixed rubric detached from the user. We identify and empirically demonstrate two limitations of this design. First, an RPA's output is shaped by the preceding dialogue history, preventing a scientifically grounded assessment of its role-playing ability in real multi-turn settings. Second, user experience varies substantially across individuals, and conventional fixed rubrics need not align with user satisfaction. We therefore introduce PALATE (Person-Aligned LLM-Simulated-User Assessment with Tailored Evaluation), a scalable RPA benchmark built on user simulators. PALATE is accompanied by a pool of 300 character profiles. Its main evaluation trains five per-user simulators and lets them engage candidate RPAs in free-form, multi-turn conversations over a pre-frozen panel of character profiles. Alongside a general quality rubric, we construct personalized rubrics to measure user satisfaction; on held-out annotated data, the personalized rubrics show higher agreement with human judgments than the general rubric. In the main evaluation of 16 candidates, PALATE separately characterizes generic turn quality, long-horizon session capability, and per-user experience on multi-turn trajectories co-constructed by each candidate. It thereby produces interpretable evaluations of specific user-RPA pairs rather than compressing systems into a single user-independent ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PALATE，一个基于用户模拟器的可扩展角色扮演智能体（RPA）评测基准。PALATE训练五位单用户模拟器，与候选RPA进行自由多轮对话，并结合个性化评分标准衡量用户满意度，从而实现了对特定用户-RPA配对的可解释评估。
AI.motivation: 现有RPA评测基准存在两大局限：一是要求RPA续写固定的对话历史，无法在真实多轮场景下科学评估其角色扮演能力；二是用户满意度因个体差异大，固定评分标准与用户真实体验可能不一致。
AI.method: PALATE包含300个角色档案库，主评测训练五个单用户模拟器，让它们与候选RPA在预冻结的角色档案上进行自由多轮对话。除通用质量评分标准外，还构建个性化评分标准来衡量用户满意度，并在保留的标注数据上验证其与人类判断的一致性。
AI.result: 在保留的标注数据上，个性化评分标准与人类判断的一致性高于通用评分标准。在16个候选RPA的主评测中，PALATE分别刻画了通用回合质量、长程会话能力和每位用户在多轮轨迹上的体验，产生针对特定用户-RPA配对的可解释评估。
AI.conclusion: PALATE突破了传统固定对话历史和固定评分标准的局限，通过用户模拟器和个性化评分实现面向个体用户满意度的RPA评测，避免了将系统压缩为单一与用户无关的排名。

title: Wiring diagram extraction and gluing: a case study in classifying figure skating jumps using 3D dataset
summary: Hasse clustering is an algorithm that extracts common patterns in sequential data and represents them in graphical forms. As the number of expected clusters grows, however, the algorithm can become infeasible to run due to combinatorial complexity. In this article, we describe a theory of gluing wiring diagrams, allowing iterative applications of Hasse clustering to achieve the same result as a single application. We test our theory in the context of classifying videos of figure skating jumps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"胶合接线图"理论，使得Hasse聚类算法可以通过迭代方式应用，从而解决因簇数量增长导致的计算组合爆炸问题，并在花样滑冰跳跃视频分类任务中验证了该理论。
AI.motivation: Hasse聚类算法能够从序列数据中提取公共模式并以图形形式表示，但随着预期簇数量的增加，算法的组合复杂度会急剧上升，导致算法变得不可行。
AI.method: 作者描述了一种"胶合接线图"（gluing wiring diagrams）的理论，通过该理论可以将Hasse聚类的单一应用分解为多次迭代应用，且最终结果与单次应用等价。
AI.result: 该理论在花样滑冰跳跃视频分类的上下文中进行了测试验证。
AI.conclusion: 胶合接线图理论为Hasse聚类提供了一种可扩展的迭代实现方式，有效降低了计算复杂度，并在实际视频分类任务中展示了其可行性。

title: AutoSupervision: Closing the Feedback Loop in Scientific Workflows with Grounded Revision Verification
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled AI systems to assist scientific research and peer review. However, an essential capability for reliable AI-assisted scientific workflows remains underexplored: verifying whether reviewer feedback leads to meaningful and evidence-supported manuscript improvements. We introduce AutoSupervision, which evaluates whether scientific manuscript revisions genuinely address reviewer concerns through grounded evidence. AutoSupervision leverages transparent peer-review records as a natural source of supervision, where reviewer comments specify scientific concerns, author responses describe claimed resolutions, and revised manuscripts provide evidence of changes. Given reviewer comments, author responses, and revised manuscripts, models must characterize reviewer concerns, determine whether concerns have been addressed, and identify supporting manuscript evidence. We construct AutoSupervision from 56,000 Nature Communications articles and corresponding review records. Then we conducted experiments on LLMs, the ablation study, and the case study. Our results show that while LLMs perform well in characterizing reviewer concerns, with GPT-5.5 achieving a score of 0.754, evidence-based verification remains the primary bottleneck, with the best-performing model reaching only 0.501.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoSupervision框架，利用56,000篇Nature Communications论文的真实审稿记录，评估大语言模型能否验证科学手稿修订是否真正基于证据回应审稿人关切。实验发现LLM在刻画审稿人关切方面表现良好（GPT-5.5达0.754），但基于证据的验证仍是主要瓶颈（最优模型仅0.501）。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM已广泛应用于辅助科学研究和同行评审，但一个关键能力尚未被充分探索：验证审稿人反馈是否真正带来了有意义且基于证据的手稿改进。这一能力对可靠的AI辅助科学工作流至关重要。
AI.method: 利用透明的同行评审记录作为自然监督来源，包括审稿人评论（指出科学关切）、作者回复（描述声称的解决方式）和修订手稿（提供变更证据）。模型需要完成三个任务：刻画审稿人关切、判断关切是否被解决、识别支持性手稿证据。基于56,000篇Nature Communications论文构建数据集。
AI.result: LLM在刻画审稿人关切方面表现良好，GPT-5.5达到0.754分；但基于证据的验证是主要瓶颈，最佳模型仅达到0.501分。此外还进行了消融实验和案例分析。
AI.conclusion: 尽管LLM能较好地理解审稿人关切的语义，但在证据驱动的验证任务上仍存在显著差距，这为未来提升AI辅助科学评审的可靠性指明了改进方向。

title: Articulated Object Reconstruction from Rest-State Observation
summary: Building interactive digital twins requires recovering both 3D geometry and the kinematic structures that govern how objects articulate. Yet existing methods for articulated object reconstruction require explicitly observable motion from multiple articulation states. We introduce a rest-state formulation that reconstructs articulated objects from a single closed configuration, an inherently ill-posed setting where geometry, semantics, and motion priors compensate for the absence of motion cues. Our framework adopts an explicit mesh as an intermediate representation for cross-model verification and fusion, reconciling noisy outputs from vision-language and segmentation models into spatially consistent part structures. To estimate joint parameters without observed motion, we use a video diffusion model to synthesize articulation hypotheses and validate them through geometric consistency. Our approach achieves accurate part decomposition and physically plausible articulation, performing competitively with motion-observing reconstruction-based, generation-based, and modular pretrained-model baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于静止状态（rest-state）公式的关节物体重建方法，仅从单个封闭构型即可重建3D几何和运动学结构，利用视频扩散模型合成关节运动假设并通过几何一致性验证，在无需观测运动的情况下实现与基于运动观测的方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有关节物体重建方法都要求从多个运动状态中显式观测运动，这在实际应用中难以满足。本文旨在解决从单个封闭构型重建关节物体这一病态问题，利用几何、语义和运动先验来弥补运动线索的缺失。
AI.method: 采用显式网格作为中间表示进行跨模型验证与融合，将视觉语言模型和分割模型的噪声输出调和为空间一致的部分结构；通过视频扩散模型合成关节运动假设，并利用几何一致性进行验证以估计无观测运动下的关节参数。
AI.result: 方法实现了准确的部分分解和物理合理的关节运动，在性能上与基于运动观测的重建方法、基于生成的方法以及模块化预训练模型基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 仅从静止状态即可有效重建关节物体，验证了几何、语义与运动先验能够替代运动观测在关节重建中的关键作用。

title: World Action Planner: Generalizable Decision-Making with Action-Conditioned World Models
summary: Building generalizable agents for diverse applications remains a fundamental challenge. While imitation learning-based policies succeed in specific training environments, they often fail to generalize to novel scenes and tasks. In this work, we propose World Action Planner, a robot planning system that leverages the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and the physical grounding of a multi-task pose-image conditioned world model. Our system enables an agent to propose initial action plans and iteratively refine them via optimization and search, reasoning over imagined world model rollouts. We demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance across compositional tasks, new layouts, and zero-shot generalization scenarios, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art end-to-end policy models such as VLAs and WAMs. Project website at worldactionplanner.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出World Action Planner，一个结合视觉语言模型推理能力与多任务位姿-图像条件世界模型的机器人规划系统。该系统能够提出初始动作计划，并通过在世界模型滚动推演上进行优化和搜索来迭代细化，在组合任务、新布局和零样本泛化场景中显著优于现有端到端策略模型。
AI.motivation: 基于模仿学习的策略在特定训练环境中表现良好，但难以泛化到新场景和新任务，构建通用智能体仍然是一个根本性挑战。
AI.method: 结合VLM的推理能力与多任务位姿-图像条件世界模型的物理基础，通过想象世界模型滚动推演来提出初始动作计划，并采用优化和搜索策略进行迭代细化。
AI.result: 在组合任务、新布局和零样本泛化场景中表现出优越性能，显著超越VLA和WAM等最先进的端到端策略模型。
AI.conclusion: World Action Planner通过世界模型与VLM的协同作用，有效提升了机器人规划的泛化能力，为通用机器人智能体的构建提供了新思路。

title: Beyond Feeling Better: Capability-Sustaining Emotional Dialogue as a Longitudinal Research Paradigm
summary: Emotional dialogue research includes two influential strategy traditions. Empathetic dialogue prioritizes understanding a speaker's emotional experience. Emotional support conversation selects and sequences support for the seeker's current needs. Sustained use introduces a further goal. Effective support should sustain users' capacities for emotion regulation, coping, self-endorsed decisions, and social connection across the interaction lifecycle. We propose capability-sustaining emotional dialogue (CSED) as a longitudinal research paradigm that aligns supportive strategy with this goal and organizes data, models, system design, evaluation, and governance around repeated use, non-use, transition, and termination. A targeted literature-and-corpus audit motivates this position. In a PRISMA-ScR-guided sample, 95% of 60 system-building papers pursue relief-oriented goals. None evaluates capability or longitudinal outcomes, and only 1 considers dependency, autonomy, or termination risk. In 300 ESConv supporter turns, capability-relevant functions appear in 43.0%, while generic suggestions account for 22.0%, compared with 4.0% reappraisal, 6.7% self-efficacy support, and 0.3% boundary behavior. We release a protocol for extending the audit to model behavior. An illustrative process model connects latent user capability to six design commitments, four evaluation timescales, and lifecycle constraints. The resulting agenda makes CSED testable across data, policy design, training, evaluation, and governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出能力维持型情感对话（CSED）作为纵向研究范式，强调情感支持对话的目标不仅是即时缓解情绪，还应持续维持用户在情绪调节、应对、自主决策和社交连接方面的能力。通过文献审计发现现有系统普遍追求缓解导向目标，缺乏对能力维持和长期效果的评估。
AI.motivation: 现有情感对话研究存在两条传统路线：共情对话侧重理解说话者的情感体验，情感支持对话侧重选择和排序支持策略。但在持续使用场景下，有效的支持应维持用户在整个交互生命周期中的情绪调节、应对和自我决策能力，而现有研究缺乏对这一纵向目标的关注。
AI.method: 作者进行了PRISMA-ScR引导的文献审计：60篇系统构建论文中有95%追求缓解导向目标，无一评估能力或纵向结果。同时在300个ESConv支持者回合中分析了能力相关功能的出现频率（43.0%），对比了通用建议（22.0%）、重评（4.0%）、自我效能支持（6.7%）和边界行为（0.3%）。提出了一个将潜在用户能力与六个设计承诺、四个评估时间尺度和生命周期约束联系起来的示例过程模型。
AI.result: 文献审计揭示：95%的现有系统论文仅追求缓解导向目标，缺乏对能力维持和纵向结果的评估，仅1篇考虑依赖、自主或终止风险。语料分析显示能力相关功能占43.0%，但关键支持策略（重评、自我效能）占比较低。研究发布了扩展审计协议，并提出了可测试的CSED研究议程。
AI.conclusion: CSED将情感对话研究从短期缓解导向转向长期能力维持导向，通过将数据、模型、系统设计、评估和治理与重复使用、非使用、过渡和终止等生命周期阶段对齐，使纵向情感支持成为可测试的研究方向。

title: EgoGVAE: Ego-body Mesh Reconstruction via Guided Variational Autoencoder
summary: We address the problem of recovering the full-body mesh from only the head pose. This task has become essential for various applications based on head-mounted devices or smart glasses. The challenge of this task lies in estimating the pose information of unobserved body parts based solely on a single joint (i.e., head) trajectory. Several studies have begun to adopt head-conditioned generative models, however, such previous methods are costly and time-consuming due to the diffusion-based iterative process. As an alternative, we propose a simple yet novel method that leverages the latent space of the guidance network, which is designed as a variational autoencoder taking full-body poses as inputs. By enforcing latent distributions of this guidance network and our head-to-motion network to be similar, latent features sampled from the 'guided' distribution, i.e., distribution learned in our head-to-motion network, can be reliably decoded for natural representations of full-body poses even only with the head pose. One important advantage of the proposed method is that one-step sampling scheme achieves remarkably fast inference (more than 50 times faster) compared to diffusion-based approaches. Experimental results on benchmark datasets show that the proposed method efficiently improves the performance of ego-body mesh reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅利用头部姿态恢复全身网格的方法。通过变分自编码器作为引导网络，使头部到运动网络的潜在分布与引导网络相似，实现一步采样方案，比扩散方法快50倍以上，同时提升全身网格重建性能。
AI.motivation: 基于头戴设备或智能眼镜的应用需要仅从头部姿态恢复全身网格，但现有基于扩散的头部条件生成模型成本高、耗时长，需要更高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出一种简单新颖的方法：利用以全身姿态为输入的变分自编码器作为引导网络，通过强制引导网络与头部到运动网络的潜在分布相似，使仅从头部姿态采样的潜在特征能被可靠解码为自然的全身姿态。采用一步采样方案实现快速推理。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效提升了自身身体网格重建的性能，推理速度比基于扩散的方法快50倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持高质量全身姿态重建的同时，通过一步采样大幅提升推理效率，为头部受限场景下的全身运动重建提供了高效可行的解决方案。

title: CORE: In-Context Reconstruction for Unified Tabular Anomaly Detection
summary: Tabular anomaly detection (TAD), which focuses on identifying abnormal samples that deviate from the majority in tabular data, has received growing attention. Recently, there has been an emerging trend towards unified TAD, which seeks to detect anomalies across different datasets using a single generalizable model. In unified TAD, aligning heterogeneous data remains challenging. While existing methods often rely on distance-based unified feature construction, they may obscure the semantics of the original features. Moreover, existing approaches typically formulate anomaly detection as a binary classification task, which may overlook diverse anomaly patterns from various datasets and be misled by unrepresentative synthetic anomalies. To address these challenges, we propose an in-COntext REconstruction approach for unified TAD (CORE for short). It introduces a decorrelated feature alignment module to directly align heterogeneous features into a unified representation space, which retains their semantic information. Meanwhile, CORE formulates unified TAD as an in-context reconstruction problem, eliminating the need for labeled or synthesized anomalies. Specifically, the in-context reconstruction module reconstructs each sample by leveraging contextual normal samples to capture dataset-specific distributions, such that reconstruction errors reflect its deviation from normality, facilitating unified TAD on arbitrary unseen datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于上下文重建的统一表格异常检测方法CORE，通过去相关特征对齐模块和多上下文重建模块，无需标签或合成异常即可在任意未见数据集上进行统一的异常检测。
AI.motivation: 现有的统一表格异常检测方法存在两个主要问题：一是基于距离的统一特征构建可能掩盖原始特征的语义信息，导致异构数据对齐困难；二是将异常检测视为二分类任务，可能忽略不同数据集中的多样异常模式，并被不具有代表性的合成异常误导。
AI.method: CORE包含两个核心模块：1）去相关特征对齐模块，直接将异构特征对齐到统一表示空间并保留语义信息；2）上下文重建模块，通过利用上下文正常样本重建每个样本以捕捉数据集特定的分布，使重建误差反映样本偏离正常状态的程度，从而无需标签或合成异常即可进行统一异常检测。
AI.result: 将统一TAD问题重新定义为上下文重建问题，避免了依赖标签或合成异常，使得模型能够在任意未见数据集上进行异常检测。
AI.conclusion: CORE通过保留特征语义的对齐方式和基于重建的异常检测范式，有效解决了统一表格异常检测中的异构数据对齐和异常模式多样性问题。

title: FinanceHarness: Autonomous Financial Deep Research Framework
summary: Powered by advances in LLMs and autonomous agents, deep research has become one of the most widely adopted agentic products. However, most deep research systems write general-purpose reports, which are inadequate for financial deep research. Financial research demands specialized knowledge to analyze historical patterns and forecast upcoming events. Automating financial deep research therefore requires both a layered harness to drive the research agent and a verifiable, point-in-time benchmark that prevents leakage of future information. We present FinanceHarness, a harness that runs finance-oriented tools and practitioner-guided workflows, automating financial deep research end to end: environment and data construction, the agent execution loop, and reward modeling. We further propose FinanceGym, comprising thesis-driven research questions and rubrics that combine pre-cutoff and post-cutoff criteria. Professional expert validation yields an 82% pass rate. Even leading LLMs and agents score below 40% on the rubrics, showing that FinanceGym is challenging and leaves substantial headroom. With the same open-weight backbone, FinanceHarness improves the overall rubric score from 25.3% to 32.4%. FinanceHarness is available at https://github.com/Yijia-Xiao/FinanceHarness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinanceHarness——一个面向金融深度研究的自动化框架，包含工具层、代理执行循环和奖励建模，并配套提出FinanceGym基准（基于论文驱动的研究问题和评分标准）。专家验证通过率达82%，而顶尖LLM和代理的得分低于40%，同时FinanceHarness将开源权重模型的评分从25.3%提升至32.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究系统生成的是一般性报告，无法满足金融研究的需求。金融研究需要专业知识来分析历史模式和预测未来事件，且要求防止未来信息泄露的可验证、时点基准。
AI.method: 构建FinanceHarness分层框架，涵盖环境与数据构建、代理执行循环（集成金融工具和实践者引导的工作流）以及奖励建模；同时提出FinanceGym基准，包含论文驱动的研究问题及结合截止前和截止后标准的评分规则。
AI.result: 专业专家验证通过率为82%；顶尖LLM和代理在评分标准上得分低于40%；使用相同开源权重骨干，FinanceHarness将整体评分从25.3%提升至32.4%。
AI.conclusion: FinanceGym对现有模型具有挑战性且留有较大提升空间，FinanceHarness能有效提升金融深度研究的自动化水平。

title: Hidden APIs in Language Models: Discovering Reusable Causal Interfaces from Forked Futures
summary: Identical language-model answers can arise from hidden states that support different future computations, so current-answer probes do not establish a reusable internal interface. We introduce forked futures: future operations are sampled only after a prefix state has formed, and states are compared through the response distributions induced by those operations. This yields an empirical causal quotient over hidden states without requiring researcher-specified latent labels. Shared, Local, Mixture, and Distributed interfaces then compete under prequential causal description length subject to future-signature fidelity and matched capacity constraints. In the two detailed model evaluations, Shared has the lowest held-out description length, with gains of 0.216 nats on Qwen2.5-1.5B and 0.294 nats on Llama-3-8B, while maintaining tightly clustered mean future-signature distortion; a five-backbone sweep preserves the positive direction of Sharedness Gain. The figure-aligned transplantation analysis gives Shared the strongest joint target-correctness, locality, copy-preservation, and composite profile, and API-aligned paths mediate 0.749 of the target effect versus 0.150 for matched null paths. In the blind four-class model-organism test, 14/16 architectures are recovered, with one observed non-Shared to Shared error among 12 non-Shared organisms. These results support an economical reusable causal interface within the tested operation banks, while keeping the claim explicitly conditional on the candidate architectures, interventions, and held-out futures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"分叉未来"（forked futures）方法，通过未来操作采样后的响应分布比较隐状态，建立经验因果商，并在多种接口架构（Shared、Local、Mixture、Distributed）中比较，发现Shared接口在多个模型上具有最低的持出描述长度（Qwen2.5-1.5B上增益0.216 nats，Llama-3-8B上增益0.294 nats），且在移植分析、路径中介和盲测识别中表现最优。
AI.motivation: 现有的答案探针（answer probes）无法真正验证可复用的内部接口，因为相同的语言模型输出可能源自支持不同未来计算的隐状态。需要一种不依赖研究者指定潜在标签的方法来建立隐状态之间的因果等价关系，从而识别真正可复用的内部接口。
AI.method: 引入"分叉未来"框架：在前缀状态形成后才采样未来操作，通过操作诱导的响应分布来比较隐状态。提出经验因果商（empirical causal quotient）替代研究者指定的潜在标签。四种接口架构（Shared、Local、Mixture、Distributed）在预quential因果描述长度、未来签名保真度和容量匹配约束下竞争。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B上Shared接口描述长度增益0.216 nats，在Llama-3-8B上增益0.294 nats，均为最低；五个骨干模型扫描中Sharedness增益方向一致。移植分析中Shared在目标正确性、局部性、拷贝保持和复合画像上最强；API对齐路径中介0.749的目标效应（对照无效路径仅0.150）。盲测四类模型-生物实验中14/16的架构被正确恢复。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持在测试的操作库中存在经济可复用的因果接口（Shared），但结论明确限定于候选架构、干预方式和持出未来操作的范围内，不做过度泛化。

title: Memory Decoder at Scale: A Pretrained, Parametric Long-Term Memory
summary: Decoder-only language models entangle long-term memory and reasoning in a single parameter set, making it difficult to scale memory capacity independently. Memory Decoder introduces a parametric long-term memory module but only studies it at a relatively small scale. In this work, we present Memory Decoder at Scale, scaling memory models up to 6.9B parameters and pretraining them on 300B tokens. At this data scale, the combined cost of indexing and search makes a standard Faiss pipeline infeasible. We address this bottleneck with a distributed pipeline for Faiss indexing and retrieval, together with sparse, batch-wise loading of kNN distributions. Across model scales, we find that allocating more parameters to memory yields a better parameter-performance tradeoff than scaling the base model alone. On 17 benchmarks, pairing a 6.9B general memory with Pythia-410M raises its average score from 29.86 to 37.34, surpassing Pythia-12B (37.24) with 39% fewer total parameters. For Qwen3 Base models ranging from 0.6B to 14B, 1.7B domain memories improve the average score across the three domains by more than 9 points at every scale. Overall, our results demonstrate that independently scaling pretrained memory offers a more parameter efficient path to improving language model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Memory Decoder at Scale，将记忆增强语言模型扩展到6.9B参数和300B token的预训练规模，解决了大规模下Faiss索引与检索的计算瓶颈，并证明将更多参数分配给记忆模块比单独扩展基础模型具有更好的参数-性能权衡。
AI.motivation: Decoder-only语言模型将长期记忆与推理能力纠缠在单一参数集中，难以独立扩展记忆容量。尽管Memory Decoder引入了参数化长期记忆模块，但此前仅在较小规模下研究。本文旨在验证大规模下独立扩展记忆模块的参数效率。
AI.method: 提出了分布式Faiss索引和检索流水线，以及稀疏、批次化加载kNN分布的方法，以解决300B token规模下标准Faiss流水线不可行的问题。通过将记忆参数与基础模型参数分离，在不同规模下系统评估参数分配对性能的影响。
AI.result: 在17个基准上，6.9B通用记忆搭配Pythia-410M将平均得分从29.86提升至37.34，超过Pythia-12B（37.24）且总参数量少39%。对于Qwen3 Base模型（0.6B到14B），1.7B领域记忆在各规模上使三个领域的平均分提升超过9分。
AI.conclusion: 独立扩展预训练记忆模块提供了一条比扩展基础模型更参数高效的路径来提升语言模型性能。

title: Private Face Recognition Training Dataset Publication via Identity-Decoupled and Geometry-Preserving Face Distillation
summary: Publishing private face recognition~(FR) training datasets is privacy-sensitive because faces expose identity information. Private FR training dataset publication mitigates this risk by releasing protected proxies as substitutes for private training faces. However, training FR models with such data introduces an identity paradox: \emph{the identity cues that make released faces useful for recognition supervision are also the cues that make them linkable to real individuals.} A protected face should be decoupled from the original identity, yet still behave as a reliable identity sample for training. Removing these cues too aggressively may destroy the class structure needed for recognition learning, whereas preserving them too faithfully may increase source-identity linkability. We argue that this paradox stems from conflating source-aligned identity semantics with recognition-useful proxy identity geometry. The former should be suppressed to reduce linkage to private individuals, while the latter should be preserved for FR learning. Based on this insight, we propose \textbf{Private Face Distillation}, an identity-decoupling and geometry-preserving framework. It uses Orthogonal Geometry Preservation to construct decoupled proxy identities from private identity representations while maintaining hyperspherical geometry, and Relational Topology Alignment to preserve identity relations for recognition learning. Experiments across multiple domain-shifted FR scenarios show that Private Face Distillation achieves stronger utility than the evaluated publication baselines. On IJB-C surveillance, it improves $\mathrm{TAR}@\mathrm{FAR}{=}1\text{e-}{3}$ by 3.94\% over the baseline while reducing source-identity linkability. These results suggest that private FR training dataset publication should decouple source-identity correspondence while preserving proxy identity geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Private Face Distillation框架，通过解耦源身份语义与保留代理身份几何，解决私有面部识别训练数据集发布中的身份悖论问题，在多个跨域场景中优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 私有面部识别训练数据集发布面临身份悖论：用于识别监督的身份线索同时也是将其链接到真实个体的线索。过度移除这些线索会破坏识别学习所需的类结构，而保留过多则会增加身份链接风险。
AI.method: 提出Private Face Distillation框架，包含两个核心组件：1) Orthogonal Geometry Preservation（正交几何保持），从私有身份表示构建解耦的代理身份，同时维持超球面几何；2) Relational Topology Alignment（关系拓扑对齐），保留身份间关系以支持识别学习。
AI.result: 在多个跨域面部识别场景中，Private Face Distillation优于所有评估的发布基线。在IJB-C监控场景下，TAR@FAR=1e-3提升3.94%，同时降低了源身份链接风险。
AI.conclusion: 私有FR训练数据集发布应当解耦源身份对应关系，同时保留代理身份几何结构，二者可兼得而非相互矛盾。

title: SCOPE: Synthetic Conditional Objectives for Policy Evolution in Black-Box Combinatorial Optimization
comment: 43 pages; Kiet, Duc, and Bang contributed equally
summary: Black-box combinatorial optimization requires systematically identifying high-quality solutions under a limited evaluation budget, yet the unknown objective function provides little guidance for deciding where the search should explore next. We introduce SCOPE, a general framework for Synthetic Conditional Objectives for Policy Evolution in Black-Box Combinatorial Optimization. Rather than directly optimizing the inaccessible objective, SCOPE learns a set of synthetic objectives conditioned on the accumulated search history, where each objective is designed to expose a distinct and potentially useful preference over candidate solutions. These objectives are then used to evolve search policies that generate diverse candidates, whose true quality is subsequently assessed through black-box evaluations. The outer loop adaptively updates and selects synthetic objectives according to how effectively their induced policies discover promising regions. In contrast, the inner loop returns a portfolio of top-performing policies to reduce the risk of relying on a single surrogate preference. This formulation reframes objective design as a mechanism for guiding policy exploration, enabling the search process to exploit observed evidence while maintaining structured diversity across discrete solution spaces. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark problems demonstrate that SCOPE consistently improves black-box search performance under limited evaluation budgets and generalizes well across diverse combinatorial structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOPE框架，通过学习条件化的合成目标来指导黑盒组合优化中的策略演化，在有限评估预算下提升搜索性能。
AI.motivation: 黑盒组合优化中，未知目标函数无法为搜索方向的探索提供有效指导，导致在有限的评估预算下难以系统性找到高质量解。
AI.method: SCOPE框架包含内外双层循环：外层根据搜索历史自适应地更新和选择一组条件化的合成目标，每个目标代表对候选解的不同偏好；内层利用这些目标演化出多样化候选生成的搜索策略，并返回一组高性能策略组合以降低对单一替代偏好的依赖。
AI.result: 在多个基准问题上，SCOPE在有限评估预算下持续提升黑盒搜索性能，并能很好地泛化到多种不同的组合结构。
AI.conclusion: 目标设计可以作为一种引导策略探索的机制，使搜索过程在利用已有证据的同时保持离散解空间中的结构化多样性。

title: RepBench: Compiling Benchmarks into Capability Representations for Large Language Models
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, with appendices. Yanshi Li and Xueru Bai contributed equally
summary: Representation engineering reads and steers capability directions in large language models, yet methods are typically evaluated on paper-specific synthetic data. The resulting measurements are difficult to compare or reproduce and may reflect surface patterns rather than capabilities. We present RepBench, a benchmark-grounded data layer for capability-aligned representation probing. Crawling 13,427 benchmark papers yields a taxonomy of 182 capability clusters in 13 families; harvesting 353 public benchmark datasets yields 46,149 audited probe texts covering 94 capabilities, each supported by at least two independent benchmarks. This multi-benchmark design reduces dependence on any single source: raw per-text vectors exhibit no natural cluster granularity, whereas benchmark-pooled capability vectors show an interior clustering optimum at a small number of clusters on all 12 evaluated models, with low agreement to the human taxonomy. Under cross-benchmark transfer evaluation across twelve models completed by all four readouts, difference-in-means attains the highest model-level mean on ten models, while logistic regression wins the most capability-model cells. This disagreement shows that the readout method and aggregation criterion are meaningful evaluation dimensions. The pipeline, corpus, and evaluation code are released as a reusable closed-loop workflow.

AI.tldr: RepBench是一个面向能力对齐表示探测的基准数据层。它爬取了13,427篇基准论文，构建了182个能力簇的分类体系，并从353个公开基准数据集中整理了46,149条带审计的探测文本，覆盖94种能力。研究发现，基准池化的能力向量在内部聚类上存在最优值，但与人写分类体系一致性低。跨基准迁移评估显示，差均值法在10个模型上取得最高模型级均值，而逻辑回归在最多能力-模型单元上获胜。
AI.motivation: 现有表示工程方法通常在论文特定的合成数据上进行评估，导致测量结果难以比较和复现，且可能反映表面模式而非真实能力。需要一个基准化的、能力对齐的统一评估数据层。
AI.method: 大规模爬取13,427篇基准论文构建182个能力簇（13个族）的分类体系；从353个公开基准数据集中整理46,149条审计探测文本，覆盖94种能力（每项至少由两个独立基准支持）；在12个模型上使用4种读出方法（包括差均值和逻辑回归）进行跨基准迁移评估。
AI.result: 原始逐文本向量无自然聚类粒度，而基准池化的能力向量在所有12个模型上呈现内部聚类最优（簇数较少），但与人类分类体系的低一致性。差均值法在10个模型上取得最高模型级均值，而逻辑回归在最多能力-模型单元上获胜，表明读出方法和聚合标准是有意义的评估维度。
AI.conclusion: RepBench提供了一个可复用的闭环工作流（管道、语料库和评估代码均已开源），为能力对齐表示探测提供了大规模、多基准支撑的标准化评估基础设施，揭示了不同读出方法在能力探测中的差异性。

title: ReDiPPO: Reference-Guided Value Calibration and Discrepancy-Aware Token Reweighting for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for enhancing the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Among existing policy optimization methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) remains particularly appealing because its learned critic can, in principle, provide token-level credit assignment. However, in mathematical reasoning tasks characterized by long reasoning horizons and sparse outcome rewards, reliable token-level credit assignment remains challenging. The standard critic often fails to accurately evaluate intermediate reasoning states, resulting in noisy advantage estimates and suboptimal policy updates. In this paper, we propose ReDiPPO, a Reference-guided and Discrepancy-aware PPO framework for mathematical reasoning. ReDiPPO introduces a reference-guided critic that uses reference answers as training-time privileged signals to provide more accurate value estimation. Meanwhile, it retains a standard critic and quantifies the token-level reference-standard discrepancy between the standard value estimate and the reference-guided value estimate. This discrepancy serves as an indicator of difficult reasoning states and is used to reweight the corresponding token-level advantages during PPO optimization. Extensive experiments on diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ReDiPPO improves value-estimation accuracy and consistently outperforms strong policy optimization baselines, including PPO, DAPO, and GSPO, in final reasoning performance. Our code is available on https://github.com/cii030/ReDiPPO.

AI.tldr: ReDiPPO是一个用于数学推理任务的参考引导且带差异感知的PPO框架，通过参考答案作为训练时的特权信号来提升价值估计准确性，并利用参考-标准价值估计的差异来重加权token级优势，在多个数学推理基准上优于PPO、DAPO和GSPO等基线。
AI.motivation: 在长推理链和稀疏结果奖励的数学推理任务中，标准PPO的critic难以准确评估中间推理状态，导致token级优势估计存在噪声，进而产生次优的策略更新。
AI.method: ReDiPPO包含两个核心组件：(1) 参考引导的critic，利用参考答案作为训练时的特权信号来提供更准确的价值估计；(2) 保留一个标准critic，量化标准价值估计与参考引导价值估计之间的token级差异，该差异作为困难推理状态的指示器，用于在PPO优化中对相应token级优势进行重加权。
AI.result: 在多种数学推理基准上的大量实验表明，ReDiPPO提升了价值估计的准确性，并在最终推理性能上一致性地优于PPO、DAPO和GSPO等强策略优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入参考引导和差异感知机制，ReDiPPO有效解决了数学推理中长推理链和稀疏奖励下的token级信用分配难题，为提升大语言模型数学推理能力提供了新的策略优化方向。

title: LEEPS: Latent-Guided Explore-Exploit Prompt Sampling for Efficient RLVR in Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but prompt groups with identical rollout rewards consume generation budget without effective learning signals. Pre-rollout prompt selection can reduce this waste by screening prompts before rollout generation. However, existing pre-rollout methods struggle to balance exploitation and exploration: repeatedly exploiting historically informative prompts can narrow training coverage, whereas broader exploration can lower the fraction of informative prompts. To address these limitations, we introduce LEEPS, a Latent-Guided Explore--Exploit Prompt Sampler that adaptively balances the reuse of previously observed informative prompts with continued exploration of uncertain ones. LEEPS partitions candidates into exploit and explore portfolios and adaptively allocates rollout budget according to their recent non-trivial ratios. It further uses representation-space neighbors and historical rollout outcomes to prioritize uncertain prompts likely to yield non-zero reward variance, thereby making exploration more targeted without additional rollouts. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, LEEPS achieves the highest average score at both model scales, with relative gains of 2.6\% and 3.7\% over the strongest baseline for Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and 7B, respectively, and generally improves faster during the training process. It also achieves the highest average score across the three evaluated OOD general-reasoning benchmarks at both model scales and adds only about 2 seconds of online sampling overhead per training step. Code is available at https://github.com/ShuangLiangX/LEEPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LEEPS（Latent-Guided Explore–Exploit Prompt Sampler），一种面向RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）的提示词采样方法，通过自适应的探索-利用平衡机制，在提示词选择阶段筛选高信息量样本，减少预算浪费并提升推理能力。
AI.motivation: RLVR能提升大模型推理能力，但相同rollout奖励的提示词组会浪费生成预算且缺乏有效学习信号。现有rollout前提示词筛选方法难以平衡利用与探索：过度利用历史信息提示词会缩小训练覆盖范围，而过度探索则会降低信息提示词比例。
AI.method: LEEPS将候选提示词划分为利用组合和探索组合，根据近期非平凡比率（non-trivial ratios）自适应分配rollout预算。利用表示空间中的邻居和历史rollout结果，优先选择可能产生非零奖励方差的潜在提示词，使探索更具针对性且无需额外rollout。
AI.result: 在六个数学推理基准上，LEEPS在两种模型规模下均取得最高平均分，相对最强基线分别提升2.6%（Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B）和3.7%（Qwen2.5-Math-7B）；在训练过程中收敛更快；在三个OOD通用推理基准上也取得最高平均分，在线采样开销仅约每训练步2秒。
AI.conclusion: LEEPS通过自适应探索-利用平衡和潜在空间引导的定向探索，有效解决了RLVR中提示词选择的信息利用率问题，在提升训练效率的同时保持了良好的泛化能力，且计算开销极小。

title: FDDWAN: A Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Network for Watermarking Attack
summary: Existing invisible watermark removal methods often struggle to accurately capture the watermark-bearing features, leading to an unfavorable trade-off between watermark suppression and perceptual fidelity. In this paper, we propose the Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Watermark Attack Network (FDDWAN), a coarse-to-fine framework that performs watermark removal through wavelet-domain decomposition and residual diffusion refinement. In the initial stage, the Wavelet-based Frequency-domain Preliminary Attack Module (WFPAM) decomposes the watermarked image into low- and high-frequency subbands and applies frequency-specific attack strategies tailored to their respective contributions to watermark robustness and perceptual quality. In the next stage, the Frequency-domain Residual Diffusion Attack Module (FRDAM) separately models the residual distributions between the preliminarily attacked outputs and the corresponding watermark-free references during training.
