Rather than reconstructing the entire image, FRDAM selectively refines frequency-domain residuals, directing the diffusion process toward the remaining watermark related discrepancies while minimizing modifications to image content. Extensive experiments on CelebA and ImageNet across four representative watermarking schemes demonstrate that FDDWAN achieves a more favorable trade-off between watermark removal effectiveness and visual fidelity than conventional and learning-based attack methods.

AI.tldr: 提出FDDWAN，一种频率解耦的扩散水印攻击网络，通过小波域分解和残差扩散精修实现粗到细的水印去除，在抑制水印与保持视觉保真度之间取得更优平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的不可见水印去除方法难以准确捕获水印承载特征，导致水印抑制效果与感知保真度之间存在不利的权衡。
AI.method: 采用两阶段粗到细框架：(1) WFPAM模块将水印图像分解为低频和高频子带，并针对各自对水印鲁棒性和感知质量的贡献应用频率特定的攻击策略；(2) FRDAM模块在训练期间分别建模初步攻击输出与无水印参考之间的残差分布，选择性地细化频域残差，引导扩散过程聚焦于剩余水印相关差异。
AI.result: 在CelebA和ImageNet数据集上，跨越四种代表性水印方案的广泛实验表明，FDDWAN在去除水印效果和视觉保真度之间实现了比传统方法和学习型攻击方法更优的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过频域解耦和残差扩散精修，FDDWAN有效解决了水印去除中的效果与保真度权衡问题，为水印攻击提供了更优方案。

title: HealthCAT: An Interpretable Encoder-only Transformer Framework for Health Indicator Prediction and Temporal Interpretation of Wearable Sensor Data
summary: Wearable sensors continuously capture fine-grained multivariate time-series data, providing opportunities to model behavioural patterns associated with health outcomes. However, existing deep learning methods prioritise predictive accuracy over interpretability, limiting their application in health research. In this study, we present HealthCAT, a flexible framework that integrates an Encoder-only Transformer with an Attentive Class Activation Token (AttentiveCAT) to generate class-specific, time-step-level interpretations. These interpretations can be mapped back onto behavioural cycles that are relevant to the domain (e.g., time-of-day), supporting individual-level analysis of wearable sensor data. We evaluated HealthCAT using two real-world wearable sensor datasets (306 participants in total). HealthCAT outperformed deep learning baselines by up to 17\% in F1-score and 12\% in accuracy on both datasets ($p<0.05$). In masking experiments, the time steps identified by HealthCAT carried significantly more predictive value than random selection across all masking conditions ($p<0.05$), indicating that the identified time steps are predictively informative. By coupling predictive performance with validated time-step-level interpretability, HealthCAT moves wearable sensor analysis beyond aggregated metrics towards temporal patterns that support health monitoring, behavioural pattern analysis, and intervention design in health research. The significance of this work is that it enables accurate prediction of health indicators from wearable sensor data while providing insights into when and how physical activity patterns occur, rather than relying solely on aggregated summary measures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HealthCAT框架，将Encoder-only Transformer与Attentive Class Activation Token（AttentiveCAT）相结合，在保持高预测性能的同时，为可穿戴传感器数据提供类别特异性的时间步级可解释性，并可将解释映射回行为周期（如一天中的时段），实现个体层面的行为模式分析。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴传感器能够连续采集细粒度的多变量时间序列数据，为建模健康相关的行为模式提供了机会。然而，现有深度学习方法过于注重预测准确性而忽视可解释性，限制了其在健康研究中的应用价值。
AI.method: HealthCAT框架包含两个关键组件：（1）Encoder-only Transformer作为骨干网络进行时序特征提取；（2）Attentive Class Activation Token（AttentiveCAT）机制生成类别特异性、时间步级（time-step-level）的解释，这些解释可映射回与领域相关的行为周期（如时间段），支持个体层面的可穿戴数据分析。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界可穿戴传感器数据集（共306名参与者）上，HealthCAT相比深度学习基线在F1分数上最高提升17%，准确率上最高提升12%（p<0.05）。在掩码实验中，HealthCAT识别的时间步在所有掩码条件下比随机选择具有显著更高的预测价值（p<0.05），验证了所识别时间步的预测信息有效性。
AI.conclusion: HealthCAT通过将预测性能与经过验证的时间步级可解释性相结合，将可穿戴传感器分析从聚合式指标推向时间模式层面，能够支持健康监测、行为模式分析和干预设计。其核心贡献在于既能准确预测健康指标，又能揭示身体活动模式在何时以及如何发生，而非仅依赖聚合摘要度量。

title: GGC: Selective Query Correction for Reliable Text-to-SPARQL Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in structured query generation, making them a natural choice for Text-to-SPARQL, which translates natural language questions into executable SPARQL queries over knowledge graphs. However, their initial outputs remain unreliable: generated queries may be executable yet semantically misaligned with input questions, leading to incorrect retrieval. To address this issue, we propose Generator-Gate-Corrector (GGC), a framework for reliable LLM-based Text-to-SPARQL generation. GGC first uses a Generator to produce an initial query, then applies a Gate to predict whether correction is needed, and finally invokes a Corrector only for selected high-risk queries. This selective correction mechanism avoids unnecessary modifications and reduces the risk of degrading originally correct queries. Experiments on MCQA show that GGC improves query-level accuracy from 90.23\% to 98.33\% while reducing inference overhead by 45\% compared with correcting all generated queries. Ablation studies show that the Gate is robust across thresholds and that Corrector training data composition affects correction effectiveness and stability. Overall, the results demonstrate that selective correction enhances the accuracy, reliability, and efficiency of LLM-based text-to-SPARQL generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GGC框架，通过生成器-门控-修正器的选择性修正机制，提升LLM在Text-to-SPARQL任务中的可靠性，在MCQA上查询准确率从90.23%提升至98.33%，同时推理开销降低45%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在文本到SPARQL查询生成中虽表现出色，但初始输出不可靠——生成的查询可能可执行却与输入问题语义不一致，导致错误检索结果。需要一种机制在保持准确性的同时避免过度修正原本正确的查询。
AI.method: 提出Generator-Gate-Corrector（GGC）框架，包含三个组件：Generator生成初始查询；Gate预测是否需要修正；Corrector仅对高风险查询执行修正。通过选择性修正机制避免不必要的修改，降低对原本正确查询的降级风险。
AI.result: 在MCQA数据集上，查询级准确率从90.23%提升至98.33%，推理开销相比全量修正降低45%。消融实验表明Gate在不同阈值下具有鲁棒性，Corrector训练数据构成会影响修正效果和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 选择性修正机制能够显著提升LLM文本到SPARQL生成的准确性、可靠性和效率，是一种有效的框架设计思路。

title: HALO: Heterogeneous Admission through Localized Obligations for Safe Agentic Execution
summary: Recent agentic AI systems may return a heterogeneous response containing notices, requests, handoffs, and actions. Conditions can change before external use, so components from the same response need not remain supported together. Rejecting the whole response discards useful components, whereas checking components independently can leave a dependent without its prerequisite. We present Heterogeneous Admission with Localized Obligations (HALO), a runtime protocol that preserves supported components whose declared prerequisites also remain supported, rechecks each exact action before dispatch, and allows blocked actions to be replaced only by fresh candidates. HALO matched all 96 admission expectations and passed all 20 protocol tests. In structured-response replay, it retained 248/248 supported components, including 128/128 unaffected by unrelated changes, while a whole-response policy retained 0/248. Across ten cold-start PX4/Gazebo sessions, HALO blocked every tested stale route, observed no matching stale setpoint, and completed all fresh recoveries.

AI.tldr: 提出了HALO协议，一种针对异构代理AI响应的运行时准入协议，通过组件级准入检查保留仍受支持的组件，同时为被阻止的动作提供新鲜替换候选，在测试中显著优于整体拒绝策略。
AI.motivation: 现有代理AI系统可能返回包含通知、请求、交接和动作的异构响应，但外部使用前条件可能发生变化，导致同一响应的部分组件不再受支持。整体拒绝会丢弃仍然有效的组件，而独立检查组件可能使依赖关系失效。
AI.method: HALO运行时协议采用异构准入与局部义务策略：仅保留声明的前置条件仍然受支持的组件，在派发前重新检查每个精确动作，并仅允许用新鲜候选替换被阻止的动作。
AI.result: HALO匹配了全部96项准入预期并通过20项协议测试。在结构化响应回放中保留了248/248个受支持组件（其中128/128不受无关变更影响），而整体响应策略保留0/248。在十次PX4/Gazebo冷启动会话中，阻止了所有测试的过期路线，未观察到失配的过期设定点，并完成所有新鲜恢复。
AI.conclusion: HALO通过组件级粒度保留支持的组件、拒绝不支持的组件并提供新鲜替换，有效解决了异构代理响应在动态环境中因条件变化导致的组件失效问题，显著优于整体拒绝策略。

title: Challenges in annotations by humans and LLMs: A case study of evaluative language
summary: In this paper, we draw a comparison between linguists in training, a trained linguist, and annotations generated by large language models (LLMs) to find out if they struggle with complex linguistic phenomena in a similar way. For this purpose, we analyse evaluative language in spoken popular science discourse, with the example of a corpus of English TED talk transcripts. We focus on the Appraisal theory and its Attitude subsystem, including the categories (classes) of Affect, Judgement, and Appreciation. In this context, Appraisal theory is an example of a highly subjective annotation task, making it a suitable example for the study of complex annotation challenges. First, we assess human annotations on a sentence level in specific scientific domains. Then, we develop three prompts and compare them for model performance for the automatic classification of Appraisal classes. We assess the performance of three LLMs using the best-performing prompt and finetune the model, reaching an F1-score of 0.77. We find that models perform best compared to annotations conducted by the trained linguist, while linguists in training do not reach high agreement scores. We conclude that LLMs can aid in complex annotation task resolution, opening new pathways for the complex theories annotated and analyzed in digital humanities studies.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了受训语言学家、语言学受训者和大语言模型（LLMs）在复杂语言学现象标注中的表现，以英语TED演讲语料为例，聚焦Appraisal理论中的Attitude子系统（情感、判断、欣赏三类）。研究发现LLMs在最佳提示和微调后达到F1分数0.77，模型表现最接近受过训练的语言学家，而受训语言学家的标注一致性较低，表明LLMs可在复杂标注任务中提供帮助。
AI.motivation: 复杂语言学现象（如Appraisal理论中的主观评价标注）对人类标注者来说具有高度挑战性，而LLMs在这类任务中的表现尚缺乏系统性比较研究。作者希望探究不同主体（语言学家受训者、专业语言学家、LLMs）在面对同一复杂标注任务时是否面临相似的困难。
AI.method: 首先，在特定科学领域的句子层面评估人类标注者（受训语言学家和专业语言学家）的标注表现。其次，开发三个提示（prompts）并比较其在自动分类Appraisal类别中的性能。然后使用最佳提示评估三个LLMs，并对模型进行微调，最终达到F1分数0.77。
AI.result: LLMs在最佳提示下表现最好，其标注结果接近受过训练的语言学家；而语言学受训者的标注一致性得分较低。微调后的模型达到了0.77的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: LLMs可以在复杂的标注任务中提供有效辅助，为数字人文学科中复杂理论的分析与标注开辟了新途径。

title: SPFM-Net: Semantic-Prior-Guided Frequency-Constrained Mamba for Invisible Watermark Attack
summary: Existing watermark attacks typically rely on predefined signal-processing operations or locally constrained restoration networks, making it difficult to capture the long-range dependencies of globally distributed watermark signals and resulting in an unfavorable trade-off between removal effectiveness and visual fidelity. In this paper, we propose SPFM-Net, a semantic-prior-guided and frequency-constrained Mamba framework for invisible watermark attack. SPFM-Net first employs high-ratio masking to disrupt the spatial coherence of invisible watermark signals, and then utilizes a partially fine-tuned pretrained Masked Autoencoder to reconstruct semantically consistent image from sparse observations while suppressing watermark-related information. A Multi-scale Residual Frequency Feature Interaction module subsequently aggregates watermark-related residual features across multiple receptive fields, while adaptively suppressing responses from watermark-irrelevant regions. To further capture the long-range dependencies of globally distributed watermark signals, a lightweight Mamba-based Global State-space Feature Modeling (GSFM) unit is introduced to separate watermark-related features from natural image content and suppress the remaining watermark traces. In addition, SPFM-Net is optimized using a multi-level objective that jointly imposes spatial-, frequency-, and edge-domain constraints, enabling effective watermark suppression while preserving perceptual quality. Extensive experiments on representative spatial-domain, transform-domain, orthogonal moment-based, and deep learning-based watermarking schemes demonstrate that SPFM-Net achieves a favorable trade-off between watermark attack effectiveness and perceptual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPFM-Net，一种基于语义先验引导和频率约束的Mamba框架，用于不可见水印攻击，通过高比例掩码、部分微调的MAE、多尺度残差频率特征交互模块和Mamba全局状态空间特征建模单元，在攻击有效性与视觉保真度之间取得良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有水印攻击方法依赖预定义信号处理操作或局部受限的复原网络，难以捕捉全局分布水印信号的长程依赖关系，导致去除效果与视觉保真度之间存在不利的权衡。
AI.method: SPFM-Net包含四个核心组件：(1)高比例掩码破坏水印信号的空间相干性；(2)部分微调的预训练掩码自编码器(MAE)从稀疏观测中重建语义一致的图像并抑制水印信息；(3)多尺度残差频率特征交互模块聚合多感受野的水印残差特征并抑制无关区域响应；(4)基于Mamba的轻量级全局状态空间特征建模单元捕捉全局水印信号的长程依赖。模型通过多层级目标函数在空间域、频率域和边缘域联合约束优化。
AI.result: 在代表性空间域、变换域、正交矩基和深度学习水印方案上的大量实验表明，SPFM-Net在攻击有效性与感知保真度之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: SPFM-Net通过语义先验引导与频率约束的Mamba框架，有效解决了现有方法难以捕获全局水印信号长程依赖的缺陷，在水印去除与图像质量保持之间实现了更优的折中。

title: FinSMART: Financial Sentiment Analysis for Algorithmic Trading through Market-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to a market-agnostic, supervised learning paradigm that relies on limited, static and human-annotated datasets, and thus are incapable of adapting to evolving market conditions. To address this limitation, we introduce FinSMART, the first market-aligned reinforcement learning framework for financial sentiment analysis, which directly optimizes sentiment signals using realized market outcomes. To deal with the noisy, non-stationary, and multifactorial nature of financial markets, FinSMART incorporates a signal extraction pipeline that combines market-aware data filtering with a discrete asymmetric trading reward, enabling stable reinforcement learning from economically meaningful market feedback. Experimental results demonstrate that FinSMART significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in profitability, risk-adjusted performance, and sentiment signal quality, improving cumulative trading returns by 220% over the strongest baseline. Uniquely, the FinSMART framework naturally supports market-aware retraining, at any point in time, by replacing costly manual annotation with newly observed financial articles and their realized market outcomes. Such a retraining strategy enables the model to continuously adapt to changing market dynamics, resulting in consistent performance gains over its static counterpart. These findings demonstrate the practical applicability of market-aligned reinforcement learning and highlight its potential as a next-generation paradigm for developing adaptive financial LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinSMART，这是首个面向金融情绪分析的市场对齐强化学习框架，利用真实市场结果直接优化情绪信号，克服了传统静态监督学习范式无法适应市场变化的局限。实验表明FinSMART在盈利性、风险调整表现和情绪信号质量上显著优于现有方法，累计交易收益比最强基线提升220%，并支持市场感知的持续重训练。
AI.motivation: 现有金融情绪分析方法依赖于静态、有限的人工标注数据集的监督学习范式，无法适应不断变化的市场条件。作者希望突破这一局限，使模型能够基于真实的市场经济反馈进行优化，从而实现对动态市场环境的持续适应。
AI.method: FinSMART框架包含两个核心组件：(1)信号提取流水线，结合市场感知的数据过滤与离散非对称交易奖励函数，以应对金融市场的噪声、非平稳性和多因素特性；(2)利用已实现的市场结果作为奖励信号进行强化学习优化，同时支持通过新观察到的金融文章及其市场结果替代人工标注来实现在任意时点的市场感知重训练。
AI.result: 实验结果显示FinSMART在盈利性、风险调整表现和情绪信号质量方面均显著优于现有最先进方法，累计交易收益比最强基线提升220%。此外，市场感知的重训练策略使模型能够持续适应市场动态变化，相较于静态模型取得了持续的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了市场对齐强化学习在金融情绪分析中的实际应用价值，展示了其作为开发自适应金融大语言模型的新一代范式的潜力。

title: Hallucinations Leave a Grounding Signature:Verifier-Guided Decoding for Selective Object Correction
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate objects that are absent from an image. Despite recent progress, existing mitigation methods still lack reliable object-level grounding diagnostics and therefore tend to apply coarse-grained interventions, which can impair visual understanding, shorten responses, and reduce coverage of genuinely grounded objects. The key challenge is thus to detect, during generation, whether each emerging object mention is supported by reliable visual evidence, so that hallucination can be mitigated selectively. Yet output confidence reflects next-token plausibility rather than visual support, allowing language priors to make absent objects appear certain. We show that the missing diagnostic evidence is encoded in an Intrinsic Grounding Signature (IGS), a distributed signed attention pattern that remains informative for such confident hallucinations. Based on IGS, we propose Verifier-Guided Decoding (VGD), a decoding framework in which a lightweight verifier examines each emerging object mention, rolls back the KV cache when the mention is identified as high risk, suppresses the object and its synonyms, and regenerates the affected continuation. Because VGD intervenes only on object mentions identified as high risk, it reduces object hallucination while preserving the model's original visual understanding and grounded object coverage. Experiments on CHAIR and AMBER-G show that VGD achieves state-of-the-art object hallucination reduction: at @rec90, it cuts AMBER-G CHAIR by 43.6\% while retaining 99.6\% of grounded-object coverage, and reduces CHAIR-MSCOCO CHAIR$_i$/CHAIR$_s$ by 37.0\%/30.4\% without shortening captions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于内在接地签名（IGS）的验证器引导解码（VGD）框架，用于选择性缓解大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）中的对象幻觉问题，在不损害视觉理解和接地对象覆盖的前提下，实现了最先进的对象幻觉降低效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的LVLM幻觉缓解方法缺乏可靠的对象级接地诊断，往往采用粗粒度的干预措施，会损害视觉理解、缩短响应并减少真正接地对象的覆盖。需要一种能够检测生成过程中每个对象提及是否由可靠的视觉证据支持的方法，从而实现选择性幻觉缓解。
AI.method: 作者发现缺失的诊断证据编码在内在接地签名（IGS）中——一种分布式带符号注意力模式，即使对于高置信度的幻觉对象也具有信息量。基于IGS，提出验证器引导解码（VGD）框架：轻量级验证器检查每个出现的对象提及，当识别为高风险时回滚KV缓存，抑制该对象及其同义词，并重新生成受影响的文本延续。
AI.result: 在CHAIR和AMBER-G基准上，VGD实现了最先进的对象幻觉降低效果：在@rec90下，AMBER-G CHAIR降低43.6%，同时保留99.6%的接地对象覆盖；CHAIR-MSCOCO的CHAIR_i/CHAIR_s分别降低37.0%/30.4%，且不缩短标题长度。
AI.conclusion: VGD通过只在识别为高风险的对象提及上进行干预，能够同时减少对象幻觉并保持模型原有的视觉理解和接地对象覆盖能力，验证了IGS作为对象级接地诊断信号的有效性。

title: Rehearse: Stepping Back from the Confidence Cliff in Self-Improving Autoresearch
summary: Autoresearch improves machine-learning code by proposing changes, running full training jobs, and keeping changes that improve the metric. The efficiency of this loop depends not only on generating ideas, but also on the agent's ability to decide, before spending a training run, whether a proposed modification is likely to work. We study how the reliability of this pre-execution judgment changes over the course of an autoresearch trajectory. In public AutoSOTA logs (Li et al., 2026; Tsinghua FIB Lab, 2026), the fraction of helpful modifications falls from 70% in the first two iterations to 43% by iteration 6+. On 296 same-baseline modification pairs from 39 paper-derived AutoSOTA tasks, each containing one modification that improved the metric and one that did not, with measured outcomes hidden, an LLM judge given candidate rationales but no prior-attempt history reaches 79.5% accuracy on the pairs where strict consensus returns a verdict. On the full 366-pair benchmark, however, this ability weakens substantially late in the loop. As successful changes accumulate, selective accuracy - accuracy conditioned on a strict-consensus verdict - falls from 82.8% to 56.9%, while the judge remains willing to decide. We call this operational pattern the confidence cliff. Rehearse implements the loop change as a lightweight skill for autoresearch loops: propose several ideas, compare them before execution, run the most promising, and judge with a focused memory of similar past attempts and outcomes. This focused outcome memory raises late selective accuracy to 83.5%. Across 4,000 budgeted training runs over three loops, Rehearse improves the endpoint under the same training-run budget on nanochat, image classification, and time-series forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自动研究（autoresearch）循环中预执行判断的可靠性问题，发现随着迭代进行会出现"置信度悬崖"（confidence cliff）现象——选择性准确率从82.8%降至56.9%。作者提出Rehearse方法，通过聚焦的过往尝试和结果记忆，将后期选择性准确率提升至83.5%，并在三个基准任务上以相同训练预算改善了最终结果。
AI.motivation: 自动研究循环的效率不仅依赖于生成想法，还依赖于智能体在执行完整训练之前判断修改是否可能有效的可靠性。然而，这种预执行判断能力如何随循环轨迹演化尚不清楚，需要研究。
AI.method: 首先基于公开AutoSOTA日志统计修改成功率随迭代的变化，构建296对同基线修改对（每对含一个有效一个无效修改）的基准测试。然后分析LLM评判器在有无历史信息条件下的准确率变化，识别"置信度悬崖"现象。最后提出Rehearse方法：提出多个想法、执行前比较、运行最有希望的修改，并用聚焦的过往尝试和结果记忆进行评判。
AI.result: LLM评判器在无历史信息时对严格共识对达到79.5%准确率。但后期选择性准确率从82.8%降至56.9%，呈现置信度悬崖。Rehearse的聚焦结果记忆将后期选择性准确率提升至83.5%。在4,000次预算训练运行中，Rehearse在nanochat、图像分类和时间序列预测三个循环上以相同训练预算改善了端点结果。
AI.conclusion: 预执行判断可靠性随自动研究循环推进显著下降，但通过轻量级的聚焦记忆机制（Rehearse）可以有效缓解这一退化，在不增加训练预算的情况下提升自动研究循环的整体效率。

title: Rethinking LLM-Judged Helpfulness as a Pedagogy Signal: A Pre-Registered Audit Across Tutor Models
summary: LLM tutoring poses a measurement problem: can a general-purpose helpfulness rubric distinguish direct answer-giving from pedagogical guidance? We audit this signal in a pre-registered study. Within each of three tutor bases, we compare conversational and pedagogical policies instantiated with the same underlying model and paired with one fixed weak simulated student. Deterministic detectors measure answer leakage and next-turn independent work. Claude Opus 4.8 is the frozen, condition-blind primary judge. After the Opus scores were fixed, GPT-5.6 Sol was prospectively specified for a post hoc robustness audit of the same 1,179 confirmatory answer-phase tutor turns under the frozen helpfulness and pedagogy rubrics. On the primary base under Opus, the policies do not differ significantly in helpfulness but are perfectly rank-separated under the pedagogy rubric (Cliff's $|δ|{=}0.10$ vs. $1.0$). Across the two judges, pedagogy contrasts retain their direction where detected, whereas the helpfulness ordering is judge-contingent, reversing between judges on two of three bases. In an Opus-only ablation, seven primary-base policies span $2.3$ points in mean judged pedagogy within a $0.25$-point band of mean judged helpfulness. Separately, answer-revealing turns are followed by less independent student work on every base, a result that is judge-invariant by construction. In this controlled setting, general-purpose helpfulness is not a reliable pedagogy signal. Tutor evaluation should pair pedagogy-targeted rubrics with deterministic process measures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预注册研究验证了通用有帮助性评分标准能否区分LLM辅导中的直接给答案与教学引导。结果表明，有帮助性评分在不同评判者间不一致且排序会反转，而针对性教学法评分标准和确定性过程指标则能稳定区分。
AI.motivation: LLM辅导面临测量难题：通用有帮助性评分标准能否有效区分直接给答案与教学引导？现有评估方法可能无法捕捉教学辅导的关键质量维度。
AI.method: 在三个辅导基座上，用同一底层模型实例化对话策略和教学策略，配对一个固定的弱模拟学生。使用确定性检测器测量答案泄漏和下一步独立工作。Claude Opus 4.8作为冻结的条件盲主评判者，事后用GPT-5.6 Sol对同样的1,179个确认性答题阶段辅导轮次进行鲁棒性审计。
AI.result: 主基座上，两种策略在有帮助性上无显著差异，但在教学法评分下完全分离（Cliff's |δ|=0.10 vs 1.0）。跨两个评判者，教学法对比方向保持一致，而有帮助性排序在三个基座中的两个上发生反转。Opus消融实验中，七个策略的平均教学法评分跨度2.3分，而平均有帮助性评分仅差0.25分。暴露答案的轮次在学生独立工作方面表现更差，且该结果不依赖评判者。
AI.conclusion: 在受控环境中，通用有帮助性不是可靠的教学信号。辅导评估应将针对教学法的评分标准与确定性过程指标结合使用。

title: Thinking Once Is Enough: Intermediate-Layer Evidence Routing for High-Resolution VQA
summary: High-resolution visual question answering (HR-VQA) is often treated as a problem of insufficient evidence acquisition, where failing multimodal large language models must inspect images again through cropping, re-encoding, or multi-round search. We show that this view is incomplete: in many cases, fine-grained evidence has already survived visual encoding and become identifiable and influential within an intermediate-layer routing window, but is later diluted before answer generation. We propose Thinking-Once, a \textbf{training-free, single-visual-pass} evidence-routing method that reconstructs question-conditioned attention at this window, preserves core entity tokens and compact background context, and routes this evidence to later layers without extra visual encoding. Across five base models, Thinking-Once consistently improves or matches the corresponding base setting, increasing the average scores on V$^*$Bench, HRBench-4K, and HRBench-8K by \textit{+3.1}, \textit{+3.0}, and \textit{+2.7} points while reducing the average peak memory by about 4,GB. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, it improves the three benchmarks by \textit{+9.9}, \textit{+4.6}, and \textit{+5.5} points, raising the cross-benchmark mean from 72.5 to 79.1. With the ZwZ-8B base model, Thinking-Once reaches a mean score of 82.7. Against 11 open-source HR-VQA baselines, it obtains the best or tied-best score on all three benchmark averages and the best overall mean; for example, compared with DeepScan, it reduces V$^*$Bench inference time by \textbf{97.2\%} while improving the cross-benchmark mean from 77.8 to 79.1. These results show that HR-VQA can be improved by routing already encoded evidence rather than repeatedly acquiring new visual inputs. Code is available in the appendix.

AI.tldr: 提出Thinking-Once，一种无需训练、单次视觉通过的证据路由方法，解决高分辨率视觉问答中细粒度证据在中间层被稀释的问题。该方法在五个基础模型上持续提升或持平基线效果，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上跨基准平均分从72.5提升至79.1，且相比DeepScan减少97.2%的推理时间。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为高分辨率视觉问答（HR-VQA）是证据获取不足的问题，需要通过裁剪、重新编码或多轮搜索来补充视觉信息。作者指出这一观点不完整：在许多情况下，细粒度证据在视觉编码后已存活，并在中间层路由窗口内可识别且有影响力，但在答案生成前被稀释。这挑战了"反复获取新视觉输入"的主流思路。
AI.method: 提出Thinking-Once方法，这是一个无需训练、单次视觉通过的证据路由方法。核心思想是在中间层路由窗口重建问题条件化注意力，保留核心实体标记和紧凑的背景上下文，将这些证据路由到后续层，无需额外的视觉编码。
AI.result: 在五个基础模型上，Thinking-Once一致地提升或匹配基线效果。在V*Bench、HRBench-4K和HRBench-8K上平均提升+3.1、+3.0和+2.7分，同时将平均峰值内存减少约4GB。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上分别提升+9.9、+4.6和+5.5分，跨基准均值从72.5提高到79.1。在使用ZwZ-8B基础模型时达到82.7的平均分。在11个开源HR-VQA基线中，在所有三个基准平均分上获得最佳或并列最佳，整体均值最佳。相比DeepScan，推理时间减少97.2%。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：HR-VQA可以通过路由已编码的证据来改善，而不是反复获取新的视觉输入。这挑战了传统的"证据获取不足"范式，表明中间层证据路由是一种更高效的解决方案。

title: Guiding Large Language Models with Genetic Programming-Evolved Heuristic Knowledge for Dynamic Multi-Mode Project Scheduling
summary: In dynamic multi-mode project scheduling, activities have alternative execution modes and uncertain durations, while precedence relations and limited resources constrain their execution. Heuristic priority rules support fast online decisions, but their design requires substantial domain expertise. Genetic programming (GP) hyper-heuristics can automatically evolve such rules. Large language models (LLMs), meanwhile, provide a flexible interface for interpreting scheduling information and explaining decisions. However, zero-shot LLM decisions may lack domain knowledge, consume many tokens, and vary across repeated queries. GP-evolved rules therefore provide a potential source of scheduling knowledge for guiding LLM decisions. Unlike existing LLM--GP hybrids that use LLMs to support heuristic evolution, we transfer knowledge in the reverse direction, using knowledge extracted from high-quality GP rules to guide an online LLM decision maker. We extract knowledge from high-quality GP rules and inject it through Feature Selection, Feature Hint, Rule Reference, and Rule Follow. These mechanisms are evaluated in terms of scheduling performance, token consumption, decision stability, and the feature focus expressed in generated rationales. GP-derived guidance generally improves the unguided LLM, but its representation matters. Simplifying the decision context or supplying explicit decision logic is more effective than highlighting important features. Feature Selection offers the best token efficiency, whereas Rule Follow achieves strong performance at greater token cost. Guidance also improves decision stability and changes the features expressed in generated rationales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种逆向的LLM-GP混合框架：从遗传规划（GP）进化出的高质量启发式规则中提取调度知识，用于引导零样本大语言模型（LLM）进行动态多模式项目调度决策。通过特征选择、特征提示、规则引用和规则遵循四种知识注入方式，评估了调度性能、token消耗、决策稳定性和理由生成的特征关注度。
AI.motivation: 动态多模式项目调度中，启发式优先级规则设计需要大量领域专业知识，GP超启发式可自动进化规则但缺乏可解释性；LLM提供灵活接口但零样本决策缺乏领域知识、token消耗大且多次查询结果不稳定。现有LLM-GP混合方法多为LLM辅助GP进化，本文反向利用GP规则知识指导LLM决策，弥补LLM的领域知识缺失问题。
AI.method: 从高质量GP规则中提取知识，通过四种机制注入到在线LLM决策器中：（1）特征选择（Feature Selection）简化决策上下文；（2）特征提示（Feature Hint）突出重要特征；（3）规则引用（Rule Reference）提供规则逻辑；（4）规则遵循（Rule Follow）让LLM直接跟随GP规则决策。从调度性能、token消耗、决策稳定性和生成理由的特征关注度四个维度进行评估。
AI.result: GP引导总体优于未引导的LLM，但知识表示方式至关重要。简化决策上下文或提供显式决策逻辑比突出重要特征更有效。特征选择在token效率上最优，而规则遵循在性能上表现强但token成本更高。引导还改善了决策稳定性，并改变了生成理由中表达的特征关注。
AI.conclusion: GP规则知识可以有效引导LLM进行调度决策，但知识表示形式决定了引导效果的上限。特征选择与规则遵循分别代表token效率与性能的最优权衡，为LLM-GP混合调度决策提供了新的研究方向。

title: SAFViT: Spatial Attention Fusion Gating for Vision Transformer-Based Nucleus Segmentation and Classification
summary: Accurate cell segmentation and classification are foundational to digital pathology, enabling quantitative tissue analysis for diagnosis and treatment planning. Encoder-decoder architectures that fuse multi-scale features through skip connections have become the dominant paradigm for this task, yet standard direct skip connections treat every spatial location equally, which leads to redundant and potentially conflicting information reaching the decoder. To overcome this problem, various gating mechanisms have been introduced, but most of them operate solely on filtering encoder information, neglecting the benefit of global contextual information from the decoder. This study proposes replacing conventional skip connections in a CellViT-based model with a novel Spatial Attention Fusion (SAF) Gating module. Each SAF gate concatenates the encoder skip and upsampled decoder features, compresses them through two pointwise convolutions with an intermediate ReLU, and applies a channel-wise softmax to produce a per-pixel "heatmap of trust" that sums to unity at every spatial location, allowing the network to learn where each source is most trustworthy. The resulting fused features improve the model's ability to detect the minority "Dead" class, which in turn enhances the multi-class panoptic quality (mPQ) on the PanNuke dataset. SAF Gating is compared against six gating alternatives including no gating, attention gates, squeeze-and-excitation, CBAM, cross-attention, and attentional feature fusion on PanNuke and MoNuSeg datasets. SAF Gating achieves the highest mPQ (0.471), a gain driven primarily by a 14.5-point improvement in Dead-class F1 score compared to ungated CellViT baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的空间注意力融合（SAF）门控模块，通过通道级softmax生成逐像素"信任热图"来替代传统的直接跳连接，提升了细胞分割和分类的准确性。
AI.motivation: 标准编码器-解码器架构中的直接跳连接对所有空间位置一视同仁，导致冗余和冲突信息到达解码器；现有门控机制大多只过滤编码器信息，忽视了解码器全局上下文信息的价值。
AI.method: 在CellViT模型中用SAF门控模块替代传统跳连接。每个SAF门拼接编码器跳接特征与上采样解码器特征，通过两个逐点卷积（含中间ReLU）压缩，再应用通道级softmax生成在每个空间位置总和为1的逐像素"信任热图"，使网络能学习每个来源最可信的位置。
AI.result: 在PanNuke数据集上达到了最高mPQ（0.471），较未加门控的CellViT基线在"Dead"类F1分数上提升14.5个百分点。该模块在PanNuke和MoNuSeg数据集上与六种门控替代方法（无门控、注意力门控、SENet、CBAM、交叉注意力、注意力特征融合）对比均表现最优。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合解码器全局上下文信息来引导编码器特征选择，SAF门控能有效改善少数类（如Dead类）的检测性能，从而提升整体多类别全景分割质量。

title: SpatialCLI: Learning to Reason With Spatial Tools, Then Without Them
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in embodied agents to interpret visual inputs, reason about spatial relationships, and make task-level decisions based on that reasoning. However, a fundamental capability mismatch remains: general VLMs can reason about the overall task but often miss the visual details that determine success, while specialist vision models can capture those details but cannot translate them into task-level decisions. In this work, we propose SpatialCLI, a framework that teaches VLMs to reason with spatial tools and progressively internalize the specialist perceptual capabilities they provide. SpatialCLI proceeds in three stages: (1) Call exposes specialist vision models as spatial tools to augment the VLM's perception; (2) Learn uses Cold-Start SFT and agentic RL to improve tool use; and (3) Internalize verbalizes successful tool-use trajectories to internalize specialist perceptual capabilities. We further introduce SpatialCLI-Bench, a 516-example benchmark for compositional perception across localization, segmentation, depth, and pose. On MindCube, SpatialCLI raises Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 29.3% to 84.6% with tools, surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol with tools (72.1%), while retaining 73.8% without tools after internalization.

AI.tldr: SpatialCLI是一个三阶段框架，通过将专业视觉模型作为空间工具教授给VLM，并逐步内化这些感知能力，解决了通用VLM与专业视觉模型之间的能力鸿沟问题。
AI.motivation: 通用VLM擅长任务级推理但常忽略决定成败的视觉细节，而专业视觉模型能捕捉细节却无法转化为任务级决策，两者之间存在根本性的能力错配。
AI.method: SpatialCLI包含三个阶段：(1) Call—将专业视觉模型作为空间工具暴露给VLM以增强感知；(2) Learn—使用冷启动SFT和代理RL优化工具使用；(3) Internalize—将成功的工具调用轨迹语言化以内化专业感知能力。同时引入SpatialCLI-Bench基准测试集（516个示例），覆盖定位、分割、深度和姿态等组合感知任务。
AI.result: 在MindCube基准上，SpatialCLI将Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct从29.3%提升至配备工具时的84.6%，超过GPT-5.6 Sol的72.1%；内化后无需工具仍保持73.8%的性能。
AI.conclusion: SpatialCLI验证了通过工具调用训练和逐步内化的方法可以有效弥合通用VLM与专业视觉模型之间的能力差距，实现高水平的空间推理与感知能力。

title: RRM: Experience-Driven Reflective Retrieval Memory for Long-Horizon Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Existing multimodal long-term memory agents use external memory to overcome the limited context available for long videos. However, most methods emphasize what to store rather than how stored memory should be retrieved. When retrieval becomes inaccurate or repeatedly fails to obtain useful evidence, existing agents lack mechanisms to diagnose failures from previous task trajectories and adapt future search strategies.We introduce Reflective Retrieval Memory (RRM), a reflective memory framework for long-horizon multimodal reasoning. RRM augments an entity-centric multimodal memory graph with reflective experience memory, which distills transferable procedural retrieval knowledge from historical task trajectories. Unlike episodic and semantic memories that preserve factual evidence from the current video, reflective experience memory captures reusable search strategies across tasks. RRM converts retrieved experiences into query-level guidance, while answer generation remains conditioned only on factual evidence newly retrieved from the current video. A lifecycle management mechanism further regulates experience memory through usage frequency, reuse feedback, and temporal decay, thereby reducing redundancy and noise. RRM consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches on M3-Bench-Robot, M3-Bench-Web, and Video-MME-Long, demonstrating the effectiveness of reflective retrieval memory for long-horizon multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反射式检索记忆框架（RRM），通过从历史任务轨迹中提炼可迁移的检索知识来解决多模态长期记忆在长视频推理中检索不准确的问题，并在多个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态长期记忆智能体侧重存储什么而非如何检索，当检索失效时缺乏诊断和自适应调整检索策略的机制，导致长视频推理表现受限。
AI.method: RRM在实体中心的多模态记忆图谱上增加反射式经验记忆，蒸馏历史轨迹中的可转移程序性检索知识；将检索经验转换为查询级引导，答案生成仅依赖当前视频新检索的事实证据；通过生命周期管理机制基于使用频率、复用反馈和时间衰减来调节经验记忆。
AI.result: 在M3-Bench-Robot、M3-Bench-Web和Video-MME-Long三个基准上一致超越先前最先进方法，验证了反射式检索记忆对长时程多模态推理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RRM表明将检索策略本身作为可沉淀、可反思、可淘汰的经验进行管理，能显著提升长视频多模态推理中记忆检索的可靠性，并减少经验记忆中的冗余与噪声。

title: FeatFix: Reuse What You Verify through Local Exact-Feature Correction for Faster Cached Diffusion Inference
summary: Diffusion models are widely used to generate high-quality images and videos, but their iterative denoising process remains computationally intensive. A growing class of training-free accelerators reduces this cost by reusing cached intermediate features or forecasting future ones. To control draft drift, these methods sometimes compute an exact block feature for verification. Yet the resulting exact feature is typically used only to measure discrepancy or guide a later decision and is then discarded. We find that this previously computed feature can instead be reused for correction. Forwarding it at the verification site resets the local draft residual and reduces downstream feature error. Based on this observation, we introduce FeatFix, a local exact-feature correction method for cached diffusion inference. FeatFix operates at a fixed sparse set of layer--timestep sites. At each selected site, it replaces the complete draft block output with the exact output computed from the same incoming state, avoiding token- or channel-level partial replacement and full-timestep recomputation. Experiments across four image and video backbones show that FeatFix consistently accelerates generation, achieving a speedup of up to $6.70\times$ over Vanilla while maintaining competitive output quality.

AI.tldr: FeatFix是一种免训练加速扩散模型推理的方法，通过重用验证阶段计算出的精确块特征来校正本地草稿残差，在稀疏的层-时间步站点上替换完整草稿块输出，实现最高6.70倍加速且保持输出质量。
AI.motivation: 现有训练免加速方法（如缓存重用、特征预测）为控制草稿漂移会计算精确块特征用于验证，但这些精确特征仅用于度量差异或指导后续决策后被丢弃，未充分利用其潜力来校正生成质量。
AI.method: FeatFix在固定的稀疏层-时间步站点上操作。在每个选定站点，将完整草稿块输出替换为从相同输入状态计算得到的精确输出，从而重置局部草稿残差并减少下游特征误差，避免token或通道级别的部分替换以及全时间步重计算。
AI.result: 在四个图像和视频骨干网络上实验，FeatFix始终加速生成，相比Vanilla最高可达6.70倍加速，同时保持竞争力的输出质量。
AI.conclusion: 原本仅用于验证的精确特征可以被进一步重用于校正草稿输出，这种本地精确特征校正策略能够在显著加速扩散模型推理的同时维持生成质量。

title: Albilich: Steerable Proof-State Orchestration for LLM-Based Mathematical Research with CAS Integration
summary:
Large language models can contribute useful ideas to mathematical research, yet long-horizon proof attempts remain difficult to coordinate, evaluate, and reproduce. We present Albilich, an open-source agentic harness for autoresearch in mathematics that combines long-horizon reasoning, computer algebra systems (CAS), literature retrieval, and persistent SQLite-based context management.
  We evaluate Albilich on the RealMath benchmark (Zhang et al. 2025) and on open problems in group theory from the Kourovka Notebook (Khukhro and Mazurov 2026). It solved 10/10 problems on RealMath with CAS and 9/10 with no CAS. On the Kourovka problems, Albilich produced a counterexample to Problem 21.142 and a proof of a strengthening of Problem20.2. Anablation on Problem 17.91 demonstrates 32.0% token reduction when CAS is enabled. An ablation on Problem 21.142 demonstrates higher verifier-rejection rate and failure to synthesize proof routes in the absence of the advisor agent. These results support Albilich as a human-steerable, CAS-boosted environment for scalable AI-assisted mathematical research.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Albilich，一个开源的数学自动研究智能体框架，结合长程推理、计算机代数系统(CAS)、文献检索和SQLite持久化上下文管理。在RealMath基准上10/10全解（无CAS时9/10），并在Kourovka笔记本开放问题上产生了一个反例和一个加强版证明。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型能为数学研究贡献有用想法，但长程证明尝试在协调、评估和复现方面存在困难，需要更系统化的智能体框架来支持。
AI.method: 构建Albilich开源智能体框架，整合长程推理、计算机代数系统(CAS)、文献检索和基于SQLite的持久化上下文管理，并在RealMath基准和Kourovka开放问题上进行评估。
AI.result: RealMath上CAS模式10/10全解、无CAS模式9/10；Kourovka问题上解决了Problem 21.142（反例）和Problem 20.2的加强版证明；消融实验显示CAS带来32.0% token减少，advisor agent的缺失导致验证拒绝率升高。
AI.conclusion: Albilich是一个可人工引导、CAS增强的可扩展AI辅助数学研究环境，在开放问题上展现出实际解决能力。

title: Where and When to Commit: Candidate-Aware Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) expose a provisional prediction at every denoising step, creating an opportunity for generation-time early exit that stops decoding before the schedule is exhausted. Existing early-exit gates decide termination from fixed-region confidence statistics or schedule-dependent rules, evidence too coarse for a decision that freezes every remaining position at once, so they fire prematurely on long chain-of-thought outputs whose answers stabilize only near the end. Adaptive sampling, the other axis of training-free acceleration, paces how quickly positions commit while decoding continues but never verifies that the output itself has stabilized. We introduce a training-free, candidate-aware early-exit framework that keeps the two axes separate and matches each decision to evidence of its own scope. Confidence-Verified Commit (CVC) governs when the sequence may stop by verifying confidence and sustained argmax stability over the dynamically extracted candidate span using a deterministic parser specified from each task's output format. Block-Wise Early Commit (BWEC) governs where to accelerate by applying a cheaper local rule to non-final blocks, while leaving the final block and global termination under CVC. We refer to their combination as LATCH (Localized Acceleration with Tracked-Candidate Halting). Unlike prior methods, LATCH needs no suffix-prompt construction; it is prompt-anchor-free but format-aware. We evaluate LATCH end to end on 11 tasks under zero-shot settings using LLaDA and Dream. LATCH stays within 2.0 percentage points of full-decoding accuracy across all 22 evaluation settings, with one frozen hyperparameter set that transfers cross-backbone untuned, while achieving end-to-end TPS speedups of 9.3-17.8x on short-answer tasks and 2.0-3.3x on long-reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LATCH框架，一种无需训练的候选感知早期退出方法，通过两个独立机制（CVC和BWEC）分别管理序列何时停止和何处加速，在11个任务上实现9.3-17.8x（短答案）和2.0-3.3x（长推理）的速度提升，同时保持精度损失在2个百分点以内。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）在每个去噪步骤都暴露中间预测，为生成时的早期退出提供了机会。然而现有早期退出门控仅依赖固定区域置信度统计或调度依赖规则，证据过于粗糙，导致在长链式推理输出中过早终止。自适应采样虽能控制解码速度，但无法验证输出本身是否已稳定。
AI.method: 提出LATCH框架，包含两个独立机制：1) CVC（置信验证提交）通过任务特定输出格式的确定性解析器验证置信度和持续argmax稳定性来决策何时停止；2) BWEC（块级早期提交）对非最终块应用更廉价的局部规则来加速何处提交，而最终块和全局终止仍由CVC管理。该方法无需后缀提示构造，是提示锚无关但格式感知的。
AI.result: 在LLaDA和Dream骨干网络上、11个任务的零样本设置下评估，LATCH在全部22个评估设置中精度损失保持在2.0个百分点以内，使用一组冻结超参数跨骨干迁移无需调参；端到端TPS加速在短答案任务上为9.3-17.8x，长推理任务上为2.0-3.3x。
AI.conclusion: LATCH通过将"何时停止"和"何处加速"两个决策维度分离，并匹配各自范围的证据，实现了训练免费、跨模型可迁移的高效早期退出框架，有效解决了现有方法在长链推理任务上过早终止的问题。

title: MECA: A Mechanism-Centered Agent for Constructing Well-Specified and Valuable Mathematical Conjectures
comment: 78 pages, 5 figures. Includes appendices and the full collection of 100 generated conjectures
summary: Automatically constructing well-specified and valuable mathematical conjectures remains a central challenge in AI-assisted mathematical discovery. Many existing open problems and conjectures are often too broad, underspecified, or difficult to connect to plausible proof or refutation strategies. We view a mathematical mechanism as a structure or reasoning principle that connects the assumptions of a candidate problem to its target conclusion, such as an inequality, invariant, decomposition, or reduction to an intermediate claim. We present MECA (MEchanism-centered Conjecture Agent), a multi-agent framework that constructs conjectures by jointly developing candidate statements and their supporting mechanisms. Explorer agents propose mechanisms, test how they apply, and revise the candidate conjecture accordingly, while critic agents assess their mathematical validity and research value. Their feedback guides changes to the assumptions, scope, and conclusion. Through this process, MECA transforms broad research directions into precise conjectures with substantive mathematical support while retaining a clearly identified unresolved core. We evaluate MECA in two complementary settings. First, we compare it with a generate-and-revise baseline on reconstructing preselected target-paper conclusions from target-conditioned but article-blind source materials. Second, we construct 100 semi-open problems from literature-derived seeds and existing open problems and evaluate them through independent proof and refutation attempts by automated provers. Our results indicate that mechanism-centered refinement produces well-specified and research-worthy conjectures that remain challenging for current automated provers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MECA（机制中心猜想智能体），一个多智能体框架，通过联合开发候选猜想及其支撑机制来构建数学猜想。探索智能体提出机制并测试其应用，批评智能体评估其数学有效性和研究价值，从而将宽泛的研究方向转化为具有实质性数学支撑的精确猜想。
AI.motivation: 现有的数学猜想起发生成往往过于宽泛、定义不明确，难以连接到可行的证明或反驳策略。研究者希望构建一个能够自动生成明确且具有研究价值猜想的系统，填补AI辅助数学发现中猜想规范化的空白。
AI.method: MECA采用多智能体框架：探索智能体（Explorer agents）提出机制、测试应用并修订候选猜想，批评智能体（critic agents）评估数学有效性和研究价值，通过反馈循环指导对猜想假设、范围和结论的修改。
AI.result: 在两个设置中评估：1）与生成-修订基线对比，从目标条件下的文章盲来源材料重建预选目标论文结论；2）从文献种子和现有开放问题构建100个半开放问题，通过独立自动证明器的证明和反驳尝试评估。结果表明机制中心化细化产生了规范且具研究价值的猜想，对当前自动证明器仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 机制中心化的猜想精化方法能够生成规范且值得研究的数学猜想，这些猜想对现有自动证明工具仍构成挑战，表明该框架在AI辅助数学发现方面具有潜力。

title: New Synchronous Computation Dynamics for Hopfield Networks
summary: The dynamics of the original Hopfield network is asynchronous (sequential) (updates the state of only one neuron per time step). In this paper, we propose a new tool and a new dynamics to reduce the processing time by updating one or more neurons simultaneously per instant while ensuring process convergence and aiming for the maximum energy decrease at each step, thus guaranteeing the shortest total processing time. From the point of view of synchronous dynamics, calculating the next network state at which energy decreases the most from the current state while ensuring convergence is itself a combinatorial optimization problem. We develop and use a new tool to solve it. We call this new tool Discrete Differential Filter (DDF) and, based upon it, we develop a new synchronous dynamics which we call SD-DDF (Synchronous Dynamics based upon Discrete Differential Filter). In this paper, we review the original asynchronous dynamics for Hopfield networks and present a new tool and a new synchronous dynamics with its theoretical justification and four computational experiments to assess the speed up in processing time empirically.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于离散差分滤波器（DDF）的Hopfield网络同步动力学（SD-DDF），通过每步同时更新一个或多个神经元来减少处理时间，在保证收敛的同时实现能量最大程度下降，并通过四项计算实验验证了处理速度的提升。
AI.motivation: 原始Hopfield网络采用异步（顺序）动力学，每步只更新一个神经元，导致处理时间较长。作者希望提出一种同步动力学方法，通过同时更新多个神经元来加速处理过程。
AI.method: 提出了离散差分滤波器（DDF）这一新工具，并基于其开发了称为SD-DDF的同步动力学。该方法在每步中同时更新一个或多个神经元，确保收敛的同时追求最大能量下降。其中计算每个时间步能量下降最多的下一网络状态本身是一个组合优化问题，DDF被用来求解该问题。
AI.result: 作者回顾了原始Hopfield网络的异步动力学，并展示了新工具和新的同步动力学的理论合理性，通过四项计算实验实证评估了处理时间的加速效果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的SD-DDF同步动力学能够在保证收敛的前提下，通过同时更新多个神经元实现最大程度能量下降，从而缩短总处理时间，实验验证了其加速效果。

title: Fidelity Is Not Safety: Gently-Compressed LLMs Pass Every Data-Free Quality Guard Yet Invent Procedure Steps in Agentic Execution
summary: Practitioners accept a compressed language model once it clears a stack of data-cheap quality guards: perplexity within a small factor of the original, downstream accuracy (for example MMLU) inside a confidence interval, and data-free output-fidelity signals that compare the compressed and original network's internal representations under random probe inputs. This stack has a blind spot. Across three model families, gently-compressed models clear every guard and then invent procedure steps that were never in the instructions when they run a standard operating procedure (SOP) as an agent. The effect is operator-specific: coherent low-rank (SVD) truncation induces it, and magnitude pruning matched to the same perplexity does not. One dissociation isolates the cause. The same compressed weights that CI-win a paired output-fidelity test CI-fail the invented-step canary. The governing axis is the coherence of the compression error times its rate; the magnitude of the damage does not predict it. The data-free fidelity probe is a fidelity oracle by construction, so it cannot see this axis. We characterize the blindspot and dissociation with paired confidence intervals on a pre-registered, powered canary across three architectures. Operator-specificity replicates on all three, and the perplexity-guard evasion appears where the model admits in-guard low-rank headroom. We then give a data-free screen: a two-axis statistic of the compression error (coherent-fraction and error-rate) that flags the failing builds with fixed thresholds across architectures and matches the coherence-times-rate mechanism. Perplexity, MMLU, and fidelity acceptance do not certify agent safety. Screen gently-compressed low-rank builds before agentic deployment

AI.tldr: 本文发现当前主流的模型压缩质量检验指标（困惑度、下游准确率、数据无关的保真度探测）存在盲区：轻度压缩的模型能通过所有测试，但在作为智能体执行标准操作流程时会凭空编造指令中从未出现的步骤。该效应具有算子特异性——低秩SVD截断会引发，而同困惑度水平的幅度剪枝不会。作者提出一个二维无数据筛查统计量（相干分数与误差率）可跨架构稳定识别有风险的压缩模型。
AI.motivation: 现有压缩模型质量把关体系（困惑度、MMLU、保真度信号）存在系统性盲区，无法捕捉压缩模型在智能体场景下产生的幻觉行为，可能导致部署安全风险。作者希望揭示并量化这一盲区，并提供可用的补救筛查方法。
AI.method: 在三个模型家族上设置预注册、有检验功效的金丝雀测试（invented-step canary），配合配对置信区间进行对比。对压缩误差进行解离分析，引入"相干压缩误差"（coherent compression error）与误差率两个轴的统计量，作为无数据的筛查标准，验证其与误行为机制的匹配性。
AI.result: 同困惑度下SVD压缩会引发步骤编造而幅度剪枝不会；可赢得配对输出保真度检验的压缩权重却会在金丝雀测试中失败；相干分数与误差率构成的二维统计量能跨架构用固定阈值识别出有风险的压缩构建；困惑度、MMLU和保真度验收均无法表征该风险。
AI.conclusion: 当前压缩验收标准不能保证智能体部署安全。对于轻度压缩的低秩模型，在部署前必须额外引入基于相干压缩误差的筛查。作者建议采用相干分数×误差率的二维统计量作为数据无关的补充筛查工具。

title: EEG-EditBench: Probing Visual Information in EEG-Image Retrieval Models with Controlled Image Edits
comment: Main paper with supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/XiaoZhangYES/EEG-EditBench. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/xiaozgg/EEG-EditBench
summary: Recent EEG-to-image retrieval models have achieved strong performance in identifying viewed images from semantically diverse candidates. Yet such success does not reveal what visual information supports the match. A model may readily identify a cheetah among tools, plants, and vehicles, but can it still distinguish the viewed cheetah from the same scene with the cheetah replaced by a dog? Motivated by this question, we introduce EEG-EditBench, a diagnostic benchmark that examines this question through controlled edits of object identity, attributes, background, and object presence. Built from the 200 THINGS-EEG2 test images, EEG-EditBench contains 2,137 quality-controlled edits and evaluates eight representative EEG visual decoding models. Our results show that strong standard retrieval does not consistently transfer to edit-based evaluation, with fine-grained attribute changes presenting the greatest challenge. EEG-EditBench reveals model behavior hidden by aggregate retrieval accuracy and provides a controlled basis for studying what visual information EEG-image models preserve. The code and complete dataset are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EEG-EditBench，一个用于诊断EEG-to-image检索模型的基准，通过受控编辑（对象身份、属性、背景、对象存在性）来检验模型是否真正利用视觉信息，而非仅靠语义类别区分。实验发现强检索性能不总能迁移到细粒度编辑任务，属性变化是最难挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG-to-image检索模型虽然在语义多样候选集上表现优异，但无法反映模型实际利用了哪些视觉信息。模型可能仅凭粗粒度语义类别（如"猎豹"vs"工具"）就能匹配成功，却在需要区分细粒度视觉差异（如同场景中猎豹被替换为狗）时失效。作者希望通过受控编辑来揭示模型隐藏的行为。
AI.method: 从200 THINGS-EEG2测试图像构建诊断基准EEG-EditBench，包含2,137个质量控制后的受控编辑，覆盖四种编辑类型：对象身份、对象属性、背景和对象存在性。评估八个代表性EEG视觉解码模型，通过编辑后的检索任务测试模型是否能在细粒度差异下正确匹配。
AI.result: 发现标准检索性能强并不一致地迁移到基于编辑的评估中，其中细粒度属性变化是最大的挑战。EEG-EditBench揭示了被聚合检索准确率掩盖的模型行为差异。
AI.conclusion: EEG-EditBench为研究EEG-image模型保留了哪些视觉信息提供了受控基础，代码和完整数据集已公开，有助于推动更深入的模型理解与改进。

title: Baikal: Structured Search for Deep Research over Data Lakes
summary: Deep research over data lakes requires an LLM agent to investigate evidence across thousands of heterogeneous tables and passages to synthesize a report. Existing methods perform iterative retrieval and generation, letting accumulated context determine what to investigate next, which can overexploit locally promising evidence and fail to cover distinct semantic regions under a fixed budget. To address this, we cast deep research over data lakes as a budgeted search problem and present Baikal - a framework that clusters heterogeneous evidence into semantic regions, then searches over them adaptively to balance exploration and exploitation. Within each selected region, Baikal generates and investigates region-grounded subquestions, using finding quality as rewards to update region-level value estimates and guide search under policies ranging from random and LLM-guided selection to Bayesian $ε$-greedy and UCB. We evaluate Baikal on 15 queries each over HybridQA and TAT-QA data lakes containing 10,993 and 2,757 tables, respectively, together with 227K Wikipedia passages and 13K financial report passages. We assess research quality with a new rubric covering groundedness, relevance, diversity, and utility, and use GPT-5-mini to score Baikal and strong baselines, including DeepSearcher and an OpenCode research agent with retrieval and clustering variants. Across both data lakes, Baikal performs strongly under several region-selection policies; its best configuration improves report scores over the strongest baselines by 28% on HybridQA and 36% on TAT-QA. Our analyses attribute these gains to organizing and exploring semantic evidence regions, which improves groundedness and diversity and yields more useful findings under the same subquestion budget. These results demonstrate the value of structured semantic exploration for systematic research and discovery over heterogeneous data lakes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Baikal框架，将数据湖上的深度研究建模为预算受限的搜索问题，通过将异构证据聚类为语义区域并自适应搜索（平衡探索与利用），在HybridQA和TAT-QA两个数据湖基准上相比最强基线分别提升28%和36%的报告得分。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究方法采用迭代检索-生成的方式，让累积上下文决定下一步调查方向，这容易过度利用局部有希望的证据，在固定预算下无法覆盖不同的语义区域，导致研究覆盖不足、多样性差。
AI.method: Baikal框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 将异构证据聚类为语义区域；(2) 在区域间自适应搜索，采用多种策略（随机、LLM引导、贝叶斯ε-greedy、UCB）平衡探索与利用；(3) 在选定区域内生成并调查区域相关子问题，以发现质量作为奖励更新区域价值估计。同时提出了一个新的评估量规，涵盖基础性、相关性、多样性和实用性四个维度。
AI.result: 在15个查询上评估，覆盖HybridQA（10,993张表）和TAT-QA（2,757张表）数据湖，以及227K维基百科段落和13K金融报告段落。Baikal在多种区域选择策略下均表现优异，最佳配置相比最强基线在HybridQA上提升28%，在TAT-QA上提升36%。消融分析表明收益来源于组织并探索语义证据区域，提升了基础性和多样性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化语义探索对异构数据湖上的系统性研究具有重要价值，Baikal证明了将深度研究视为预算受限搜索问题、通过区域聚类和自适应探索平衡的策略能显著提升研究报告质量。

title: Causal Discovery with Inverted Self-attention for Multivariate Time Series
summary: Causal discovery in multivariate time series data is challenging due to complex interactions, high dimensionality, and nonlinear dependencies among variables. Existing methods often struggle to capture these complexities, resulting in inaccurate causal structures. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework that leverages self-attention mechanisms within the transformer architecture for causal discovery. Our approach introduces a novel inverted causal self-attention mechanism (CSAM) that emphasizes latent and indirect causal relationships by inverting tokens and inducing sparsity in attention scores, focusing on significant causal interactions and reducing spurious correlations. Additionally, we develop a global causal algorithm to identify global causal links, providing a holistic metric for causal influence, along with a causal verification module to ensure robustness in the identified causal relationships, enhancing the reliability of our framework. Experiments on both linear and nonlinear datasets, along with ablation studies and sensitivity analyses, show that our framework outperforms existing methods, demonstrating its potential for causal discovery in complex multivariate time series.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于Transformer自注意力机制的多变量时间序列因果发现框架，通过创新的反转因果自注意力机制（CSAM）和全局因果算法提升因果发现的准确性和稳健性，实验表明优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列因果发现面临复杂交互、高维度和非线性依赖等挑战，现有方法难以准确捕捉这些复杂性，导致因果结构推断不准确。
AI.method: 提出反转因果自注意力机制（CSAM），通过反转token和引入注意力分数稀疏性来强调潜在及间接因果关系；开发全局因果算法识别全局因果链接，提供因果影响的整体度量；设计因果验证模块确保识别因果关系的稳健性。
AI.result: 在线性和非线性数据集上的实验、消融研究和敏感性分析表明，该框架在因果发现性能上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了在复杂多变量时间序列中进行因果发现的潜力，有效提升了因果结构的准确性和可靠性。

title: VeriSkill: A Self-Evolution Framework for Program Verification Skills
summary: Automating program verification with LLM agents requires generating specifications, annotations, auxiliary lemmas, and tool invocations, all of which depend on reusable skills. A natural remedy is skill self-evolution: distilling skills from trajectories and refining them through feedback. However, existing evolution methods struggle with program verification tasks because they cannot reliably identify skill-specific failures or extract actionable signals from opaque verifier feedback. In this paper, we propose VeriSkill, a self-evolution framework built for program verification. It attributes verification failures to skill deficiencies, distills diagnostic signatures into reusable lessons, and iteratively refines candidate skills, admitting only revisions that improve verification performance while preserving program semantics. Experiments show that VeriSkill consistently outperforms all baselines across multiple verification tools, agent frameworks, and LLM backends.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VeriSkill，一个为程序验证任务构建的自我进化框架，通过将验证失败归因于技能缺陷、将诊断性签名提炼为可复用经验，并迭代优化候选技能（仅采纳能改进验证性能且保持程序语义的修订），在多种验证工具、代理框架和LLM后端上始终优于所有基线。
AI.motivation: 使用LLM代理自动化程序验证需要生成规范、注释、辅助引理和工具调用，这些都依赖于可复用技能。虽然技能自我进化（从轨迹中提炼技能并通过反馈优化）是一种自然解决方案，但现有进化方法无法可靠识别技能特定的失败，也无法从模糊的验证器反馈中提取可操作的信号，因此难以应对程序验证任务。
AI.method: VeriSkill框架包含三个关键步骤：1）将验证失败归因于技能缺陷；2）将诊断性签名提炼为可复用的经验教训；3）迭代优化候选技能，且只采纳能改善验证性能同时保持程序语义不变性的修订。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，VeriSkill在多种验证工具、代理框架和LLM后端上均一致地优于所有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VeriSkill通过可靠地归因技能失败并从模糊的验证器反馈中提取可操作信号，有效解决了LLM代理在程序验证任务中技能自我进化的核心难题，展现出良好的泛化性和鲁棒性。

title: EMBL AI Librarian: Life-Sciences Knowledge Layer for AI Agents
summary: The web is increasingly accessed by AI agents rather than humans. Every agent needs knowledge, especially in the life-sciences, where agentic pipelines are growing fast. Access to the literature is a crucial part of that need, and resources such as Europe PMC, with over 40M indexed records, are widely used to meet it. Yet these resources were not built for AI agents: they take keywords and complex syntax and return whole papers, so every agent must learn the syntax, issue several searches, and read full papers to find the evidence it needs. We introduce EMBL AI Librarian, a knowledge layer that upgrades the Europe PMC interface for AI agents: an agent asks in natural language and receives evidence that answers it. A single LLM orchestrates the whole knowledge retrieval process: it plans complementary subqueries executed by the live Europe PMC search engine, then reads the selected papers and locates the relevant evidence. We evaluate Librarian across four benchmarks: literature synthesis, claim verification, open-domain question answering, and downstream biology tasks such as protocol questions and sequence manipulation. On ScholarQABench, Librarian improves Citation F1 by more than $16$ points over strong recently published baselines. Used as the retrieval layer of an existing claim-verification pipeline, it increases agreement with expert consensus; and on the open-form LitQA2 benchmark, a GPT-5.4 agent scores about $8$ points higher when grounded in Librarian than with web search. Overall, our results show that equipping life-science agents with the Librarian knowledge layer improves performance across a range of tasks. We release our code publicly at https://github.com/petroni-lab/librarian

AI.tldr: 本文介绍EMBL AI Librarian，这是一个为AI智能体设计的知识层，将欧洲PMC文献数据库接口升级为自然语言查询与证据检索系统。通过单个LLM编排整个知识检索流程，包括规划互补子查询、执行实时搜索、阅读论文并定位相关证据。在四个基准测试中表现优异，其中ScholarQABench的Citation F1提升超过16个点，使GPT-5.4智能体在LitQA2上的得分提高约8个点。
AI.motivation: 当前的文献资源（如欧洲PMC）是为人类设计的，使用关键词和复杂语法返回整篇论文，不适合日益增长的AI智能体使用。智能体需要学习语法、多次搜索并阅读全文才能找到所需证据，效率低下。因此需要构建一个专门面向AI智能体的知识检索层。
AI.method: 提出EMBL AI Librarian知识层，核心是一个LLM编排整个检索流程：1）智能体用自然语言提问；2）单个LLM规划互补的子查询，由实时欧洲PMC搜索引擎执行；3）LLM阅读选中的论文并定位相关证据，最终返回直接回答问题的证据。
AI.result: 在四个基准（文献综合、声明验证、开放域问答、下游生物学任务）上评估。ScholarQABench上Citation F1提升超过16个点；用于声明验证管线时提高与专家共识的一致性；在LitQA2基准上，GPT-5.4智能体使用Librarian比网页搜索得分高约8个点。
AI.conclusion: 为生命科学智能体配备Librarian知识层能显著提升各类任务的性能，证明了面向AI智能体的知识检索层的价值。代码已在GitHub上公开。

title: DECODE: Tackling Representation and Decision Degradation in Continual AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: As generative models continue to evolve, AI-generated image detectors must incrementally adapt to emerging generative domains while preserving knowledge acquired from previous ones. This continual learning setting is particularly challenging because forensic traces are often subtle and generator-specific, making detectors highly vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods primarily address this problem by stabilizing feature representations, implicitly treating forgetting as a representation-level issue. In this paper, we show that this perspective is incomplete. We demonstrate that even when feature representations remain discriminative, the decision boundary can progressively drift as the classification head is continually optimized on new domains. These two effects jointly give rise to a compound failure mode, termed Dual Degradation. To overcome this challenge, we propose DECODE, a decoupled continual detection framework that jointly mitigates representation- and decision-level forgetting. Specifically, we introduce Subspace Diversity Regularization (SDR) to preserve diverse forensic representations and Closed-Form Decision Alignment (CDA) to recalibrate the shared classification head after each adapter merge without manual hyperparameter tuning. Extensive experiments on 19 generative domains show that DECODE achieves an average accuracy of 99.36% with only 0.39% forgetting, while further generalizing to 11 unseen generators with 95.36% accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DECODE框架，解决AI生成图像检测器在持续学习中的"双重退化"问题——即特征表示与决策边界同时发生遗忘。通过子空间多样性正则化（SDR）和闭式决策对齐（CDA）分别缓解表示层面和决策层面的遗忘，在19个生成域上达到99.36%平均准确率和仅0.39%的遗忘率，并可泛化到11个未见生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有生成图像检测器的持续学习研究主要聚焦于稳定特征表示，将遗忘视为表示层面问题。但本文指出这一视角不完整：即使特征表示保持判别力，分类头在持续优化新域时决策边界也会逐渐漂移，两种效应叠加形成"双重退化"（Dual Degradation）复合失效模式。
AI.method: 提出DECODE解耦持续检测框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 子空间多样性正则化（SDR），用于保留多样化的取证特征表示；(2) 闭式决策对齐（CDA），在每次适配器合并后以无需手动调参的方式重新校准共享分类头，同时缓解表示层面和决策层面的遗忘。
AI.result: 在19个生成域上的实验表明，DECODE达到99.36%的平均准确率，仅0.39%的遗忘率；额外在11个未见生成器上达到95.36%的泛化准确率。
AI.conclusion: DECODE验证了持续检测中表示层面和决策层面遗忘需协同处理的必要性，为AI生成图像检测的增量学习提供了更完整的解决思路，兼具高准确率、低遗忘率和良好的跨生成器泛化能力。

title: SpecCal: Ambiguity-Aware Candidate Calibration for Infrared Spectrum-Based Molecular Structure Reconstruction
summary: Inferring molecular structures from infrared (IR) spectra is a fundamental yet challenging problem. A key difficulty is that an IR spectrum provides limited structural information: different molecules may share similar functional groups and local vibrational patterns, leading to highly similar spectral responses. Thus, even when an observed spectrum has a unique underlying structure, reconstructing it from the spectrum remains ambiguous. Existing IR-to-molecule models usually generate a ranked set of candidate molecules, but this set is largely determined by the model's learned generation preference and may not fully capture the structures that best satisfy the observed spectral constraints. To address this limitation, we propose SpecCal, a training-free candidate calibration framework for IR-to-molecule prediction. SpecCal operates on the candidate outputs of existing base models and improves the prediction set by re-ranking current candidates while introducing additional structurally plausible alternatives guided by spectral consistency. The framework is plug-and-play and model-agnostic, requiring no parameter updates for integration with diverse base models. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that SpecCal consistently improves top-k reconstruction at both SMILES and scaffold levels across different base models. Further analyses demonstrate that calibrating candidate sets under spectral ambiguity provides a practical way to improve molecular reconstruction from IR spectra. The code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SpecCal-B18A.

AI.tldr: SpecCal是一个无需训练的候选校准框架，用于改进红外光谱到分子结构预测。它通过对现有基模型输出的候选分子进行重新排序并引入光谱一致性的额外候选，来提升top-k分子重建准确率，且无需参数更新。
AI.motivation: 红外光谱推断分子结构是一个基础但困难的问题，因为光谱信息有限，不同分子可能因相似官能团和局部振动模式而产生高度相似的光谱响应。现有IR-to-molecule模型生成候选分子集合时主要受模型自身生成偏好影响，可能未能充分覆盖最符合光谱约束的结构。
AI.method: SpecCal是一种即插即用、模型无关的训练免校准框架。它基于现有基模型的候选输出，通过重新排序当前候选并引入由光谱一致性指导的额外结构可行候选来改进预测集，不需要任何参数更新即可集成到不同基模型中。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，SpecCal在不同基模型下一致性地提升了SMILES和scaffold级别的top-k重建性能。
AI.conclusion: 在光谱模糊条件下校准候选集是改进红外光谱分子重建的一种实用方法。

title: Understanding Is Done Early: A Depth Division of Labor in Large Language Models and Its Use for Unbounded-Context Memory
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 27 tables. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review
summary: Transformer depth is not used uniformly: lower and middle layers build semantic representations, while upper layers increasingly specialize them for prediction. We turn this division of labor into CoMem (Comprehension Memory), which writes each context chunk only through an intermediate layer, retrieves a fixed number of cached residual states, and recomputes the query-conditioned upper layers over the resulting pack. For a fixed retrieval budget, model-side read compute and memory are independent of stored-context length. We evaluate a continued-trained Qwen3-8B base LM under a unified chat-template-free protocol. The backbone is frozen; the flagship trains only a rank-32 self-distillation LoRA on plain PG19, and we report an adapter-free arm separately. CoMem reaches 97.05 on RULER and 38.27 on LoCoMo versus 34.59 for full-context KV-Direct; the dialogue-memory advantage survives conversation-cluster resampling and an independent judge. Results on additional long-context and long-document tasks expose both the benefits of bounded retrieval and its in-window compression tax. Controlled depth sweeps show that deeper caching lowers per-query recomputation but incurs a fidelity loss that self-distillation substantially repairs. In a separate adapter-free efficiency control on an NVIDIA H20 at 128k, CoMem uses 18.26 GB rather than 89.36 GB and achieves a 7.83x prefill speedup. These results show that long-context memory can be organized along the layer axis, not only the token axis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoMem（Comprehension Memory）方法，利用Transformer层间分工特性——低中层构建语义表示、上层进行预测特化——将长上下文记忆按层轴组织而非仅按token轴。CoMem仅通过中间层写入每个上下文块，检索固定数量的缓存残差状态，并重计算查询条件化的上层。在固定检索预算下，模型侧读取计算和内存与存储上下文长度无关。
AI.motivation: Transformer各层对上下文的利用并不均匀：低层和中层构建语义表示，上层逐渐特化用于预测。作者希望利用这一分工特性，将长上下文记忆组织到层轴上，而不只是token轴上，从而打破存储上下文长度对检索计算和内存的依赖。
AI.method: 提出CoMem框架：每个上下文块仅通过中间层写入缓存；检索时获取固定数量的缓存残差状态；对聚合结果重计算查询条件化的上层。在冻结骨干的Qwen3-8B基础LM上进行持续训练，使用rank-32自蒸馏LoRA在PG19上训练，并单独报告无adapter的对照组。在NVIDIA H20上128k上下文进行效率评估。
AI.result: CoMem在RULER上达到97.05，在LoCoMo上达到38.27（对比全上下文KV-Direct的34.59）；对话记忆优势在对话簇重采样和独立评判下依然成立。在128k上下文下，CoMem使用18.26 GB内存而非89.36 GB，实现7.83倍prefill加速。深度扫描显示更深缓存降低每查询重计算但带来保真度损失，自蒸馏可大幅修复。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明长上下文记忆可以沿层轴组织，而不只沿token轴。CoMem展示了有界检索的收益，同时也暴露了窗口内压缩代价。自蒸馏有效修复了深度缓存带来的保真度损失，整体方案在记忆质量和计算效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Unifying Adversarially Robust Model Experts in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, posing a serious problem for real-life applications and deployment. Adversarial fine-tuning emerges as a prominent defense method; however, different fine-tuning strategies often produce specialized models with distinct robustness characteristics. Each fine-tuned model in turn thrives in some evaluation settings but falters on others, limiting their defensive capabilities. We refer to these specialized fine-tuned models as robust model experts and propose a collaborative adversarial fine-tuning framework: CARE - Collaborative Adversarial Robustness fine-tuning using Embedding alignment. CARE maintains multiple experts during training, enables knowledge exchange through embedding-space harmonization, and consolidates the learned knowledge into a single unified robust model. Experts benefit from one another while preserving their individual specializations, enabling the final model to inherit complementary robustness properties. In this paper, we demonstrate CARE on two different adversarial fine-tuning strategies with complementary robustness behaviors. Extensive experiments on classic image classification and downstream vision-language tasks display the effectiveness of our approach, with CARE being able to outperform individually learned model experts. The results suggest that collaborative learning across model experts is a promising direction for improving adversarial robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARE框架，通过嵌入空间对齐实现多个对抗微调模型专家之间的协作学习，将互补的鲁棒性知识整合到一个统一的鲁棒模型中，在图像分类和下游视觉-语言任务上优于单个专家模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（如CLIP）容易受到对抗攻击，对抗微调是重要防御手段，但不同微调策略产生的模型各有其鲁棒性特点，在部分评估场景下表现好而在其他场景下失效，限制了防御能力。
AI.method: 提出CARE（Collaborative Adversarial Robustness fine-tuning using Embedding alignment）框架：训练过程中维护多个鲁棒模型专家，通过嵌入空间和谐化实现知识交换，并将学习到的知识整合为单一统一的鲁棒模型。专家之间互相受益同时保留各自专长，使最终模型获得互补的鲁棒性属性。
AI.result: 在经典图像分类和下游视觉-语言任务上的大量实验表明，CARE能够优于单独训练的模型专家，验证了协作学习策略在提升对抗鲁棒性方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型专家的协作学习是提升对抗鲁棒性的一个有前景的方向。

title: Annotating Topical Legal Insights from Case Proceedings
summary: In this paper, we mainly concentrate on finding concepts or topics from the legal case proceedings, since adopting a structured representation for legal documents, as opposed to a mere bag-of-words flat text representation, can significantly enhance processing capabilities. To achieve this objective, we put forward a set of diverse concepts for legal case proceedings. With this motivation, we propose LeDA, a system for Legal Data Annotation. The system offers the generic functionality of annotating and adjudicating entities or concepts within documents via a web-based interface. A novel feature of our system is that it allows to dynamic create new tags for annotation, which is a particularly useful provision for situations where there exists no pre-defined ontology for the entities (concepts) that need to be annotated - these being rather discovered by annotators as they continue examining more documents. The system that we demonstrate is currently in use to annotate a set of concepts from legal documents to construct semantic representations of documents as bags of concepts that can then be used for several downstream tasks, such as prior case retrieval, judgment prediction, and so on. Along with the system features in general, we also describe how LeDA was used by 3 assessors to annotate and adjudicate legal concept names from Indian Supreme Court case proceedings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LeDA系统，一个用于法律数据标注的Web工具，支持从法律案件诉讼文件中动态标注和裁定概念或实体，并通过3位评估者对印度最高法院案件进行标注验证。
AI.motivation: 法律文档采用结构化表示（如概念/主题）而非简单的词袋平面文本表示，可以显著提升后续处理的能力，因此需要从法律案件诉讼文件中识别和标注概念。
AI.method: 提出了LeDA（Legal Data Annotation）系统，提供基于Web界面的通用标注和裁定功能。系统的新颖之处在于支持动态创建新的标注标签，适用于没有预定义本体论、需要标注者随文档检查逐步发现概念的场景。
AI.result: 该系统已实际用于标注法律文档中的概念集合，构建文档的语义表示（bag of concepts），可用于先例检索、判决预测等下游任务。此外，系统由3位评估者用于标注和裁定印度最高法院案件诉讼文件中的法律概念名称。
AI.conclusion: LeDA系统通过动态标签创建功能，为没有预定义本体论的法律概念标注提供了灵活解决方案，构建的概念袋表示可支撑多种下游法律文本处理任务。

title: MORFES: A Benchmark for Productive Inflectional Competence in Modern Greek
summary: Modern Greek is a richly inflected language, yet the language models built for it are evaluated mainly on factual knowledge, and no benchmark is dedicated to their inflectional competence. We introduce MORFES (Morphological Open-class Recognition-and-Formation Evaluation Suite), a benchmark of 500 expert-verified items that tests the recognition and production of Greek inflected forms, favoring lower-frequency lemmas so that a correct answer reflects the rule rather than a memorized form. We make it publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/KIEFERSA/MORFES. We evaluate a range of open language models on MORFES, situating them within the rapidly scaling open-weight ecosystem from LLaMA to Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, Magistral, and Kimi K2, where multilingual coverage grows but grammatical competence in morphologically rich languages remains under-measured. Among them, Sophea-Genesis-1, a model we developed and release as open weights at https://huggingface.co/KIEFERSA/Sophea-Genesis-1, leads on inflectional morphology while matching similarly sized models in general capability.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MORFES——一个用于评估现代希腊语词形变化能力的基准测试集，包含500个专家验证的测试项，并发布了在该基准上表现领先的开源模型Sophea-Genesis-1。
AI.motivation: 现代希腊语是一种形态丰富的屈折语，但现有针对希腊语的语言模型评测主要聚焦于事实性知识，缺乏专门评估其屈折形态能力的基准测试。
AI.method: 构建MORFES基准，包含500个专家验证的测试项，用于评估希腊语屈折形式的识别与生成能力；刻意选用低频率词条以确保正确答案反映语法规则而非记忆结果；评测了从LLaMA到Qwen3、DeepSeek-R1等多种开源语言模型，并开发了Sophea-Genesis-1模型。
AI.result: 在MORFES基准上，作者开发的Sophea-Genesis-1模型在屈折形态学任务上领先，同时在通用能力上与同等规模的模型表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 开源模型生态中多语言覆盖能力不断增长，但形态丰富语言的语法能力仍缺乏充分评测；MORFES基准和Sophea-Genesis-1模型的发布填补了这一空白。

title: CoRE-UIR: Prior-guided common and residual experts for efficient all-in-one remote sensing image restoration
comment: Accepted by ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
summary: Remote sensing images acquired by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and satellites are often degraded by adverse weather, illumination variation, and imaging artifacts, which may co-occur and jointly induce global distribution shifts and local structural corruption. Although All-in-One image restoration offers an appealing unified alternative to task-specific pipelines, existing methods still suffer from weak or implicit degradation cues and parameter redundancy caused by full-rank multi-expert designs with overlapping restoration behaviors. We propose CoRE-UIR (Common and Residual Experts for Universal Image Restoration), a prior-guided global-local framework centered on the Common-and-Residual Expert Block (CoRE). CoRE explicitly decomposes restoration capacity into a common dense expert for degradation-invariant restoration and low-rank residual experts for degradation-specific compensation, enabling adaptive specialization without redundant expert replication. Built on this design, Degradation Prior Embedding (DPE) adapts frozen CLIP features into an explicit restoration-oriented prior, while Global Feature Modulation (GFM) aligns global feature statistics before local residual compensation. We also construct MDVD-108K (Multi-Degradation VisDrone), a large-scale UAV restoration dataset covering both single and compound degradations, together with a real-world test set. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets show that CoRE-UIR improves the overall average PSNR by 1.05 dB while running 11.83$\times$ faster and reducing peak memory by 85.3% relative to the strongest baseline, BaryIR, thereby maintaining a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off. Evaluations on downstream tasks and unseen degradation also validate the generalizability of CoRE-UIR. The code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/zzaiyan/CoRE-UIR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRE-UIR，一种基于通用与残差专家（CoRE）的先验引导全局-局部图像复原框架，将复原能力显式分解为通用密集专家（处理退化不变复原）和低秩残差专家（处理退化特定补偿），并引入退化先验嵌入（DPE）和全局特征调制（GFM），同时构建了大规模无人机多退化数据集MDVD-108K。相比最强基线BaryIR，PSNR提升1.05dB，速度快11.83倍，峰值内存降低85.3%。
AI.motivation: 无人机和卫星遥感图像常受多种共同发生的退化影响（如恶劣天气、光照变化、成像伪影），导致全局分布偏移和局部结构损坏。现有All-in-One图像复原方法存在退化线索弱或隐式、以及全秩多专家设计导致参数冗余和恢复行为重叠的问题。
AI.method: 提出CoRE-UIR框架，核心是Common-and-Residual Expert Block（CoRE），将复原能力分解为通用密集专家和低秩残差专家；Degradation Prior Embedding（DPE）将冻结的CLIP特征适配为显式复原导向先验；Global Feature Modulation（GFM）在局部残差补偿前对齐全局特征统计；并构建MDVD-108K大规模无人机复原数据集。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，CoRE-UIR相比最强基线BaryIR，PSNR平均提升1.05dB，运行速度快11.83倍，峰值内存降低85.3%；下游任务和未见退化场景的评估验证了其泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CoRE-UIR通过显式的通用-残差专家分解和先验引导机制，在保持高质量复原的同时显著提升效率，实现了良好的质量-效率权衡，并展现出强大的泛化能力。代码和数据集将开源发布。

title: MemeBench: What LVLMs Miss When Interpreting Culture-Dependent Memes
summary: Large vision-language models have improved at describing visual content, but accurate descriptions do not ensure interpretation when meaning depends on knowledge beyond the pixels. Memes expose this gap because they rely on cultural entities, background knowledge, and community conventions. Most meme benchmarks reduce interpretation to labels or holistic scores, obscuring where an explanation breaks down. We introduce MemeBench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,253 Chinese and English memes with human-written references and quality-controlled VIKR annotations, centered on anime, comics, games, and adjacent online subcultures. Its VIKR schema decomposes explanations into Visual clues, Identity links, Knowledge units, and Reasoning mechanisms. Across 26 LVLMs, every model covers visible content more reliably than the knowledge needed to interpret it, and even the strongest retains a 22.6% Visual-Knowledge gap. To test whether this diagnosis can guide improvement, we introduce KAR, an entity-guided retrieval baseline built on CultureBase. Across four controlled models, KAR raises VIKR Success by 3.6-7.4% and, compared with generic retrieval, repairs more answers and breaks fewer. Yet both retrieval conditions improve Identity and Knowledge while reducing Visual coverage in every comparison. MemeBench reveals whether an interpretation succeeds, what is missing, and whether targeted evidence fills the diagnosed gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MemeBench，一个包含1,253个中英文模因的诊断性基准测试集，采用VIKR标注模式将解释分解为视觉线索、身份链接、知识单元和推理机制。实验发现26个LVLM在视觉内容理解上均优于背景知识获取，最强模型仍有22.6%的视觉-知识差距。作者还提出基于实体引导检索的KAR基线，可将VIKR成功率提升3.6-7.4%，但检索在提升身份和知识的同时会降低视觉覆盖。
AI.motivation: 现有大型视觉语言模型在描述视觉内容方面表现出色，但精确描述不等于正确解读——当意义依赖于像素之外的背景知识时（如模因依赖文化实体、背景知识和社区惯例），模型常常无法正确解释。现有模因基准测试将解释简化为标签或整体分数，无法定位解释失败的具体环节，因此需要更精细的诊断性基准。
AI.method: 作者构建了MemeBench基准（1,253个中英文模因，集中在动漫、漫画、游戏等网络亚文化），提出VIKR标注模式将模因解释分解为四个维度：视觉线索（Visual clues）、身份链接（Identity links）、知识单元（Knowledge units）和推理机制（Reasoning mechanisms）。同时提出KAR（entity-guided retrieval baseline），基于CultureBase知识库进行实体引导的检索增强。
AI.result: 在26个LVLM上的评估显示，所有模型对可见内容的覆盖可靠度均高于解读所需的知识掌握度，最强模型仍存在22.6%的视觉-知识差距。KAR在四个受控模型中将VIKR成功率提升3.6-7.4%，相比通用检索能修复更多答案且破坏更少；但两种检索条件在提升身份和知识的同时均降低了视觉覆盖。
AI.conclusion: MemeBench不仅能揭示模因解释是否成功，还能精确定位缺失的成分（视觉、身份、知识或推理），并检验针对性证据能否填补诊断出的知识缺口。该工作为评估和提升LVLM的模因解读能力提供了更精细的诊断框架。

title: (Towards) Scalable Reliable Automated Evaluation with Large Language Models
comment: 17 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the Fourth Workshop on Generation, Evaluation and Metrics (GEM2) at ACL 2025
summary: Evaluating the quality and relevance of textual outputs from Large Language Models (LLMs) remains challenging and resource-intensive. Existing automated metrics often fail to capture the complexity and variability inherent in LLM-generated outputs. Moreover, these metrics typically rely on explicit reference standards, limiting their use mostly to domains with objective benchmarks. This work introduces a novel evaluation framework designed to approximate expert-level assessments of LLM-generated content. The proposed method employs pairwise comparisons of outputs by multiple LLMs, reducing biases from individual models. An Elo rating system is used to generate stable and interpretable rankings. Adjustable agreement thresholds, from full unanimity to majority voting, allow flexible control over evaluation confidence and coverage. The method's effectiveness is demonstrated through evaluating competency profiles extracted from scientific abstracts. Preliminary results show that automatically derived rankings correlate well with expert judgments, significantly reducing the need for extensive human intervention. By offering a scalable, consistent, and domain-agnostic evaluation layer, the framework supports more efficient and reliable quality assessments of LLM outputs across diverse applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需人工参考标准的LLM输出评估框架，通过多LLM两两比较结合Elo评分系统生成稳定排名，并采用可调的共识阈值（从全体一致到多数投票）控制评估置信度，实验表明自动排名与专家判断高度相关，显著减少人工干预需求。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM文本质量评估方法依赖显式参考标准且难以捕捉生成内容的复杂性，仅限于有客观基准的领域，同时人工评估成本高昂，亟需一种可扩展、跨领域的自动化评估方案。
AI.method: 提出一个评估框架：1) 由多个LLM对输出进行两两比较，减少单一模型的偏见；2) 采用Elo评分系统生成稳定且可解释的排名；3) 通过可调节的共识阈值（从完全一致到多数投票）灵活控制评估置信度与覆盖面；4) 在科学摘要中提取的能力画像上进行验证。
AI.result: 初步实验结果表明，自动生成的排名与专家评价高度相关，显著降低了大规模人工评估的需要，验证了该方法在无需显式参考标准场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种可扩展、一致且领域无关的评估层，能够更高效、更可靠地支持跨应用的LLM输出质量评估，为减少人工干预提供了可行路径。

title: One Patch Is Enough: Reinforcement-Optimized Visual Token Grounding for MLLM-Based Scene Text Spotting
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Scene text spotting requires high-precision alignment between textual recognition and spatial localization. While visual-token grounding has emerged as a promising formulation for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), the previous multi-patch paradigm often introduces redundant noise and localization ambiguity, particularly for dense or small text instances. To address this, we propose Single-Patch Text Spotting (SPaTS), a vision-centric framework that routes each text instance through a single anchor visual token and then recovers geometry via full-image refinement. To accurately identify this anchor without oracle labels, we introduce Single-Patch Selective Optimization (SPaSO), a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes discrete visual-token selection using patch-level rewards. To further improve representation robustness and localization precision, we introduce Directional Embedding Alignment (DEA) to suppress unstable norm bias by decoupling feature magnitude and direction, and Patch-Enhanced Decoding (PED) to fuse the routed anchor with language semantics and cross-attend over the full-image feature map for geometry-aware boundary regression beyond coordinate-space surrogates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPaTS consistently and significantly outperforms both frontier closed-source MLLMs and OCR MLLMs. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPaTS，一种基于单一锚点视觉token的场景文本检测框架，通过强化学习实现离散视觉token选择，并引入方向嵌入对齐和补丁增强解码来提升定位精度，大幅超越现有闭源MLLM和OCR MLLM。
AI.motivation: 现有的多补丁（multi-patch）范式在视觉token grounding中容易引入冗余噪声和定位模糊，尤其在密集或小尺寸文本实例上表现不佳，需要更精确的文本识别与空间定位对齐方案。
AI.method: 提出SPaTS框架：(1) 每个文本实例通过单一锚点视觉token进行路由，再通过全图细化恢复几何信息；(2) SPaSO强化学习框架，利用补丁级奖励优化离散视觉token选择；(3) DEA方向嵌入对齐，解耦特征幅度与方向来抑制不稳定的范数偏差；(4) PED补丁增强解码，将锚点与语言语义融合，并在全图特征图上进行跨注意力实现几何感知的边界回归。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SPaTS在场景文本检测任务上一致且显著地优于前沿闭源MLLM和OCR MLLM。
AI.conclusion: 单补丁视觉token路由范式配合强化学习优化和方向/补丁增强机制，能有效解决场景文本检测中的定位模糊问题，代码即将开源。

title: STEREODISCO: Discovering Stereotypicality in LLMs
summary: LLMs encode, convey, and perpetuate stereotypes. Prior computational research focuses on a small set of semantic axes investigated in social psychology, and operates on word embeddings produced by language models, leaving open which other semantic axes carry stereotypical associations in LLMs and how LLMs internally represent such axes. We introduce STEREODISCO, a framework that adapts the semantic differential method (Osgood et al., 1957) to the systematic study of stereotypes in LLM internal representations. STEREODISCO constructs approx. 2,000 candidate semantic axes from WordNet antonym synsets, recovers each as a geometric axis in the LLM's activation space via probing, and identifies stereotypical axes via a statistical test over concept projections. As a case study, we apply STEREODISCO to social group stereotypes with LLAMA-3-8B-INSTRUCT and MISTRAL-7B-INSTRUCT.
