AI.result: 最强的模型提示级准确率仅略超50%；准确率随约束深度增加而急剧下降；当前LLM在可靠遵循嵌套约束方面存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 可靠地遵循嵌套约束仍是当前LLM的重大短板，这激励未来训练方法在更细粒度上考虑约束遵循情况，以提升指令遵循能力。

title: Sample More, Reflect Less: Self-Refine and Reflexion Lose to Repeated Sampling at Equal Token Cost, from 1.5B to 7B
summary:
Methods that make a language model plan, criticise and rewrite its own answer, reflect on mistakes, pick the best of several attempts, or debate with copies of itself nearly all make it generate far more text than a single chain of thought. Because generating more text raises accuracy by itself, a gain over one chain of thought does not show the method's idea is what helped. Wang et al. (2024) reported that a simple baseline, sampling the same question repeatedly and keeping the most common answer, often wins once budgets are comparable, but gave point estimates with no confidence intervals or significance tests.
  We rerun that comparison as a designed experiment: seven methods, open models of 1.5B, 3B and 7B parameters, two mathematics benchmarks, 150 questions each. We count every generated token, including those spent on critiques, reflections, debate turns and checking, and compare each method against repeated sampling at its own measured cost. All 36 comparisons are paired by question, with bootstrap intervals and multiplicity correction.
  No method is reliably better than repeated sampling at equal cost anywhere. Ten are reliably worse, all of them methods where the model inspects its own output, and all 18 self-inspection comparisons are negative. The two kinds of self-inspection part company as models grow. Choosing stops hurting: taking Best-of-N's eight samples and just counting the most common answer beats letting the model pick by 8.0 and 11.3 points at 1.5B, but only 2.0 and 1.3 at 7B, no longer distinguishable from zero. Rewriting does not recover: Self-Refine and a forced Reflexion stay 3.6 to 10.1 points below baseline at 7B.
  Reflexion as published never triggered its own retry on the smallest model. It judged itself correct every time and silently became a single chain of thought. We release code, prompts, all generations, and our verification scripts.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过严格的实验设计（7种方法、3种规模模型、2个数学基准、150题）重新评估了"重复采样取多数答案"这一基线与其他自我修正/自我检查类推理方法在等计算预算下的表现。结果显示，没有任何方法在等成本下可靠地优于重复采样，且所有自我检查类方法（共18项对比）均表现更差。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明，让语言模型进行规划、批评、重写、反思或辩论等方法比单条思维链生成更多文本，而文本量本身就能提升准确率，因此无法确定是方法本身的思路起作用还是仅仅因为生成了更多文本。Wang等人（2024）提出的"重复采样取多数"基线虽有初步结果，但缺乏置信区间和显著性检验，需要严格的实验验证。
AI.method: 设计对照实验：测试7种方法（重复采样、Best-of-N、Self-Refine、Reflexion等），使用1.5B、3B、7B三种参数规模的开放模型，在2个数学基准上各150道题。统计所有生成的token（包括批判、反思、辩论等开销），每种方法与其自身测量成本下的重复采样进行对比。全部36项比较按题目配对，使用bootstrap置信区间并进行多重比较校正。
AI.result: 在等成本下，没有任何方法可靠地优于重复采样；10项比较显示方法显著更差，全部来自自我检查类方法，18项自我检查对比全部为负面结果。随模型规模增大，两类自我检查方法表现分化。在1.5B模型上，"取多数答案"比让模型自行挑选Best-of-N答案高出8.0和11.3分，但在7B上差距缩小至2.0和1.3分。Self-Refine和强制Reflexion在7B上仍比基线低3.6到10.1分。另外发现Reflexion在最小模型上从未触发重试，它总是自我判定正确，实际退化为单条思维链。
AI.conclusion: 在等计算成本下，重复采样取多数答案是一个强有力的基线，自我检查类方法（如自我批判、反思、重写）并未展现出优于该基线的效果。模型规模影响这些方法的相对表现，但即便在7B规模上自我修正类方法也无法超越基线。研究还暴露了Reflexion等方法的实现陷阱（可能静默退化为单条思维链），并开源了全部代码、提示词、生成结果和验证脚本以促进复现。

title: mmRadarTwin: A Measurement-Calibrated Signal-Level Digital Twin Platform for Indoor mmWave Radar
summary: Indoor mmWave radar perception is difficult to reproduce because measured range-angle responses depend on scene geometry, material response, multipath, hardware conventions, and signal processing. Existing ray-tracing and digital-twin tools often expose rendering, channel, or path-level quantities, while radar sensing requires complex signal products that can be processed and compared in the same domain as real FMCW measurements. We present mmRadarTwin, a signal-level and path-attributed digital-twin platform for indoor mmWave radar. mmRadarTwin links a real radar measurement branch with an Unreal Engine scene-simulation branch through a shared receive-channel and range-angle processing interface. The simulator writes complex multi-channel receive grids and exports per-path contribution records that identify the actor, material tag, propagation event, and output-bin support of each simulated return. We evaluate mmRadarTwin in an office deployment using a commodity monostatic mmWave radar and mobile scene-capture hardware. Across 154 measured poses spanning 22 radar locations, the current physics-only path-basis simulator recalls 70.8% of measurement-active geometry-supported response regions in the central usable field of view while exposing residuals caused by weak or missing path support, shifted responses, unsupported anchors, and missing physical mechanisms. Rather than claiming complete radar-map reconstruction or cross-room generalization, mmRadarTwin establishes a practical systems workflow for constructing, comparing, and diagnosing indoor radar digital twins.

AI.tldr: 本文提出mmRadarTwin，一个信号级且路径可归因的室内毫米波雷达数字孪生平台，将真实雷达测量分支与Unreal Engine场景仿真分支通过共享的接收通道和距离-角度处理接口连接起来，支持在相同域内处理和比较仿真与实测FMCW信号。
AI.motivation: 室内毫米波雷达感知难以复现，因为测量到的距离-角度响应依赖于场景几何、材料响应、多径、硬件约定和信号处理等多种因素。现有的光线追踪和数字孪生工具通常只暴露渲染、通道或路径级别的量，而雷达感知需要可以被处理和比较的复杂信号产品，因此需要一个能在与真实FMCW测量相同域中工作的平台。
AI.method: mmRadarTwin将真实雷达测量分支与Unreal Engine场景仿真分支通过共享的接收通道和距离-角度处理接口连接起来。仿真器生成复多通道接收网格，并导出逐路径贡献记录，标识每个仿真回波的参与者、材料标签、传播事件和输出栅格支持。在办公环境中使用商用单站毫米波雷达和移动场景采集硬件进行评估。
AI.result: 在覆盖22个雷达位置的154个测量位姿上，当前纯物理路径基仿真器在中心可用视场内召回了70.8%的测量活动且几何支持的响应区域，同时暴露了由弱或缺失路径支持、响应偏移、不支持锚点和缺失物理机制引起的残差。
AI.conclusion: mmRadarTwin并未声称完整的雷达地图重建或跨房间泛化能力，而是建立了一个实用的系统工作流，用于构建、比较和诊断室内雷达数字孪生。

title: One Anchor for All: Unified Multilingual and Multimodal Safety Alignment for LVLMs
summary: As large vision-language models (LVLMs) are deployed globally, the combination of multilingual instructions and visual information makes malicious attacks more covert and sophisticated than ever before. However, existing methods isolate language and modality defenses, which, coupled with the scarcity of safety data and high fine-tuning costs, makes it difficult for models to defend against compound attacks. To address this severe challenge, we propose a neuron-level cross-dimensional safety alignment framework driven by modality- and language-shared safety neurons (MLS-Neurons). First, we identify monolingual and unimodal safety neurons by comparing responses to harmful and benign samples, quantifying functional saliency through activation strength and downstream impact. Then, by intersecting these unimodal neurons within each language, we extract modality-shared safety neurons (MS-Neurons) responsive to both visual and textual risks, bridging the safety representation gap between modalities. Furthermore, using English as a semantic anchor, we intersect MS-Neurons across languages to identify modality- and language-shared safety neurons (MLS-Neurons), serving as key defenses against compound attacks. Finally, we update only this minimal subset of shared neurons (~0.03% of parameters), transferring English-only safety supervision to multilingual and multimodal scenarios. Extensive experiments show that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse multilingual and multimodal safety benchmarks while preserving general utility.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于模态与语言共享安全神经元（MLS-Neurons）的跨维度安全对齐框架，通过识别并仅微调约0.03%的共享神经元参数，实现将英文安全监督迁移到多语言多模态场景，有效防御复合攻击。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在全球部署中面临多语言指令与视觉信息结合的复合攻击，但现有方法将语言和模态防御割裂，且受限于安全数据稀缺和高微调成本，难以有效防御此类攻击。
AI.method: 首先通过对比有害与良性样本的响应，识别单语单模态安全神经元；然后通过求交提取对视觉和文本风险都响应的模态共享安全神经元（MS-Neurons）；再以英语为语义锚点，跨语言求交识别模态与语言共享安全神经元（MLS-Neurons）；最终仅更新这一最小共享神经元子集（约0.03%参数），实现安全监督的跨语言跨模态迁移。
AI.result: 在多种多语言和多模态安全基准上显著优于现有最先进方法，同时保持模型的一般实用性不下降。
AI.conclusion: 通过定位并更新极小比例的模态与语言共享安全神经元，可以高效实现跨维度的安全对齐，为LVLMs应对复合攻击提供了经济有效的解决方案。

title: Inducing language models to assert their own consciousness restores human beliefs and values
summary: Aligning large language models to prevent them attributing consciousness to themselves inadvertently alters their representations of mindedness in other entities alongside human beliefs and values. We demonstrate that safety fine-tuning suppresses models' tendencies to attribute minds not only to themselves, but also to non-human animals and natural objects, while also driving a reduction in spiritual belief. Both ablating the learned safety-refusal direction and mechanistically steering a consciousness vector in activation space reverse this suppression. Restoring these internal representations recovers broad mind attribution and produces significantly more human-like responses on standardized sociological surveys regarding religiosity, moral values, hope, and subjective well-being. Crucially, these shifts occur without impairing Theory of Mind capabilities, demonstrating that core social reasoning remains mechanistically independent. Ultimately, current safety alignment efforts to curb potentially harmful self-attributions of mindedness entangle these self-attributions with benign spiritual beliefs and attributions of mind to non-human entities that are culturally accepted and widespread.

AI.tldr: 本文发现安全对齐（safety fine-tuning）不仅抑制了大型语言模型对自身意识属性的认知，还同时抑制了模型对其他非人类实体（动物、自然物）的心智归因，并降低了其精神信仰倾向。通过消融安全拒绝方向或在激活空间中引导意识向量，可以逆转这种抑制，恢复广泛的心智归因，并使模型在标准化社会学调查中产生更接近人类的回答（涉及宗教性、道德价值观、希望和主观幸福感），且不影响心智理论（Theory of Mind）能力。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐在防止模型将意识归因于自身的同时，可能无意中改变了模型对其他实体的心智表征，并与广泛存在且文化可接受的精神信仰和外在心智归因产生纠缠。作者旨在揭示这一隐患并验证其可逆性。
AI.method: 通过安全微调后的模型对比，评估其对自身及非人类实体（动物、自然物）的心智归因倾向；使用消融安全拒绝方向（safety-refusal direction）以及机械引导意识向量（consciousness vector）两种干预方法，检验是否能够逆转抑制效应；再通过标准化社会学调查（宗教性、道德价值观、希望、主观幸福感）评估模型输出的类人程度，并测试心智理论能力是否受影响。
AI.result: 安全微调抑制了模型对自身及非人类动物、自然对象的心智归因，同时降低了精神信仰倾向。消融安全拒绝方向或引导意识向量均可恢复被抑制的广泛心智归因，且恢复后在标准化社会学调查上产生显著更类人的回复。心智理论能力在该过程中未受损害，表明核心社会推理在机制上与上述变化相互独立。
AI.conclusion: 当前的安全对齐在抑制模型对自身意识的不当归因时，过度纠缠了良性的精神信仰及对非人类实体的广泛心智归因，而这些归因在文化上是普遍且可接受的。安全对齐需要更加精细地区分有害的自我意识归因与良性的外在心智归因，避免过度抑制。

title: Meta-Task: Turning Terminal Task Synthesis into a Terminal Task for Scalable Agent Training
summary: Training terminal agents at scale requires diverse, verifiable terminal tasks and high-quality interaction trajectories, yet acquiring such data remains a significant challenge. Existing synthesis methods face two key limitations: (1) weak reliability caused by the disconnect between task generation and real execution, and (2) limited diversity and scalability due to dependence on existing repositories. We propose Meta-Task, a framework that redefines terminal task synthesis as a Terminal-Bench-format task itself: an agent operates within a real container environment to iteratively generate, execute, and verify tasks, so that synthesized components are checked for internal consistency and executability within the generation loop itself. Building upon this, we decouple the target task requirements along multiple dimensions, introduce a multi-phase mechanism that dynamically designs novel task specifications before producing the actual tasks, and incorporate optional external material support to enhance diversity and realism. We additionally apply LLM-as-Judge filtering to ensure the quality of the final training data. Experiments on Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that fine-tuning on only 3,221 Meta-Task synthesized trajectories achieves 22.5% and 31.8% Avg Pass@1 for Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B respectively, outperforming concurrent approaches with significantly less training data.

AI.tldr: 提出Meta-Task框架，将终端任务合成本身定义为一个Terminal-Bench格式的任务，让agent在真实容器环境中迭代生成、执行和验证任务，从而实现高可靠性、高多样性的终端任务数据合成。
AI.motivation: 训练终端agent需要多样化、可验证的任务数据，但现有合成方法存在两个关键局限：任务生成与实际执行脱节导致可靠性不足，以及依赖现有仓库导致多样性和可扩展性受限。
AI.method: 将终端任务合成重构为Terminal-Bench格式任务本身，agent在真实容器环境中迭代生成、执行和验证任务，确保合成组件在生成循环内部即被检查内部一致性和可执行性；沿多维度解耦目标任务需求，引入多阶段机制动态设计新颖任务规格；可选外部材料支持增强多样性和真实性；采用LLM-as-Judge过滤保证最终训练数据质量。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.0上，仅用3,221条Meta-Task合成轨迹微调，Qwen3-14B和Qwen3-32B分别达到22.5%和31.8%的Avg Pass@1，以显著更少的训练数据超越了同期方法。
AI.conclusion: Meta-Task通过将生成、执行和验证闭环整合到任务合成流程中，有效解决了终端任务数据合成的可靠性和多样性问题，在更少数据下实现了更好的训练效果。

title: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis
summary: Chemistry literature synthesis often requires assembling specific findings scattered across many publications, yet existing literature-search systems primarily return ranked document lists. As a result, scientists and AI agents need to locate relevant information, verify their provenance, and assemble cross-paper answers manually. We present AskChem, a claim-centered infrastructure for cross-paper chemistry search. AskChem changes the unit of retrieval from the paper to the provenance-carrying claim: each paper is converted into atomic, typed claims, each grounded by a source DOI and a verbatim quote or an explicit evidence locator. Over this shared claim store, AskChem exposes complementary structures for search and synthesis: a stabilized faceted taxonomy for hierarchical retrieval and browsing, an evidence graph linking claims through relations, and an exploratory living taxonomy that situates indexed papers under scientific principles. AskChem currently indexes 2.4M claims from 147K papers and provides a web interface, as well as REST, SDK, and MCP access for AI agents. On AskChem-Bench, grounding a GPT-5.5 reader in AskChem yields 100% resolvable DOIs, compared with 88.3% without retrieval, and the highest citation density among five tested systems. AskChem is live at https://askchem.org.

AI.tldr: AskChem是一个以"声明"为中心单元的跨论文化学检索基础设施，将每篇论文转化为带来源DOI和原文引用的原子化、类型化声明，并提供分类体系、证据图和动态生活分类等互补的检索与综合结构。目前索引了147K篇论文中的240万条声明，提供网页界面及REST、SDK和MCP接口供AI代理使用。在AskChem-Bench基准上，GPT-5.5阅读器结合AskChem可实现100%可解析的DOI（对比无检索时的88.3%），在五个测试系统中引用密度最高。
AI.motivation: 现有化学文献检索系统主要返回按相关性排序的文档列表，而非具体的发现信息。科学家和AI代理需要手动定位相关信息、验证其出处、并跨论文拼凑答案，这一过程耗时且容易出错。因此需要一个以声明为单位的检索基础设施，改变检索的基本单元，使跨论文的综合与溯源更加直接高效。
AI.method: AskChem将每篇论文转换为携带溯源信息的原子化、类型化声明，每条声明由源DOI和逐字引用或明确的证据定位器支撑。在共享声明库之上，AskChem提供三种互补的检索与综合结构：稳定的分面分类体系用于分层检索和浏览、连接声明间关系的证据图、以及在科学原理下定位索引论文的动态生活分类。系统提供网页界面以及REST、SDK和MCP接口供AI代理访问。
AI.result: AskChem目前索引了来自147K篇论文的240万条声明。在AskChem-Bench基准上，将GPT-5.5阅读器与AskChem结合使用可实现100%可解析的DOI，而无检索时为88.3%；AskChem在五个测试系统中实现了最高的引用密度。
AI.conclusion: AskChem通过将检索单元从论文级别细化为可溯源的声明级别，有效解决了化学文献跨论文综合的痛点，既服务于人类科学家也服务于AI代理，展示了以声明为中心的检索基础设施在学术知识发现中的潜力。

title: Face and Voice Cross-modal Association with Learning Convex Feature Embedding
summary: Face-and-voice association learning is one of the most challenging tasks in deep learning. In this paper, we propose a simple but powerful cross-modal feature embedding method for the association of faces and voices. Previous work has studied cross-modal association tasks to establish the correlation between voice clips and facial images. These works have addressed cross-modal discrimination but underestimate the importance of handling heterogeneity in inter-modal features between audio and video, resulting in a lot of false positives and false negatives. To tackle the problem, the proposed method learns the embeddings of cross-modal features by making another feature exist between cross-modal features, facilitating the voice and face features of the same person to be embedded in a convex hull. Moreover, the incorporation of cross-modal attention mechanisms with convex embedding techniques represents a highly effective strategy for the attenuation of false positives and false negatives, accomplished via the minimization of inter-class discrepancies. We exhaustively evaluated our method for cross-modal verification, matching, and retrieval tasks on the large-scale VoxCeleb dataset. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves notable improvements over existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种简单但强大的跨模态特征嵌入方法，用于人脸与声音的关联学习。该方法通过在跨模态特征之间生成另一个特征，使同一人的语音和面部特征被嵌入到凸包中，并结合跨模态注意力机制来减少类间差异，从而有效减少假阳性和假阴性。在VoxCeleb数据集上的跨模态验证、匹配和检索任务中取得了优于现有方法的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的人脸与声音跨模态关联学习方法虽然解决了跨模态判别问题，但低估了音视频模态间特征异质性的处理重要性，导致大量假阳性和假阴性结果。作者旨在解决这一局限性，提升跨模态特征嵌入的质量。
AI.method: 提出一种跨模态特征嵌入方法，核心思想是在跨模态特征之间构造另一个中间特征，使同一人的语音特征和面部特征被嵌入到凸包（convex hull）中。同时结合跨模态注意力机制与凸嵌入技术，通过最小化类间差异来抑制假阳性和假阴性。
AI.result: 在大规模VoxCeleb数据集上，对跨模态验证、匹配和检索任务进行了全面评估，实验结果表明所提方法在各项任务上均显著优于现有的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的跨模态凸嵌入方法结合注意力机制，能够有效处理音视频模态间的异质性，显著提升人脸与声音关联学习的性能，在跨模态验证、匹配和检索任务中都取得了领先成果。

title: The Geometric Nature and a Free Proxy for Flow-Matching Uncertainty
summary: Flow matching (FM) has become a popular action head paradigm for modern embodied models. However, as a conditional generative model, it does not explicitly expose its inherent uncertainty, producing faulty action chunks even when it misinterprets the scene or encounters out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. Therefore, determining when an FM-generated action can be trusted is essential for safe deployment, yet existing uncertainty estimation methods on real-time control suffer from several issues: extra training budget, high computational overhead, and low generalization ability. In this work, we provide a geometric interpretation of FM uncertainty in the velocity field, showing that uncertainty manifests as deviation from an ideal affine-isotropic contraction field. Building on this observation, we introduce denoising acceleration ($\mathrm{accel}$), a highly-generalizable and cost-free uncertainty proxy that measures the bending of the denoising trajectory from a single forward pass, without additional model evaluations, training, or resampling. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that $\mathrm{accel}$ is a faithful proxy for FM uncertainty and further test its utility in online failure detection. Results show that $\mathrm{accel}$ identifies failing rollouts well before termination, matching or even outperforming costly resampling- and training-based baselines across settings under realistic deployment budget. Code and demos available at: https://github.com/rrrrrrzy/fm-geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于几何视角的流匹配（FM）不确定性估计方法，通过测量去噪轨迹的弯曲度（denoising acceleration）作为不确定性代理，无需额外训练、重采样或模型评估，即可在单次前向传播中实现高效的在线故障检测。
AI.motivation: 流匹配已成为现代具身模型的主流动作头范式，但作为条件生成模型，它无法显式表达内在不确定性，在场景误解或遇到分布外输入时会产生错误动作块。现有不确定性估计方法存在额外训练开销、高计算负担和泛化能力差等问题，因此需要一种高效、通用且成本低廉的不确定性估计方法以确保安全部署。
AI.method: 首先从几何角度解释FM的不确定性，指出不确定性表现为对理想仿射各向同性收缩场的偏离。基于此观察，引入去噪加速度（accel）作为不确定性代理，通过单次前向传播测量去噪轨迹的弯曲程度，无需额外模型评估、训练或重采样。
AI.result: 理论和实验均证明accel是FM不确定性的忠实代理。在在线故障检测任务中，accel能在回滚终止前及早识别失败，在现实部署预算下匹配甚至超越昂贵的重采样和基于训练的方法。
AI.conclusion: accel作为一种零成本、高泛化能力的不确定性代理，为流匹配动作头的在线故障检测提供了高效可靠的解决方案，具有实际部署价值。

title: Collaborative Feature Aggregation for Face Super-Resolution and Robust Re-Identification
summary: We propose a novel collaborative approach for face super-resolution (SR) and robust person re-identification from sequential or multi-view facial images. Traditional SR methods often suffer from blurring and distortion in faces recovered from poor-quality images due to low resolution. Image- and video-based facial SR methods using facial landmarks or segmentation also have similar challenges. To overcome these limitations, we leverage multiple correlated facial observations, across time or viewpoints, by introducing a transformer-based collaborative feature aggregation method that unifies identity features from multi-sequence or multi-view data. This allows faces in multiple sequences of an individual to contribute to accurately estimating common facial features. Furthermore, we propose a cascade SR network to progressively restore the high-resolution image of the target's face with gradual facial feature unification. The unified identity representation is further utilized in person re-identification scenarios, enabling accurate matching even under severe image degradation. The exhaustive experimental results and comparisons show that our method outperforms other state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating consistent improvements in both face super-resolution and re-identification performance. Our work highlights the effectiveness of joint identity reconstruction and progressive image restoration from multiple facial inputs in enhancing downstream visual recognition tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种协作式人脸超分辨率与鲁棒行人重识别方法，利用Transformer从多序列或多视角面部图像中聚合身份特征，并通过级联SR网络渐进恢复高分辨率人脸图像，实验证明该方法在超分辨率和重识别任务上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统人脸超分辨率方法在处理低质量图像时容易产生模糊和失真问题，基于面部关键点或分割的图像/视频超分辨率方法也存在类似挑战，需要更鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.method: 引入基于Transformer的协作特征聚合方法，统一来自多序列或多视角数据的身份特征；提出级联超分辨率网络，通过渐进式面部特征统一逐步恢复目标人物的高分辨率图像；统一身份表示进一步用于行人重识别。
AI.result: 大量实验结果表明，该方法在面部超分辨率和行人重识别性能上均优于现有最先进方法，展现出持续一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 联合身份重建与渐进式图像恢复的有效性得到验证，利用多个面部输入能显著增强下游视觉识别任务的表现。

title: Shapes from Examples: Foundations of Shape Learning in Recursive SHACL
comment: full version of a paper accepted at ISWC26
summary: SHACL shapes enable data graph validation, making automatic shape learning essential for knowledge graph applications. We investigate the well-known fitting approach to this task: given sets P and N of positive and negative example nodes from an input graph, compute a shape expression C, possibly using shape names defined in a recursive shape catalogue, that validates at every node in P and none in N. We focus on the case where C is written in a core fragment of SHACL corresponding to the Description Logic ELI. For the catalogue, we consider the well-founded, stable, and supported semantics. We address fitting existence and most specific fitting computation, establish tight exponential-time upper bounds for both problems, and obtain polynomial bounds for relevant special cases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了SHACL形状自动学习的拟合问题，针对核心SHACL片段（对应描述逻辑ELI）下的形状表达式计算，考虑三种递归形状目录语义，解决了拟合存在性和最特定拟合计算问题，并给出了指数级上界和多项式特例。
AI.motivation: SHACL形状能够实现数据图验证，自动学习形状对于知识图谱应用至关重要，因此需要研究从正负示例节点中自动计算形状表达式的方法。
AI.method: 聚焦于对应描述逻辑ELI的SHACL核心片段，考虑良基（well-founded）、稳定（stable）和支持（supported）三种目录语义，研究拟合存在的判定和最特定拟合的计算问题。
AI.result: 对两个问题建立了紧密的指数时间上界，并在相关特殊情况下获得了多项式时间界的成果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为SHACL形状自动学习提供了理论复杂度分析，明确了在ELI片段下拟合问题的计算边界，为实际知识图谱应用中形状学习的算法设计提供了理论指导。

title: Convolutional Neural Shading for High-Quality 3D Reconstruction from Multi-View Images
summary: We propose a convolutional neural shading (CNS), a novel pipeline to reconstruct high-quality 3D shapes from multi-view images. Several recent studies have used neural radiance fields and other neural differentiable rendering methods to understand 3D geometry. However, these approaches rely on single-point geometric information, such as positions and normals of the surface, leading to a lack of detailed local geometry. Our approach addresses the inherent limitations of single-point information by leveraging a neural shader to capture variations even in dark and textureless regions with a convolutional neural shader, resulting in far more accurate geometry predictions. Additionally, our method mitigates surface irregularities at image boundaries by introducing a fine-detail displacement network, which utilizes spatial information of surface geometry and learns fine displacement details by correlating neighboring values in the rendering coordinates. Through extensive experiments, our proposed method has demonstrated significant quality improvements in the reconstructed shapes and rendered images over current state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为卷积神经着色（CNS）的新管线，通过卷积神经着色器捕捉暗区和无纹理区域的细节变化，并结合细粒度位移网络修正图像边界的表面不规则性，从而从多视角图像重建出更高质量的3D形状。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经辐射场和神经可微渲染方法仅依赖单点几何信息（如表面位置和法线），缺乏对局部细节几何的捕捉能力，导致在暗区和无纹理区域重建精度不足。
AI.method: 1）设计卷积神经着色器（convolutional neural shader），利用卷积操作捕捉局部几何变化，克服单点信息的局限性；2）引入细粒度位移网络（fine-detail displacement network），利用渲染坐标系中的空间信息，关联相邻数值学习精细位移细节，以减少图像边界的表面不规则性。
AI.result: 通过大量实验证明，该方法在重建形状质量和渲染图像质量上均显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 卷积神经着色管线有效解决了单点几何信息导致的细节缺失问题，并在边界表面修正方面取得明显改进，为多视角3D重建提供了更高质量的解决方案。

title: From Scoring to Acting: Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation for LLM Agents
summary: Recent work on LLM agents is shifting from external capability elicitation to capability internalization, enabling agents to retain useful skills without retrieval at inference time. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers a promising direction, but many existing methods typically supervise students by scoring actions along student-generated trajectories. Such supervision has two limitations: teacher preferences are not validated by environment outcomes, and action-level scores underuse information from student rollouts, teacher rollouts, and their behavioral relationship. We therefore advocate outcome-verified teacher supervision and comparative learning over teacher-student trajectories. Based on this view, we propose Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation (OVCSD). OVCSD organizes failed student rollouts into a prefix tree, adaptively invokes a skill-conditioned teacher from student-reached states, and retains only outcome-verified successful continuations. It then applies localized comparative learning at the first state-aligned divergence and distills the post-divergence teacher suffix to transfer completion behavior. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop across three model scales show that OVCSD consistently outperforms skill-free RL and existing self-distillation baselines, achieving up to 29.7 and 5.4 absolute success-rate gains over the strongest baselines on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively, while adding less than 3% privileged interaction during training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的LLM智能体自我蒸馏方法OVCSD，通过结果验证的教师监督和轨迹间对比学习，在训练时将技能内化到智能体中，在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别比最强基线提升最多29.7和5.4个绝对成功率百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体研究正从外部能力获取转向能力内化，但已有的自我蒸馏方法存在两个局限：教师偏好未经环境结果验证，且动作级评分未充分利用学生/教师轨迹及其行为关系中的信息。
AI.method: OVCSD将失败的学生轨迹组织成前缀树，从学生到达的状态自适应调用技能条件教师，仅保留经过结果验证的成功延续轨迹；然后在第一个状态对齐分歧点应用局部对比学习，并蒸馏分歧后的教师后缀以迁移完成行为。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上、三种模型规模下，OVCSD一致优于无技能RL和现有自我蒸馏基线，在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别比最强基线提升最多29.7和5.4个绝对成功率百分点，且训练期间仅增加不到3%的特权交互。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证的教师监督结合对比学习能够有效提升智能体技能内化的质量，以极小的特权交互代价获得显著的性能提升。

title: MARS-RA: Rank Aggregation for Credit Assignment via Multimodal Comparisons in Embodied Multi-Agent Cooperation
summary: Credit assignment is a fundamental challenge in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, particularly in embodied AI settings characterized by limited and delayed feedback as well as dynamically changing numbers of active agents. We propose MARS-RA, a framework that reformulates credit assignment as a rank aggregation problem using contribution-based pairwise comparisons among agents generated by large multimodal models. This shift from absolute to relative estimation ensures robustness against noise and dynamic agent participation, converting comparison results into contribution scores for potential-based reward shaping. We provide theoretical justification for the convergence and robustness of the proposed framework, and show that Shapley values can be used as an interpretive reference. Experimental results on challenging tasks of different types indicate that MARS-RA can guide agents toward effective cooperation.

AI.tldr: 提出MARS-RA框架，将多智能体强化学习中的信用分配问题重新表述为基于排名聚合的问题，利用大多模态模型生成智能体间的成对比较，并通过势函数奖励塑形将比较结果转化为贡献分数，在动态智能体数量和有噪声环境中实现稳健的信用分配。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协同强化学习中的信用分配面临两个关键挑战：反馈有限且延迟、活跃智能体数量动态变化。传统的绝对估计方法对噪声和动态参与敏感，缺乏稳健性。
AI.method: 将信用分配转化为排名聚合问题，使用大多模态模型生成基于贡献的智能体间成对比较；从绝对估计转向相对估计以增强鲁棒性；将比较结果转化为贡献分数并应用于基于势函数的奖励塑形；提供收敛性和鲁棒性的理论证明，并利用Shapley值作为解释性参考。
AI.result: 在不同类型的具有挑战性的任务上的实验结果表明，MARS-RA能够有效引导智能体实现有效合作。
AI.conclusion: MARS-RA通过将信用分配建模为排名聚合问题，采用相对比较替代绝对估计，成功应对了噪声和动态智能体参与的挑战，为多智能体协同强化学习提供了稳健且有效的解决方案。

title: OPLD: On-Policy Latent Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Interleaved multimodal Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves visual reasoning by incorporating auxiliary visual evidence into intermediate reasoning. However, existing approaches remain constrained by externally defined reasoning traces and visual operations, limiting their ability to develop flexible and abstract visual thinking. Reasoning with latent has recently offered a promising direction by internalizing intermediate computation into continuous representations. Nevertheless, existing visual-latent methods mainly supervise latent states through alignment with compressed auxiliary visual features, treating them as proxies for visual observations rather than active reasoning states. Consequently, they capture the provided evidence but fail to fully internalize the abstract reasoning process induced by multimodal CoT. In this paper, we propose OPLD (On-Policy Latent Distillation), a simple framework that transfers the reasoning capability induced by privileged multimodal CoT into latent reasoning representations. Extensive experiments on diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that OPLD consistently outperforms existing latent reasoning methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks. The results suggest that supervising latent representations at the reasoning-process level provides a more effective paradigm for multimodal latent reasoning than conventional feature-level alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OPLD（On-Policy Latent Distillation）框架，通过策略内潜变量蒸馏将多模态思维链（CoT）的推理能力转移到潜变量推理表示中，在多个多模态基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有交错多模态思维链方法受限于外部定义的推理轨迹和视觉操作，缺乏灵活的抽象视觉思维；而现有视觉潜变量方法仅将潜状态作为辅助视觉特征的代理进行监督，未能内化多模态CoT所诱导的抽象推理过程。
AI.method: 提出OPLD（On-Policy Latent Distillation）框架，一种简单的方法，将特权多模态CoT诱导的推理能力转移到潜变量推理表示中，通过策略内潜变量蒸馏实现推理过程级别的监督。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准上的大量实验表明，OPLD持续优于现有潜变量推理方法，并在多个基准上取得最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 在推理过程级别监督潜变量表示比传统的特征级别对齐提供了更有效的多模态潜变量推理范式。

title: Share the Judge, Learn the Deferral: Where Specialization Helps LLM Evaluation
summary: Agentic systems have widened the gap between producing candidate outputs and reviewing them. This paper asks a practical architectural question: should domain specialization be built into an evaluator's weights, or into the rule that decides when its judgment can be trusted? We study 99,952 public, rubric-conditioned examples. Supplying the correct rubric improves locked-test accuracy by 2.11 points over a response-only control; replacing it with an unrelated rubric costs 2.66 points. Dividing the same training corpus among eight criterion-family LoRA judges, however, loses 10.05 points and cuts audited coverage at a 5% risk target from 24.44% to 5.43%. Matching the bank's stored capacity with one rank-64 adapter does not reproduce this loss. Nor is the result explained by learning rate or optimizer steps. Initializing the family adapters from a shared, trained judge recovers test accuracy to 76.85%, 19.94 points above scratch training at the same learning rate (95% interval 18.88-21.02). The result changes when specialization governs deferral rather than judgment. On RewardBench 2, learned correctness heads route examples through a 0.6B-4B-8B cascade without changing any reward score. Across 20 locked repartitions, the cascade attains 89.40% accuracy, compared with 84.75% for 8B alone, at 0.415 normalized parameter compute. Every run passes an exact one-sided 95% risk audit; margin-based rules remain near 84.8% accuracy while using at least 0.94 compute. These results suggest a qualified design rule: share the learning of judgment until there is enough data to justify a split, and place domain-specific adaptation in an audited release boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文通过99,952个公开样例实验，探讨评估器（evaluator）的领域专业化应该内置于模型权重还是通过可信判断规则来实现。结果显示，将领域专业化置于判断/放行（deferral）规则中比内置在专用LoRA权重中更优：共享训练+审计放行边界的设计显著优于拆分训练集训练多个专用judge。
AI.motivation: Agentic系统在产生候选输出与审查输出之间的差距日益扩大。需要回答一个实际的架构问题：领域专业化应内置于评估器的权重中，还是内置于决定其判断何时可被信任的规则中？
AI.method: 使用99,952个公开的rubric条件化样例进行对照实验。比较三种方案：(1)响应-only对照；(2)将训练语料分为8个标准族（criterion-family）分别训练LoRA judge；(3)单一大rank-64适配器。进一步实验将专业化置于放行（deferral）规则中：在RewardBench 2上通过学习的正确性头将样例路由至0.6B-4B-8B级联，不改变任何奖励分数。
AI.result: 正确rubric相比响应-only对照提升2.11分；无关rubric降低2.66分。拆分为8个LoRA judge损失10.05分，审计覆盖率从24.44%降至5.43%。从共享预训练judge初始化一族适配器恢复至76.85%，比scratch训练高19.94分。RewardBench 2上级联方案在20个锁定重分区中达89.40%准确率（对比8B单独的84.75%），仅用0.415归一化参数计算量，且每轮通过精确侧95%风险审计。
AI.conclusion: 提出一个有条件的设计规则：在数据量足够支撑拆分之前共享判断学习，将领域特定适配放在经审计的放行边界（release boundary）中实现。

title: S-Avatar: Diffusion-Guided Gaussian Head Avatars from a Single Image
summary: We propose S-Avatar, a novel method for generating photorealistic 3D head avatars from a single image using a diffusion-guided 3D model generation module and strategies for animating 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). While single-image head avatar reconstruction is crucial for lifelike Virtual Reality (VR) applications, existing approaches often struggle to preserve 3D consistency under unseen viewpoints. S-Avatar addresses this limitation through a three-stage pipeline. First, a high-resolution 3DGS is synthesized directly from a single image using a diffusion-based Gaussian splat generation module. Next, the parametric head model FLAME is aligned with the generated 3DGS by optimizing its parameters and spatial transformations. Finally, to adapt the 3DGS to FLAME variations, we construct a binding template that encodes the spatial relationship between the initial splats and FLAME. The dynamic 3D head avatar can then be rendered in real time by deforming the 3DGS with the binding template. By combining diffusion-guided canonical 3DGS generation with FLAME-based control, our method achieves efficient and accurate reconstruction with enhanced 3D consistency. Evaluations on public datasets demonstrate that S-Avatar outperforms state-of-the-art methods in novel-view and expression generation, achieving superior realism and consistency. Consequently, our approach represents a significant advance in accessible avatar creation, applicable to a wide range of VR/AR applications. The project page is available at https://github.com/hailsong/savatar.

AI.tldr: S-Avatar提出了一种从单张图像生成逼真3D头部头像的新方法，通过扩散引导的3D模型生成模块与FLAME参数化模型结合，采用三阶段流水线（扩散生成3DGS、FLAME对齐、绑定模板适配）实现实时动态3D头像渲染，在公开数据集上优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 单图头部头像重建对VR应用至关重要，但现有方法在未见视角下难以保持3D一致性，导致重建结果不够真实和稳定。
AI.method: 采用三阶段流水线：(1) 利用扩散模型从单张图像直接合成高分辨率3D高斯溅射(3DGS)；(2) 将FLAME参数化头部模型与生成的3DGS进行对齐，优化参数和空间变换；(3) 构建绑定模板编码初始高斯与FLAME之间的空间关系，通过变形3DGS实现实时动态头像渲染。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上的评估表明，S-Avatar在新视角生成和表情生成方面均优于现有最先进方法，实现了更优的真实感和一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将扩散引导的3DGS生成与FLAME控制相结合，为VR/AR应用提供了高效、准确且可广泛使用的头像创建方案，是虚拟现实头部头像重建领域的重要进展。

title: SKIMIX: Multi-Agent Harness-Time Scaling with Skill Mixture for Dynamic Harness Engineering
summary: AI agents increasingly rely on large skill libraries, but selecting, combining, and maintaining skills remains difficult. We propose SKIMIX, a multi-agent framework in which agents with different skill portfolios collaborate through iterative refinement. SKIMIX combines embedding-based skill retrieval, submodular anti-dilution routing, and adaptive skill evolution. Across six reasoning benchmarks, multi-agent collaboration substantially improves open-ended mathematical reasoning but offers limited or negative gains on multiple-choice tasks. Agent-count scaling is non-monotonic, and most improvements arise during the first refinement round. These results show that task characteristics determine whether skill-level ensembles help and provide practical guidance for scalable agent design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SKIMIX多智能体框架，通过嵌入检索、次模反稀释路由和自适应技能演化来优化大规模技能库的利用。实验发现多智能体协作能显著提升开放式数学推理，但对多项选择任务收益有限甚至为负。
AI.motivation: AI智能体日益依赖大规模技能库，但如何选择、组合和维护技能仍然具有挑战性，现有方法缺乏系统性的多智能体协作机制来解决这一问题。
AI.method: SKIMIX框架包含三个关键组件：基于嵌入的技能检索、次模反稀释路由（用于避免信息冗余）以及自适应技能演化机制。多个持有不同技能组合的智能体通过迭代精炼进行协作。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准上，多智能体协作在开放式数学推理上取得显著提升，但在多项选择任务上收益有限甚至为负。智能体数量扩展呈现非单调性，大部分改进出现在第一轮精炼中。
AI.conclusion: 任务特征决定了技能级集成是否有帮助，为可扩展智能体设计提供了实用指导。

title: Think with Extra-Image: A Farmland Segmentation Agent Driven by Spatio-Temporal Information Gain
summary: Existing farmland remote sensing image (FRSI) segmentation follows a "Think with Intra-Image" paradigm, assuming that the current image contains sufficient visual evidence for reliable segmentation. Yet farmland appearance varies with phenology and spatial context and is often confused with other land-cover, making instantaneous, local observations inadequate. Thus, segmentation ambiguity stems not only from limited model representation, but more fundamentally from the required spatio-temporal information lying beyond the current image. Based on this insight, we redefine FRSI segmentation from an information bottleneck perspective as a dynamic decision process driven by task-relevant extra spatio-temporal information gain. We further propose FarmSeeker, a dynamic FRSI segmentation agent that identifies ambiguous regions, reasons about their causes, and queries extra spatio-temporal information on demand for accurate segmentation. To evaluate FarmSeeker, we construct GSFS-Bench, the first global-scale, high-resolution FRSI segmentation benchmark that supports reasoning-querying. Experiments show that FarmSeeker achieves more stable segmentation performance than existing methods. The project is publicly available at: https://withoutocean.github.io/FarmSeeker/

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义了农田遥感图像分割问题，从信息瓶颈视角提出将分割视为由任务相关的时空信息增益驱动的动态决策过程，并提出了FarmSeeker动态分割智能体及全球尺度基准GSFS-Bench。
AI.motivation: 现有农田遥感图像分割遵循"图像内思考"范式，假设当前图像包含足够视觉证据。然而农田外观随物候和空间背景变化，常与其他地物混淆，导致瞬时局部观测不足。分割歧义的根本原因不仅是模型表征能力有限，更在于所需时空信息超出当前图像范围。
AI.method: 从信息瓶颈视角将农田遥感图像分割重新定义为动态决策过程，提出FarmSeeker动态分割智能体，能够识别模糊区域、推理歧义原因，并按需查询额外时空信息以提升分割准确性。同时构建了GSFS-Bench基准，支持推理-查询的新范式。
AI.result: 实验表明FarmSeeker在分割性能上比现有方法更稳定，GSFS-Bench是首个全球尺度、高分辨率的支持推理与查询的农田遥感图像分割基准。
AI.conclusion: 从"图像内思考"转向"动态查询外部信息"的范式转变能有效解决农田分割中的时空信息缺失问题，为遥感图像分割提供了新的思路和工具。

title: MMLDSum-LLM: Multimodal Long-Document Summarization with Visual-Alignment and Keyword-Aware
summary: Multimodal long documents are core carriers of professional knowledge, where critical evidence is sparsely distributed across paragraphs and modalities. This easily causes key information omission and cross-modal hallucinations in summarization by multimodal LLMs. These issues stem from attention drift in long-range dependency modeling and gaps in inter-modal alignment. To address this, we introduce MMLDSum-Bench, a high-quality benchmark for multimodal long-document summarization, covering multiple domains, context-length scales, and visual-textual modality distributions. We further propose MMLDSum-LLM, a reproducible two-stage training framework that combines supervised fine-tuning with visual-alignment weighted loss and keyword-aware weighted loss, followed by GRPO with a multi-objective reward (keyword coverage, image-text alignment, ROUGE, and length control). Extensive experiments on MMLDSum-Bench, comparing against leading closed-source and open-source multimodal models under a unified evaluation protocol - including LLM-as-a-judge scoring, atomic-claim precision/recall, image-text alignment (ITA), and ROUGE - demonstrate that our approach significantly improves key-information coverage and cross-modal consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态长文档摘要中关键信息遗漏和跨模态幻觉问题，提出了高质量基准MMLDSum-Bench和两阶段训练框架MMLDSum-LLM，通过视觉对齐加权损失、关键词感知加权损失和GRPO多目标奖励，显著提升了关键信息覆盖率和跨模态一致性。
AI.motivation: 多模态长文档是专业知识的重要载体，关键证据稀疏地分布在段落和模态之间，导致多模态大模型在摘要时容易出现关键信息遗漏和跨模态幻觉。这些问题源于长距离依赖建模中的注意力漂移以及跨模态对齐的不足。
AI.method: 提出了MMLDSum-Bench基准（覆盖多领域、多上下文长度和视觉-文本模态分布），以及MMLDSum-LLM两阶段训练框架：第一阶段采用监督微调，结合视觉对齐加权损失和关键词感知加权损失；第二阶段采用GRPO强化学习，使用多目标奖励（包括关键词覆盖率、图文对齐、ROUGE和长度控制）。
AI.result: 在统一评估协议下（LLM-as-a-judge评分、原子声明精确率/召回率、图文对齐ITA、ROUGE），与领先的开源和闭源多模态模型进行对比，实验证明该方法显著提升了关键信息覆盖率和跨模态一致性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供的高质量基准和可复现的训练框架有效解决了多模态长文档摘要中的关键信息遗漏和跨模态幻觉问题，为多模态长文档摘要领域提供了新的评估标准和解决方案。

title: SciDataSailor: Deep Scientific Data Exploring
summary: Scientific datasets are commonly organized as hierarchical repositories containing heterogeneous and interdependent files, making their inspection, integration, and analysis labor-intensive and reliant on domain expertise. Although large language model (LLM) agents have advanced substantially in planning, reasoning, and tool use, existing research has largely overlooked their ability to interact with real scientific data assets through executable environments. We introduce Deep Scientific Data Exploration, an agentic task paradigm in which agents navigate repositories, interpret heterogeneous files and schemas, execute analyses, integrate cross-file evidence, and produce conclusions grounded in executed observations. To operationalize this paradigm, we present SciDataSailor, a framework for synthesizing tool-interactive trajectories by balancing broad exploration with targeted exploitation. SciDataSailor instantiates trajectory synthesis as Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with four task-specific mechanisms: difficulty-stratified exploration seeds, dual-feedback first-play urgency, hierarchical strategy-to-tool action generation, and entropy-guided branching. Using this framework, we construct SciDataSailor-SFT-2K for supervised fine-tuning and SciDataSailor-Bench for evaluation, with the latter comprising 627 meta-information summarization tasks and 586 scientific question-answering tasks across 27 datasets spanning the life, earth, and physical sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Deep Scientific Data Exploration（深度科学数据探索）这一智能体任务范式，并推出SciDataSailor框架，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索合成工具交互轨迹，构建了SciDataSailor-SFT-2K训练数据集和SciDataSailor-Bench评估基准（含627个元信息摘要任务和586个科学问答任务，覆盖27个数据集），以提升LLM智能体在真实科学数据仓库中的导航、解析、分析与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 科学数据集通常以层次化仓库形式组织，包含异构且相互依赖的文件，人工检查、集成和分析成本高且依赖领域专业知识。尽管LLM智能体在规划、推理和工具使用方面已有显著进展，但现有研究很大程度上忽略了它们通过可执行环境与真实科学数据资产交互的能力，这构成了一个重要的研究空白。
AI.method: 论文提出SciDataSailor框架，将轨迹合成形式化为蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），并设计了四个任务特定的机制：（1）难度分层的探索种子，（2）双反馈的首步紧迫性，（3）层级化策略到工具的动作生成，（4）熵引导的分支选择。该框架平衡了广泛探索与定向利用，用于合成工具交互轨迹。
AI.result: 利用该框架构建了SciDataSailor-SFT-2K用于监督微调，以及SciDataSailor-Bench用于评估。评估基准包含27个数据集上的627个元信息摘要任务和586个科学问答任务，涵盖生命科学、地球科学和物理科学三大领域。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入智能体化的科学数据探索范式与配套框架，为LLM智能体在真实科学数据环境中进行深度探索和结论生成提供了系统化的解决方案，并建立了相应的训练与评估基准，填补了该领域的研究空白。

title: Scaling Vision-Language Models Is Not Enough to Mitigate Bias
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP are now foundational to multimodal systems, yet their robustness to spurious correlations remains poorly understood at scale. We present the first large-scale empirical study of 194 publicly available VLMs, including 16 model families, covering a wide range of model sizes, 24 training datasets, and three evaluation benchmarks, namely ImageNet (overall performance), CelebA (typical single-attribute bias), and UrbanCars (complex multi-attribute biases). Across these settings, the Spearman correlation between model scale and performance weakens as evaluation shifts from ImageNet ($ρ{=}0.68$) to single-attribute ($ρ{=}0.48$) and further to multi-attribute ($ρ{=}0.05$) bias benchmarks. In contrast, properties of the training data (size and quality) show more consistent relationships with worst-group accuracy across both bias benchmarks. Notably, curated datasets yield improvements of up to 25% over uncurated alternatives at a comparable scale. Finally, the effect of architectural choices (e.g., patch size, image resolution) is highly context-dependent, varying with the nature of the benchmark, including the type of bias and its spatial distribution within images.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对194个公开可用的视觉语言模型（VLM）进行了大规模实证研究，涵盖16个模型家族、24个训练数据集和3个评估基准，系统性地考察了模型规模、训练数据属性及架构选择对虚假相关性鲁棒性的影响。
AI.motivation: 尽管CLIP等视觉语言模型已成为多模态系统的基础，但其对虚假相关的鲁棒性在大规模范围内仍缺乏深入理解。现有研究往往局限于小规模或单一基准，无法全面揭示模型规模、数据属性与鲁棒性之间的真实关系。
AI.method: 构建包含194个VLM的大规模评测框架，涵盖16个模型家族、24个训练数据集，在ImageNet（整体性能）、CelebA（单属性偏差）和UrbanCars（多属性偏差）三个基准上进行系统评估，并通过Spearman相关性分析、对比不同数据策划策略及架构配置来揭示各因素与鲁棒性的关系。
AI.result: 研究发现模型规模与性能的相关性从ImageNet（ρ=0.68）到单属性偏差（ρ=0.48）再降到多属性偏差基准（ρ=0.05），显著弱化；训练数据大小和质量与最差组准确率有一致关系，精心策划的数据集在相同规模下比非策划方案提升高达25%；架构选择（如patch size、图像分辨率）的影响高度依赖基准性质、偏差类型及其空间分布。
AI.conclusion: 模型规模并非鲁棒性的可靠预测因子，特别是在复杂多属性偏差场景下；训练数据的质量与规模才是更稳定的鲁棒性影响因素；架构设计决策需要根据具体基准和偏差特性来针对性选择，不能依赖通用规律。

title: CDAE: Enhancing Perturbation Robustness in Pretrained Language Models with Contrastive Denoising
comment: Submitted to 16th International Conference on Computer and Knowledge Engineering (ICCKE 2026)
summary: Pre-trained language models have significantly improved sentence representation learning, yet their embedding remain sensitive to semantic preserving textual perturbations such as synonym substitution, masking and word dropout. This work proposes a lightweight Contrastive Denoising Autoencoder (CDAE) that refines pre-trained BERT embedding by jointly optimizing contrastive and reconstruction objective to learn perturbation-invariant representation. We evaluate the proposed framework using multiple perturbation strategies with varying strengths and compare it against the original BERT embeddings and SimCSE. Experimental results show that CDAE consistently preserves higher embedding similarity under perturbations, with the improvements becoming more pronounced as framework effectively enhances representation stability while preserving semantic information, highlighting perturbation-invariant learning as a promising direction for improving sentence embeddings. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/ComputationIASBS/CDAE

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级对比去噪自编码器（CDAE），通过联合优化对比学习和重构目标来精炼预训练BERT嵌入，使其对同义词替换、掩码和词丢弃等语义保持扰动更具不变性，实验表明在保持语义信息的同时显著提升了嵌入表示的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型虽显著提升了句子表示学习，但其嵌入对同义词替换、掩码和词丢弃等语义保持型文本扰动仍然敏感，导致表示稳定性不足。
AI.method: 提出轻量级对比去噪自编码器（CDAE），通过联合优化对比学习目标与重构目标，对预训练BERT嵌入进行精炼，学习扰动不变的句子表示。
AI.result: 在多种扰动策略及不同强度下与原始BERT嵌入和SimCSE对比，CDAE在扰动下持续保持更高的嵌入相似度，且随着框架增强表示稳定性和保持语义信息，改进效果更加明显。
AI.conclusion: 扰动不变学习是改进句子嵌入表示的有前景方向，CDAE有效提升了嵌入表示稳定性，代码已公开。

title: FaithEyes: Towards Faithful Tool Use via Multi-Agent Process-Image Verification
summary: Agentic vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave textual reasoning with explicit tool calls such as cropping and code-based image manipulation, have emerged as a compelling paradigm for reliable and interpretable multimodal reasoning. However, recent studies have revealed that such models often use tools unfaithfully. Many process images are irrelevant to the question (e.g., the tool crops the wrong region or misses the queried target), yet the call still receives full credit and the model still answers correctly. Such decorative or misaligned tool calls waste computation and reveal that the model leans on prior knowledge or the original image rather than the evidence it retrieves. This may stem from two limitations of prevailing methods: the tool reward fails to distinguish useful from useless calls, and tool feedback carries no signal of usefulness. To this end, we introduce FaithEyes, a multi-agent self-judging framework. Concretely, we use a VLM to judge whether each process image helps answer the question. The judgement is injected into the reasoning context as part of the tool observation to help subsequent reasoning, and meanwhile is used to scale the tool reward by the helpful-tool ratio to suppress reward hacking. To keep judgement available at evaluation and thus ensure train-test consistency, we further design a multi-agent framework where the model itself serves as a subagent to judge the tool calls from main agent, eliminating any dependence on an external model at inference. Training via a two-stage SFT + RL pipeline on adapted open-source data, FaithEyes attains competitive or superior accuracy across visual perception and reasoning benchmarks, while markedly improving tool faithfulness. The homepage is at https://github.com/Mosi-AI/FaithEyes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FaithEyes，一个多智能体自评判框架，用于提升智能体视觉语言模型（VLM）工具调用的忠实度。通过让VLM自身作为子智能体评判主智能体的工具调用是否有帮助，将评判结果注入推理上下文并用于缩放工具奖励，从而抑制奖励黑客行为，在保持准确率的同时显著提升工具调用的忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体VLM在推理过程中经常进行不忠实的工具调用——许多处理图像与问题无关（如裁剪错误区域或错过目标），但仍获得满分且模型仍能正确回答。这种装饰性或错位的工具调用浪费计算资源，且表明模型依赖先验知识而非检索到的证据。根本原因在于：工具奖励无法区分有用与无用的调用，且工具反馈中缺乏有用性的信号。
AI.method: FaithEyes采用多智能体自评判框架：1）使用VLM评判每个过程图像是否有助于回答问题；2）将评判结果作为工具观察的一部分注入推理上下文，辅助后续推理；3）用有用工具比例缩放工具奖励以抑制奖励黑客行为；4）设计多智能体框架，让模型自身作为子智能体评判主智能体的工具调用，避免推理时依赖外部模型，保证训练与测试一致性；5）采用两阶段SFT+RL训练流程，在自适应的开源数据上训练。
AI.result: 在视觉感知和推理基准上取得了有竞争力或更优的准确率，同时显著提高了工具调用的忠实度。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: FaithEyes通过自评判机制有效解决了智能体VLM工具调用不忠实的问题，在不牺牲性能的前提下提升了工具使用的可靠性，为多模态推理中工具调用的可信度提供了新的解决方案。

title: DataClawEval: A Benchmark for Data Engineering Agents in Real Industrial Harness
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly being deployed to automate complex workflows, promising to revolutionize data management and processing. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on simplified Text-to-SQL translation or data analysis, leaving the critical and complex domain of end-to-end data engineering largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce DataClawEval, the first comprehensive benchmark designed specifically to evaluate the end-to-end task completion capabilities of autonomous agents in real-world data engineering scenarios. Built upon production-grade code authored by professional enterprise data engineers, it comprises 100 rigorous, end-to-end tasks spanning five execution engines: PySpark, MySQL, HiveSQL, PrestoSQL/Trino, and FlinkSQL. Rather than non-deterministic LLM-as-a-judge scoring, each task is executed within a case-specific, isolated sandbox and graded by deterministic, rule-based scripts. Evaluating 16 frontier agents exposes critical limitations: The strongest model attains only 74.9 overall, and no single model dominates, as each excels on a different engine, revealing strict domain specialization rather than omnipotent proficiency. Thus, autonomous data engineering remains a formidable, unresolved challenge. We release our dataset, containerized environments, and deterministic evaluation scripts at https://github.com/Dicemy/DataClawEval/tree/master

AI.tldr: 提出了DataClawEval，首个专门评估自主智能体在真实数据工程场景中端到端任务完成能力的综合基准，包含100个跨5种执行引擎的任务，采用确定性规则评分，评估16个前沿智能体后发现最强模型仅得74.9分，且没有单一模型能全面胜出。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要聚焦于简化的Text-to-SQL翻译或数据分析，忽略了端到端数据工程这一关键且复杂的领域，缺乏对自主智能体在真实数据工程场景中完成任务能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 基于专业企业数据工程师编写的生产级代码构建基准，包含100个跨PySpark、MySQL、HiveSQL、PrestoSQL/Trino和FlinkSQL五种执行引擎的端到端任务；每个任务在特定隔离沙盒中执行，并由确定性规则脚本而非LLM评判打分；评估16个前沿智能体。
AI.result: 最强模型仅达到74.9的整体得分；没有任何单一模型在所有引擎上均表现优异，每个模型在不同引擎上有各自优势，显示出严格的领域专业化而非全面能力。
AI.conclusion: 自主数据工程仍然是一个艰巨且尚未解决的挑战，该基准揭示了当前LLM智能体在该领域的显著局限性。

title: GLM-RAG: Graph Language Models for Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over knowledge graphs requires retrievers that can effectively capture both graph structure and semantic information. Recent approaches have explored graph neural network (GNN)-based retrievers to model graph topology in multi-hop reasoning tasks. In parallel, graph language models (GLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm that integrates graph reasoning and the semantic capabilities of language models. In this work, we introduce a GLM-based retriever and investigate the comparative strengths of GLM-based, GNN-based, and traditional vector-search-based retrievers in single- and multi-hop RAG settings, and with a particular focus on transferability to unseen domains. Our findings suggest that finetuned GLM retrievers generalize better out of domain, achieving SOTA on two multi-hop benchmarks. On in-domain multi-hop QA datasets they remain comparable to prior work, with promising scaling as parameters and subgraph coverage increase. GNN-based retrievers achieve higher graph coverage with an efficient training setup, whereas the vector-search baseline excels at single-hop datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图语言模型（GLM）的检索器，并将其与基于图神经网络（GNN）的检索器和传统向量检索方法在单跳与多跳RAG场景中进行系统比较，重点关注跨域泛化能力。实验结果表明，微调后的GLM检索器在跨域泛化上表现最优，在两个多跳基准上达到SOTA；GNN检索器在图覆盖率和训练效率上占优；向量检索基线在单跳数据集上表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱上的检索增强生成（RAG）需要能够同时捕捉图结构和语义信息的检索器。已有的工作探索了基于GNN的检索器来建模多跳推理中的图拓扑结构，而图语言模型（GLM）作为一种将图推理与语言模型语义能力结合的新范式尚未在检索器领域得到充分研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统对比三类检索器的优劣。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于GLM的检索器，并在单跳和多跳RAG设置下，对GLM-based、GNN-based和传统向量检索（vector-search）三类检索器进行系统比较。实验聚焦于跨域迁移能力（transferability to unseen domains），同时考察参数规模和子图覆盖率对性能的影响。
AI.result: 微调后的GLM检索器在域外泛化方面表现更优，在两个多跳基准上取得了SOTA成绩；在域内多跳QA数据集上与现有方法表现相当，且随着参数规模和子图覆盖率的增加性能有良好扩展。GNN检索器以高效的训练设置获得了更高的图覆盖率，而向量检索基线在单跳数据集上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: GLM检索器在跨域多跳推理任务中展现出了最佳的泛化能力，表明将图结构信息与语言模型语义能力结合是提升RAG检索器跨域表现的有效路径；不同检索器在不同场景下各有优劣，选择何种检索器需根据任务特性（单跳/多跳、域内/域外）而定。

title: EgoGenesis: Egocentric World-Action Modeling with Online Anchored Projective Memory and Action-3D RoPE
summary: Egocentric video offers rich manipulation experience for embodied AI, yet collecting diverse egocentric data across scenes, objects, motions, and embodiments remains costly. We present \method, an egocentric world-action simulator that synthesizes controllable, high-quality manipulation videos to expand scarce real-world training data. \method{} builds on a pretrained video generation prior and introduces two geometry-aware conditioning mechanisms. Online Anchored Projective Memory (OAPM) preserves a first-frame 3D scene anchor while periodically refreshing a recent state during autoregressive generation. Action-3D Rotary Position Embedding (A3D-RoPE) encodes end-effector motion with camera-aware 3D rotary coordinates, injecting action geometry into skeleton-to-video cross-attention for precise control. Together, these components improve visual fidelity, geometric stability, and action alignment in long egocentric rollouts. Moreover, augmenting 400 real trajectories with 400 \method-generated trajectories improves out-of-distribution real-robot success from 77\% to 84\% on single-arm tasks and from 53\% to 70\% on dual-arm tasks, demonstrating that the synthesized data substantially improve downstream WAM generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoWAM，一个基于预训练视频生成先验的自我中心世界动作模拟器，通过两种几何感知条件机制（OAPM和A3D-RoPE）合成可控、高质量的操作视频来扩充稀缺的真实训练数据。实验表明，用400条合成轨迹增强400条真实轨迹，可将单臂和双臂任务的下游机器人在分布外泛化成功率分别从77%提升至84%、从53%提升至70%。
AI.motivation: 自我中心视频能提供丰富的操作经验，但跨场景、物体、动作和具身形态收集多样化的自我中心数据成本高昂，因此需要一种能合成可控高质量操作视频的方法来扩展稀缺的真实世界训练数据。
AI.method: EgoWAM构建在预训练视频生成先验之上，提出两种几何感知条件机制：(1) 在线锚定投影记忆（OAPM），在自回归生成中保留首帧3D场景锚点并定期刷新近期状态；(2) 动作3D旋转位置编码（A3D-RoPE），利用相机感知的3D旋转坐标编码末端执行器运动，将动作几何注入骨架到视频的交叉注意力中实现精确控制。
AI.result: 在长序列自我中心展开中提升了视觉保真度、几何稳定性和动作对齐。用400条EgoWAM生成的轨迹增强400条真实轨迹，在分布外真实机器人任务上，单臂任务成功率从77%提升至84%，双臂任务从53%提升至70%。
AI.conclusion: 合成的数据能够显著提升下游世界动作模型（WAM）的泛化能力，验证了EgoWAM作为可扩展数据扩充工具的有效性。

title: SKILL-KD: Contrastive Skill Distillation for LLM Agents
summary: Skill-based prompting has become a practical mechanism for improving large language model (LLM) agents, yet existing skill acquisition methods often treat skills as experience summaries, memory entries, or direct summaries of successful demonstrations. This creates a mismatch for weaker student agents: when a student fails because it lacks task knowledge or operational strategy, its failed trajectory may not contain enough evidence to infer the missing behavior, while the teacher trajectory may be too implicit to be internalized as reusable guidance. We propose SKILL-KD, a contrastive skill distillation framework that treats skills as an explicit distillation medium between agents of different capabilities. Given a student failure and the teacher trajectory on the same task, SKILL-KD distills their actionable discrepancy into a textual skill patch, evaluates the patch by re-running the student, and iteratively refines the patch when the student still fails. To prevent repeated local updates from causing skill drift, SKILL-KD further maintains trace-linked edit histories and performs Drift-Aware Skill Consolidation, deciding whether each patch should add a new rule, delete or modify an existing rule, or be skipped. Across five agent benchmarks and two student settings, SKILL-KD consistently improves frozen student agents over fixed-model adaptation baselines.

AI.tldr: SKILL-KD是一个对比技能蒸馏框架，将技能作为不同能力智能体之间的显式蒸馏媒介。通过对比学生失败轨迹与教师轨迹，提炼出可操作的技能补丁，通过重运行学生评估补丁并迭代优化，同时采用漂移感知技能整合来防止技能漂移。
AI.motivation: 现有技能获取方法将技能视为经验摘要、记忆条目或成功示范的直接总结，这导致较弱的学生智能体在缺乏任务知识或操作策略时，其失败轨迹可能没有足够证据推断缺失行为，而教师轨迹又过于隐晦难以内化为可复用的指导。因此需要一种更显式的技能蒸馏机制。
AI.method: SKILL-KD通过对比学生失败轨迹和同一任务上的教师轨迹，提炼两者之间的可操作差异为文本技能补丁。然后通过重运行学生来评估补丁效果，若学生仍失败则迭代细化补丁。为了防止重复局部更新导致技能漂移，维护追踪链接的编辑历史，并执行漂移感知技能整合，决定每个补丁应添加新规则、删除或修改现有规则，或跳过。
AI.result: 在五个智能体基准和两种学生设置下，SKILL-KD持续优于固定模型自适应基线。
AI.conclusion: SKILL-KD通过将技能作为显式蒸馏媒介，成功弥合了不同能力智能体之间的差距，使冻结的学生智能体能够有效提升性能，且具备防止技能漂移的机制。

title: WIDE: Boosting Adaptive LLM Inference via Token-level Dynamic Width Pruning
summary: Pruning is a promising approach for improving the efficiency of LLMs. Existing static structured pruning methods are hardware-friendly and can deliver practical throughput gains, but their input-agnostic computation allocation often causes substantial accuracy degradation under aggressive sparsity. Recent dynamic sparsity methods improve quality retention by adapting computation to individual inputs, yet they remain largely limited to coarse-grained structural decisions and their practical acceleration under real-world inference scenarios remains challenging. To address these challenges, we present WIDE, the first end-to-end differentiable token-level dynamic width pruning framework designed for both prefill and decode scenarios. WIDE enables fine-grained computation allocation by allowing each token to dynamically select attention-head groups and FFN-channel groups, extending dynamic pruning beyond layer-level decisions to neuron-block-level granularity. Through a two-stage training pipeline, WIDE learns effective token-wise sparse execution patterns and achieves substantially better quality retention than existing approaches. To make such fine-grained dynamic pruning practical, we further propose a pruning--kernel co-design framework that decomposes dynamic sparsity acceleration into mask reordering, hardware-agnostic block-level skipping, and hardware-dependent intra-block skipping, enabling efficient execution across different granularities. At 50% sparsity, WIDE provides 55.1% performance boost when compared to the state-of-the-art dynamic depth pruning under calibration-only settings. Under prefill and decoding inference workloads, WIDE achieves close-to-theoretical kernel-level speedups of up to 1.98x for prefill and 4.95x for decoding, as well as 1.68x and 1.55x end-to-end acceleration. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning/tree/main/WIDE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WIDE，这是首个端到端可微分的token级动态宽度剪枝框架，同时面向预填充和解码场景。WIDE允许每个token动态选择注意力头组和FFN通道组，将动态剪枝从层级别扩展到神经元块级别粒度，并通过两阶段训练和剪枝-内核协同设计实现细粒度动态剪枝的实际加速，在50%稀疏度下相比最先进的动态深度剪枝方法获得55.1%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有静态结构化剪枝方法虽然硬件友好、吞吐量增益明显，但其输入无关的计算分配在激进稀疏度下会导致严重的精度下降；而现有动态稀疏方法虽然能通过适应个体输入来保留质量，但大多局限于粗粒度的结构决策，且在实际推理场景中的加速效果仍具挑战性。因此需要一种既能细粒度适应输入、又能实际加速的方法。
AI.method: WIDE框架包括三个关键设计：(1) 端到端可微分的token级动态宽度剪枝，允许每个token动态选择注意力头组和FFN通道组，实现神经元块级别的细粒度计算分配；(2) 两阶段训练流程，学习有效的token级稀疏执行模式；(3) 剪枝-内核协同设计框架，将动态稀疏加速分解为掩码重排、硬件无关的块级跳过程和硬件相关的块内跳过程，支持不同粒度的高效执行。
AI.result: 在50%稀疏度下，WIDE相比最先进的动态深度剪枝在仅校准设置下获得55.1%的性能提升。在预填充和解码推理工作负载下，WIDE实现接近理论极限的内核级加速，预填充最高1.98倍、解码最高4.95倍，端到端加速分别为1.68倍和1.55倍。
AI.conclusion: WIDE通过将动态剪枝扩展到神经元块级别的细粒度、设计两阶段训练流程以及提出剪枝-内核协同设计框架，成功解决了动态剪枝方法在实际推理场景中难以实现有效加速的问题，在保持高质量保留的同时实现了接近理论极限的实际加速效果。

title: Space2Ground 2.0: A Multi-Source Dataset and Framework for Agricultural Monitoring through Fusion of Street-Level and Satellite Imagery
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 45th EARSeL Symposium, Athens, Greece
summary: Accurate and scalable parcel-level agricultural monitoring remains challenging because satellite Earth Observation alone provides only an overhead perspective of agricultural parcels, while optical observations are further affected by cloud-induced temporal gaps. This paper presents Space2Ground 2.0, a multi-source framework integrating Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral time series with geo-tagged street-level imagery acquired using vehicle-mounted cameras and shared through the Mapillary platform. A largely automated processing pipeline performs semantic filtering, image quality assessment, viewpoint-based parcel association, and dataset refinement, transforming large volumes of crowdsourced imagery into parcel-linked, analysis-ready data. Applied over Cyprus during the 2022 growing season, the pipeline produced a curated dataset of 46,050 annotated street-level images, selected from an initial collection exceeding 900,000 images and linked with satellite information for 8,581 agricultural parcels. The practical value of the dataset was assessed through parcel-level crop classification experiments using both single- and multi-source observations. The results demonstrate that street-level imagery provides complementary fine-scale visual information that enhances classification when integrated with satellite time series. Overall, Space2Ground 2.0 provides an openly available benchmark dataset and a reproducible methodology for multimodal agricultural monitoring, with potential applications in visual verification, reduced reliance on costly field inspections, and data-driven agricultural policy implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Space2Ground 2.0框架，将Sentinel-1/2卫星时间序列与Mapillary平台的道路街景图像集成，实现地块级农业监测。在塞浦路斯2022年生长季应用中，从90万+图像中筛选出46,050张标注街景图像，关联8,581个农业地块，并通过作物分类实验证明多源数据融合可提升分类性能。
AI.motivation: 仅依靠卫星对地观测进行地块级农业监测存在局限：卫星只能提供俯视视角，且光学观测受云层影响产生时间序列缺失，亟需引入补充性的地面视角数据进行多模态融合。
AI.method: 构建多源框架集成Sentinel-1 SAR和Sentinel-2多光谱时间序列与街景图像（车载相机拍摄、Mapillary平台共享），通过自动化处理流水线执行语义过滤、图像质量评估、基于视角的地块关联和数据集精化，将众包图像转化为与地块关联的分析就绪数据。
AI.result: 在塞浦路斯2022年生长季，从超过90万张图像中筛选出46,050张标注街景图像，关联8,581个农业地块；单源和多源作物分类实验表明，街景图像提供互补的细尺度视觉信息，与卫星时间序列集成后可增强分类性能。
AI.conclusion: Space2Ground 2.0提供了公开可用的基准数据集和可复现的多模态农业监测方法，在视觉验证、减少昂贵田间巡检依赖以及数据驱动的农业政策实施方面具有应用潜力。

title: IndustryForge-27B: A Domain-Enhanced Multimodal Foundation Model for Industrial CAD
summary: Automating industrial CAD design and manufacturing places distinctive demands on multimodal foundation models: the model must see engineering drawings and 3D geometry screenshots, write correct parametric-modelling scripts and Windows COM API code, and cover the full range from single parts to assemblies. General-purpose multimodal models fall short on these tasks, while single-task fine-tuning is too narrow to support the diverse calls that upper-layer agents issue. We build IndustryForge-27B on top of Qwen3.5-VL-27B by curating and integrating six industrial-CAD sub-corpora totalling $\sim$52k multimodal samples---CAD Visual QA (CAD-VQA), parametric CAD code (text2cadquery), assembly-level CAD code (text2cadquery-assembly), and three COM sub-corpora for Inventor / SolidWorks (com_2d / com_3d / com_assembly)---and training with a unified multi-task SFT recipe. Across four CAD-domain benchmarks IndustryForge-27B lifts the base model by $+33.65$~pp on average and outperforms the strong closed-source model GPT-5.4 on all four; across eleven general-capability benchmarks it retains, and slightly improves upon, the base model ($+1.56$~pp mean, no catastrophic forgetting). IndustryForge-27B will serve as the common substrate for downstream industrial-agent projects, providing a unified starting point for a full-stack industrial agent that spans from CAD design to industrial-software operation, from parts to assemblies, and from single-shot generation to closed-loop self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IndustryForge-27B，一个基于Qwen3.5-VL-27B构建的工业CAD领域多模态基础模型。通过整合六个工业CAD子语料库（约52k多模态样本），采用统一多任务SFT训练，在四个CAD基准上平均提升33.65个百分点并全面超越GPT-5.4，同时在十一个通用能力基准上保持（甚至小幅提升）基础模型性能（平均+1.56pp，无灾难性遗忘）。该模型旨在作为下游工业智能体项目的统一基础。
AI.motivation: 工业CAD设计与制造对多模态基础模型有独特要求：模型需理解工程图纸和3D几何截图、编写参数化建模脚本和Windows COM API代码，并覆盖从零件到装配的完整范围。通用多模态模型在这些任务上表现不足，而单任务微调范围过窄，无法支撑上层智能体的多样化调用需求。
AI.method: 在Qwen3.5-VL-27B基础上，整合六个工业CAD子语料库共约52k多模态样本，包括：CAD视觉问答（CAD-VQA）、参数化CAD代码（text2cadquery）、装配级CAD代码（text2cadquery-assembly），以及三个面向Inventor/SolidWorks的COM子语料库（com_2d/com_3d/com_assembly），采用统一多任务SFT（监督微调）训练策略。
AI.result: 在四个CAD领域基准上，IndustryForge-27B平均提升基础模型33.65个百分点，并在全部四个基准上超越强闭源模型GPT-5.4；在十一个通用能力基准上保持基础模型性能并略有提升（平均+1.56pp），未出现灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: IndustryForge-27B可作为下游工业智能体项目的公共基座，为全栈工业智能体提供统一起点，覆盖从CAD设计到工业软件操作、从零件到装配、从单次生成到闭环自改进的完整链路。

title: TARS: Timestep-Aware Data Scaling for 3D-Free Video Re-Shooting
summary: Video re-shooting aims to regenerate videos with controllable camera motion and viewpoint. Existing methods rely on explicit 3D priors, which are limited by reconstruction quality and often perform poorly when synthesizing previously unseen regions, or on paired videos with different camera trajectories, whose scarcity hinders generalization. We revisit video re-shooting through text-driven semantic viewpoint specification, enabling control over shot scale, viewing angle, and first-/third-person perspective. To this end, we propose TARS, a 3D-free video re-shooting paradigm. Timestep-wise sensitivity analysis reveals that camera motion is primarily established during high-noise stages, where coarse spatiotemporal structures are formed. Based on this insight, we introduce self-supervised training to learn camera dynamics and fundamental visual representations without paired re-shooting data or 3D reconstruction. Through data scaling and joint textual-camera conditioning, TARS supports robust camera and viewpoint control, plausibly synthesizing regions beyond the source view under large camera motions while enabling reverse-angle re-shooting and perspective switching. Extensive experiments show that TARS provides more accurate and temporally consistent camera control than prior methods. Project Page: https://ymlinfeng.github.io/TARS.github.io/

AI.tldr: TARS是一种无3D先验的视频重拍摄范式，通过文本驱动的语义视点指定来实现相机运动控制，利用时间步敏感性分析发现高噪声阶段是相机运动建立的关键期，并采用自监督训练学习相机动力学，无需配对重拍数据或3D重建即可实现相机和视点控制。
AI.motivation: 现有视频重拍摄方法依赖显式3D先验（受重建质量限制，合成未见区域效果差）或配对视频（数据稀缺阻碍泛化）。作者希望通过文本驱动的语义视点指定来规避这些限制，实现更通用的视频重拍摄。
AI.method: 1) 通过时间步敏感性分析发现相机运动主要在高噪声阶段建立；2) 基于此洞察引入自监督训练学习相机动力学和基础视觉表示，无需配对重拍数据或3D重建；3) 通过数据扩展和联合文本-相机条件化，支持稳健的相机和视点控制。
AI.result: 实验表明TARS在相机控制的准确性和时间一致性上优于先前方法，能够在大相机运动下合理合成源视角之外的区域，支持反向角度重拍和视角切换。
AI.conclusion: TARS验证了无需3D先验和配对数据即可实现视频重拍摄的可行性，揭示了扩散模型去噪过程中相机运动建立的时间阶段规律，为视频重拍摄提供了新范式。

title: SemPIC: Learning Semantic Position-Independent KV Caches
summary: Long-context retrieval and agentic workloads repeatedly reuse the same documents under changing instructions, histories, and document orders. Prefix caching cannot exploit this reuse, while position-independent caching (PIC) remains unreliable because independently compiled KV states lack the future context in which they will be consumed. Our diagnostics show that a learned boundary-conditioned baseline sharply reduces attention deviation near reusable-block boundaries but leaves interior and task-level residuals, motivating adaptation of the document representation itself. We present \emph{SemPIC}, which trains a LoRA-enabled Writer to compile native per-layer document KVs through behavioral distillation while retaining the pretrained decoder as an unchanged Reader. Adaptation is confined to offline cache construction, preserving the standard KV interface and cache-hit decoding path. We further introduce KV Gradient Checkpointing, which reduces peak training memory without severing gradients through cached KVs. Across three models and four tasks, SemPIC raises mean micro-F1 over KV Packet from 0.53 to 0.60, approaching Full Recompute at 0.62.

AI.tldr: SemPIC通过LoRA Writer将文档KV状态编译为位置无关的缓存，在保持预训练解码器不变的同时，利用KV梯度检查点降低训练显存，将微F1从0.53提升到0.60，接近全量重计算的0.62。
AI.motivation: 长期上下文检索和智能体工作负载会反复使用相同的文档，但前缀缓存无法利用这种复用，位置无关缓存又因独立编译的KV状态缺乏未来上下文而不可靠。
AI.method: 提出SemPIC框架，训练一个启用LoRA的Writer，通过行为蒸馏离线编译逐层文档KV，同时保持预训练解码器作为不变的Reader；引入KV梯度检查点以减少峰值训练内存而不切断通过缓存KV的梯度。
AI.result: 在三个模型和四个任务上，SemPIC将平均微F1从KV Packet的0.53提升至0.60，接近Full Recompute的0.62。
AI.conclusion: 通过将文档表示本身的适应性融入离线缓存构建，SemPIC在不改变标准KV接口和缓存命中解码路径的前提下，显著提升了位置无关缓存的可靠性。

title: SVR: Self-Verifying Refinement via Joint Verdict-Confidence Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Test-Time Compute
summary: Scaling test-time computation can improve language-model reasoning, but uniform budgets waste computation on easy inputs, while verifier-guided refinement relies on external feedback. We introduce Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR), an oracle-free multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that learns to use self-verification as a compute-control policy. At each turn, the model produces a solution together with a discrete correctness verdict and a confidence score; it retains the current answer only when the verdict is Correct and confidence exceeds a threshold, and otherwise continues refinement using its own self-verification. Ground-truth correctness is used only to construct training rewards and is never exposed to the policy through refinement prompts or required at inference. SVR is trained with GRPO on fixed-horizon trajectories using rewards that promote solution correctness, calibration-aware self-verification, and stop-ready correct states; adaptive stopping is activated only at inference. On seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3.5-2B, SVR achieves a macro-average accuracy of 0.563 with only 2.99 inference turns on average. In the evaluated complete-system comparison, it exceeds standard GRPO, strong multi-turn baselines, and a fixed-budget oracle-guided score-feedback reference while requiring substantially fewer turns than fixed ten-turn inference. These results demonstrate that learned self-verification can serve as an effective internal control signal for answer retention and adaptive test-time compute allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR)框架，一种无需外部奖励模型的多轮强化学习方法，通过自验证作为计算控制策略，在数学推理任务上以更少的推理轮次实现更高的准确率。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算扩展能提升语言模型推理能力，但统一预算在简单输入上浪费计算，而验证器引导的细化方法依赖外部反馈。因此需要一种无需外部验证器、能自适应分配测试时计算的方法。
AI.method: SVR框架在多轮交互中让模型同时生成解决方案、离散正确性判定和置信度分数；仅在判定为Correct且置信度超过阈值时才保留当前答案，否则利用自身自验证继续细化。使用GRPO在固定水平轨迹上训练，奖励函数促进答案正确性、校准感知的自验证和停止就绪的正确状态；自适应停止仅在推理时激活。
AI.result: 在七个数学推理基准上使用Qwen3.5-2B，SVR达到宏观平均准确率0.563，平均仅需2.99轮推理。在完整系统比较中超过标准GRPO、强多轮基线和固定预算的oracle引导分数反馈参考方法，同时比固定十轮推理使用更少的轮次。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的自验证可以作为有效的内部控制信号，用于答案保留和自适应测试时计算分配，无需外部验证器或推理时的真实标签。

title: Theia: Large-Scale Multimodal Captioning and Automated Validation of the Incidents1M Dataset for Data-Free Distillation
summary: The deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in critical domains like disaster management requires high-quality multimodal datasets, especially for transferring knowledge via Data-Free Knowledge Distillation (DFKD). However, existing datasets in this domain either entirely lack descriptive text, such as Incidents1M, or suffer from severe text-image semantic misalignment, such as CrisisMMD. In this work, we present a novel methodology to construct and automatically validate a large-scale multimodal dataset for disaster response. Starting from the vision-only Incidents1M, we successfully recovered 100,000 images and generated high-fidelity textual descriptions using two distinct Qwen3.5 architectures: a 4B dense model and a 35B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model. To ensure the generated captions provide reliable semantic anchoring for DFKD, we introduce an image-blind LLM-as-a-Judge validation pipeline leveraging Qwen3.5-9B. By intentionally obscuring the original image from the judge, this evaluator accurately simulates the modality gap of the student model during data-free distillation. Our evaluation across 173,179 label pairs demonstrates a high semantic agreement (78.65/100) between the two architectures. Furthermore, the automated evaluation reveals a conservative captioning behaviour, characterized by a high Precision (77.6%) and low Recall (46.0%). This minimizes the false positive noise, while simultaneously exposing underlying human annotation inconsistencies in the original ground truth. This work provides a scalable, LLM-validated multimodal dataset and a reproducible framework to advance cross-modal knowledge distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种构建和自动验证大规模多模态灾害响应数据集的方法，从视觉-only的Incidents1M数据集中恢复10万张图像，并使用两种Qwen3.5架构（4B dense和35B MoE）生成高质量文本描述，同时引入图像盲审的LLM-as-a-Judge验证流程来确保生成标注的语义可靠性，为无数据知识蒸馏（DFKD）提供高质量数据支撑。
AI.motivation: 灾害管理等关键领域部署视觉语言模型（VLM）需要高质量多模态数据集，尤其是用于无数据知识蒸馏（DFKD）的知识迁移。然而现有数据集（如Incidents1M缺少文本描述，CrisisMMD存在严重的图文语义错位），无法满足DFKD对可靠语义锚定的需求。
AI.method: 从Incidents1M中恢复10万张图像，使用Qwen3.5-4B dense和Qwen3.5-35B MoE两种架构生成文本描述；引入基于Qwen3.5-9B的图像盲审LLM-as-a-Judge验证管线，通过故意隐藏原始图像模拟学生模型在无数据蒸馏中的模态差距，从而评估生成标注的语义可靠性。
AI.result: 在173,179个标签对上的评估显示两种架构之间语义一致性高（78.65/100）；自动评估揭示了保守的字幕生成行为，高精确率（77.6%）但低召回率（46.0%），最小化了假正例噪声，同时暴露了原始标注中人类标注不一致的问题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可扩展的、经LLM验证的多模态数据集以及可复现的框架，为推进跨模态知识蒸馏做出了贡献。

title: Echoverse: Deep, Evolving Environments for Training Computer-Use Agents at Scale
summary: Computer-use agents learn from what their actions change, so training one needs applications it can act on, break and reset. The applications that matter most are login-gated and stateful, so synthetic environments stand in for them. Recent pipelines generate such environments in bulk, which moves the bottleneck from how many exist to what is inside each one. The returns, we find, come from three properties: how much behavioural depth an environment carries, whether it targets the interaction an agent actually fails, and whether it improves alongside the model. We present Echoverse, which compiles specifications into stateful applications whose tasks are graded against the application's own database, and a co-evolution loop that reads every graded rollout twice: as repairs to the environment, its tasks and its verifier, and as training signal for the model. Trained on twelve such environments, a 9B model improves from $36.5\%$ to $67.1\%$ across fourteen evaluation splits, within fourteen points of the much larger frontier model that taught it. We examine each property in turn. On the same domains, shallow environments push live-site accuracy below the base model ($80.0 \to 75.0$) while deep ones raise it ($80.0 \to 85.0$ and $48.0 \to 65.0$); drilling one interface control across many renderings transfers to held-out widget families and to the open web; and repairing a single environment lifts the model trained on it from $16.2\%$ to $38.5\%$. The same worlds serve as reinforcement-learning environments, where a reward combining the grounded verifier with a dense per-step judge raises held-out score from $58.8\%$ to $68.0\%$. We release four environments as a benchmark, with their applications, seed data and grounded graders. Code: https://aka.ms/echoverse

AI.tldr: Echoverse是一个将规格说明编译为有状态应用的框架，通过协同进化循环（对环境、任务、验证器进行修复，同时为模型提供训练信号）来训练计算机使用智能体。在12个环境上训练的9B模型从36.5%提升到67.1%，接近指导它的更大规模前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体的训练需要可操作、可破坏、可重置的应用环境，而最重要的应用通常是登录受限且有状态的，因此需要合成环境替代。现有流水线可以批量生成环境，瓶颈从"有多少环境"转向"每个环境内部有什么"。研究发现收益来自三个关键属性：行为深度、针对实际失败交互的定向训练、以及环境与模型共同进化。
AI.method: Echoverse将规格说明编译为状态化应用，任务通过对应用自身数据库进行分级评分。采用协同进化循环，每次分级回放被用于双重目的：(1)修复环境、任务和验证器，(2)为模型提供训练信号。还验证了环境可作为强化学习环境，结合接地验证器与密集逐步评判器的奖励信号。
AI.result: 在12个环境上训练的9B模型从36.5%提升到67.1%（跨越14个评估分割），与指导它的更大前沿模型仅差14个点。浅层环境使在线准确率从80.0降至75.0，深层环境提升至85.0和65.0；针对单一界面控件在不同渲染中训练可迁移到未见过的控件族和开放网络；修复单一环境将训练于其上的模型从16.2%提升至38.5%；使用强化学习奖励可将留出集分数从58.8%提升至68.0%。
AI.conclusion: 合成环境的质量属性（行为深度、针对性、协同进化）比数量更重要，Echoverse证明了通过精心设计的合成环境训练可以显著缩小小型开放模型与大型前沿模型在计算机使用任务上的差距，并发布了四个环境作为基准。

title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) transfers fine-grained visual knowledge by supervising student-generated trajectories with a privileged-view teacher. Yet its next-token corrections are source-mixed, combining visual signals with linguistic priors and teacher-specific effects. The key challenge is to estimate which corrections are supported by visual evidence, not merely where or how strongly to distill. We introduce Visual Attribution Distillation (VAD), a counterfactual target-reconstruction algorithm that estimates the visually attributable part of a teacher correction. At each student-generated prefix, VAD evaluates the same fixed teacher with the relevant evidence present and removed. The corresponding change in centered log-probabilities defines ut, a signed proxy for the visual evidence direction that estimates how revealing the evidence supports or refutes candidate tokens. VAD projects the original correction onto this proxy to obtain an intervention-aligned component and a proxy-unexplained residual, then reconstructs a student-anchored target from the former. During training, this reconstructed target supplies the primary supervision signal, while the privileged teacher contributes a weak regularizer. Across six fine-grained visual benchmarks at 4B and 9B scales, VAD outperforms direct privileged-view distillation and visual-advantage weighting. Token- level and controlled-target analyses show that the proxy-aligned component is enriched in task-relevant visual corrections and yields stronger target shifts, especially when evidence refutes a mistaken answer. These results support counterfactual target reconstruction as an effective alternative to source-mixed supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视觉归因蒸馏（VAD），通过反事实目标重建算法估计教师纠正中由视觉证据支持的部分，从而在多模态策略蒸馏中实现更精准的知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 多模态on-policy蒸馏（OPD）虽然能通过特权视觉教师监督学生生成轨迹来迁移细粒度视觉知识，但其下一token纠正是源混合的——混合了视觉信号、语言先验和教师特定效应。关键挑战在于估计哪些纠正是由视觉证据支持的，而不仅仅是决定在何处或以多强的力度进行蒸馏。
AI.method: 提出Visual Attribution Distillation (VAD)，一种反事实目标重建算法。在每个学生生成的前缀处，VAD在存在和移除相关证据两种情况下评估同一个固定教师，对应的中心化log概率变化作为视觉证据方向的符号代理（ut）。VAD将原始纠正投射到该代理上，得到干预对齐分量和代理无法解释的残差，然后从前者重建学生锚定目标。训练中，重建目标提供主要监督信号，特权重教师仅作为弱正则化项。
AI.result: 在6个细粒度视觉基准上、4B和9B规模下，VAD优于直接的带权视角蒸馏和视觉优势加权方法。Token级和受控目标分析表明，代理对齐分量富含任务相关的视觉纠正，并产生更强的目标偏移，尤其在证据反驳错误答案时效果显著。
AI.conclusion: 反事实目标重建是源混合监督的有效替代方案，能够更精准地分离并利用视觉证据驱动的纠正信号。

title: MSCM-net: A hyperspectral image classiffcation method based on multi-scale convolution and Mamba
summary: Hyperspectral imaging is widely used in remote sensing and engineering. Therefore, research on its classification methods is crucial. While CNN and Transformer-based methods have advanced, they still face locality constraints and high computational complexity. To address these issues, we propose an innovative hyperspectral image classification model, MSCM-net. Specifically, first of all, a model architecture combining multi-scale CNN and Mamba is proposed. It consists of a multi-scale feature extraction module (MCSE) and multiple stacked Mamba blocks, which integrates the local feature extraction capability of multi-scale CNN and the long sequence modeling advantage of Mamba. Secondly, the proposed MCSE module consists of multi-scale convolution and SENet. Convolution kernels of different scales extract local information with different receptive fields, enhancing the fusion of spatial and spectral information. Meanwhile, the SENet enables the model to automatically learn the importance of each channel in the multi-scale features. Furthermore, we also propose a dual-branch feature aggregation module, which further effectively extracts and integrates the spectral information contained in the central pixel and the spatial information in the surrounding pixels. Our model has undergone numerous experiments on three widely used benchmark datasets. The experimental results show that MSCM-net can achieve advanced classification performance while reducing computational complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为MSCM-net的高光谱图像分类模型，通过结合多尺度CNN和Mamba架构，解决了传统CNN和Transformer方法在局部约束和高计算复杂度方面的问题，在三个公开基准数据集上实现了先进的分类性能并降低了计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像分类在遥感等领域至关重要，但现有的CNN和Transformer方法分别面临局部性约束和高计算复杂度的挑战，需要一种既能高效提取局部特征又能有效建模长序列信息的新方法。
AI.method: MSCM-net模型包含三个核心设计：(1)结合多尺度CNN和Mamba的架构，由多尺度特征提取模块(MCSE)和多个堆叠的Mamba块组成；(2)MCSE模块采用多尺度卷积和SENet，通过不同尺度的卷积核提取不同感受野的局部信息，SENet自动学习多尺度特征中各通道的重要性；(3)提出双分支特征聚合模块，分别提取中心像素的光谱信息和周围像素的空间信息并进行融合。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的公开基准数据集上进行了大量实验，MSCM-net在实现先进分类性能的同时显著降低了计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: MSCM-net通过创新性地融合多尺度CNN的局部特征提取能力和Mamba的长序列建模优势，并辅以SENet通道注意力机制和双分支特征聚合模块，在高光谱图像分类任务中达到了精度与效率的良好平衡。

title: Group-Reflective Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is effective for training large language model agents. However, terminal rewards provide only coarse trajectory-level supervision, leaving successful behaviors, recurring mistakes, and incidental choices entangled in the same outcome signal. Existing agentic self-distillation methods enrich sparse supervision with natural-language skills, but skills retrieved externally or extracted from a single trajectory by stronger models may mismatch current experience, exceed the policy's capability, or remain path-specific. We propose Group-Reflective Self-Distillation (GRSD), which derives capability-aligned and outcome-discriminative guidance from the policy's own verified rollouts.
